### 8. Summary for Recreation

To recreate simplified Home and Profile pages in Compose Multiplatform Desktop:

**Home page:**
- `Scaffold` with `containerColor = Color(0xFFF2F2F7)` (light) or `Color(0xFF0D0D0D)` (dark)
- Floating top bar: 52dp height Surface, 28dp radius, 16dp horizontal margin, 6dp shadow, contains avatar (36dp circle) + search pill (36dp, full radius, `surfaceVariant.copy(alpha=0.5f)` background) + settings icon
- Scrollable category tab row below the top bar (capsule pills, 12sp, primary color when selected)
- `LazyVerticalGrid` with 2 columns (or adaptive), 12dp spacing, cards with 4:3 cover aspect ratio
- Video card: 12dp corner radius, cover with bottom gradient + stat pills (play count, danmaku), title (2 lines, 14-15sp Medium), UP avatar (14dp circle) + name (13sp)
- Floating bottom bar: 28dp radius, glass blur effect, 5 items with Cupertino icons, per-item colors

**Profile page:**
- Optional wallpaper background image (immersive mode)
- `LazyColumn` with 120dp top padding (for top bar clearance)
- User info: 72dp circular avatar + name (`titleLarge` Bold) + level badge + VIP badge (4dp radius, 10sp)
- Stats row: 4 columns SpaceAround (动态/关注/粉丝/硬币), 18sp Bold count + 12sp label
- Services: `IOSGroup`-style card (12dp radius, surface color, 16dp horizontal margin) containing `IOSClickableItem` rows (icon in rounded square + title + chevron), each ~54-60dp height
- Glass variant when immersive: `White.copy(alpha=0.28f)` container, `White.copy(alpha=0.4f)` border, white text with shadow
- Center-aligned transparent top bar with back + wallpaper + settings actions
- Floating bottom bar (same as home)

57	internal fun trimIncrementalRefreshVideosToEvenCount(videos: List<VideoItem>): List<VideoItem> {
58	    val size = videos.size
59	    if (size <= 1 || size % 2 == 0) return videos
60	    return videos.dropLast(1)

63	internal fun resolveRecommendFeedRequestIndex(
64	    isLoadMore: Boolean,
65	    isManualRefresh: Boolean,
66	    currentRefreshIndex: Int
67	): Int {
68	    return if (isLoadMore || isManualRefresh) {
69	        currentRefreshIndex + 1
70	    } else {
71	        0
72	    }
73	}

76	    category: HomeCategory,
77	    isLoadMore: Boolean,
78	    isManualRefresh: Boolean,
79	    validVideoCount: Int
80	): Boolean {
81	    return category == HomeCategory.RECOMMEND &&
82	        (isLoadMore || isManualRefresh) &&
83	        validVideoCount > 0

86	internal data class HomeRefreshUndoSnapshot(
87	    val videos: List<VideoItem>,
88	    val pageIndex: Int,
89	    val hasMore: Boolean
90	)
91	
92	internal fun buildHomeRefreshUndoSnapshot(
93	    refreshingCategory: HomeCategory,
94	    recommendCategoryState: CategoryContent?,
95	    fallbackVideos: List<VideoItem>,
96	    maxItems: Int = 20
97	): HomeRefreshUndoSnapshot? {
98	    if (refreshingCategory != HomeCategory.RECOMMEND) return null
99	    val sourceVideos = recommendCategoryState?.videos ?: fallbackVideos
100	    if (sourceVideos.isEmpty()) return null
101	    val sourcePageIndex = recommendCategoryState?.pageIndex ?: 1
102	    val sourceHasMore = recommendCategoryState?.hasMore ?: true
103	    return HomeRefreshUndoSnapshot(
104	        videos = sourceVideos.take(maxItems.coerceAtLeast(1)),
105	        pageIndex = sourcePageIndex,
106	        hasMore = sourceHasMore
107	    )
108	}
109	
110	internal fun shouldExposeHomeRefreshUndo(
111	    refreshingCategory: HomeCategory,
112	    snapshot: HomeRefreshUndoSnapshot?
113	): Boolean {
114	    return refreshingCategory == HomeCategory.RECOMMEND && snapshot != null
115	}

125	internal fun applyHomeRefreshUndoSnapshot(

127	    snapshot: HomeRefreshUndoSnapshot
128	): CategoryContent {
129	    return oldState.copy(

131	        pageIndex = snapshot.pageIndex,
132	        hasMore = snapshot.hasMore,
133	        isLoading = false,
134	        error = null
135	    )
136	}

310	    init {
311	        viewModelScope.launch {
312	            SettingsManager.getIncrementalTimelineRefresh(getApplication()).collect { enabled ->
313	                incrementalTimelineRefreshEnabled = enabled
314	            }
315	        }
316	        // Monitor blocked list
317	        viewModelScope.launch {
318	            blockedUpRepository.getAllBlockedUps().collect { list ->
319	                blockedMids = list.map { it.mid }.toSet()
320	                if (pendingNotInterestedRefilterBvids.isEmpty()) {
321	                    reFilterAllContent()
322	                }
323	            }
324	        }
325	        syncTodayWatchFeedbackFromStore()
326	        viewModelScope.launch {
327	            PluginManager.awaitPluginReady(ADFILTER_PLUGIN_ID)
328	            reFilterAllContent()
329	        }
330	        viewModelScope.launch {
331	            PluginManager.pluginsFlow.collect { plugins ->
332	                val plugin = plugins.find { it.plugin.id == TodayWatchPlugin.PLUGIN_ID }?.plugin as? TodayWatchPlugin
333	                if (plugin !== observedTodayWatchPlugin) {
334	                    todayWatchPluginObserverJob?.cancel()
335	                    observedTodayWatchPlugin = plugin
336	                    if (plugin != null) {
337	                        todayWatchPluginObserverJob = viewModelScope.launch {
338	                            plugin.configState.collect {
339	                                val runtime = syncTodayWatchPluginState(clearWhenDisabled = true)
340	                                if (shouldAutoRebuildTodayWatchPlan(
341	                                        currentCategory = _uiState.value.currentCategory,
342	                                        isTodayWatchEnabled = runtime.enabled,
343	                                        isTodayWatchCollapsed = runtime.collapsed
344	                                    )
345	                                ) {
346	                                    rebuildTodayWatchPlan()
347	                                }
348	                            }
349	                        }
350	                    } else {
351	                        todayWatchPluginObserverJob = null
352	                    }
353	                }
354	                val runtime = syncTodayWatchPluginState(clearWhenDisabled = true)
355	                if (shouldAutoRebuildTodayWatchPlan(
356	                        currentCategory = _uiState.value.currentCategory,
357	                        isTodayWatchEnabled = runtime.enabled,
358	                        isTodayWatchCollapsed = runtime.collapsed
359	                    )
360	                ) {
361	                    rebuildTodayWatchPlan()
362	                }
363	            }
364	        }
365	        loadData()
366	    }

368	    // [Feature] Re-filter all content when block list changes
369	    private fun reFilterAllContent() {
370	        val oldState = _uiState.value
371	        val newCategoryStates = oldState.categoryStates.mapValues { (_, content) ->
372	            content.copy(
373	                videos = PluginManager.filterFeedItems(
374	                    filterHomeFeedbackVideos(content.videos.filter { it.owner.mid !in blockedMids })
375	                ).toImmutableList(),
376	                // Filter live rooms if possible (assuming uid matches mid)
377	                liveRooms = content.liveRooms.filter { it.uid !in blockedMids }.toImmutableList(),
378	                followedLiveRooms = content.followedLiveRooms.filter { it.uid !in blockedMids }.toImmutableList()
379	            )
380	        }.toImmutableMap()
381	        
382	        var newState = oldState.copy(categoryStates = newCategoryStates)
383	        
384	        // Sync legacy fields for current category
385	        val currentContent = newCategoryStates[newState.currentCategory]
386	        if (currentContent != null) {
387	            newState = newState.copy(
388	                videos = currentContent.videos,
389	                liveRooms = currentContent.liveRooms,
390	                followedLiveRooms = currentContent.followedLiveRooms
391	            )
392	        }
393	        
394	        _uiState.value = newState
395	        viewModelScope.launch {
396	            val runtime = syncTodayWatchPluginState(clearWhenDisabled = true)
397	            if (shouldAutoRebuildTodayWatchPlan(
398	                    currentCategory = _uiState.value.currentCategory,
399	                    isTodayWatchEnabled = runtime.enabled,
400	                    isTodayWatchCollapsed = runtime.collapsed
401	                )
402	            ) {
403	                rebuildTodayWatchPlan()
404	            }
405	        }
406	    }

408	    private fun resolveTodayWatchRuntimeConfig(
409	        pluginEnabled: Boolean,
410	        config: TodayWatchPluginConfig
411	    ): TodayWatchRuntimeConfig {
412	        return TodayWatchRuntimeConfig(
413	            enabled = pluginEnabled,
414	            mode = config.currentMode.toUiMode(),
415	            upRankLimit = config.upRankLimit,
416	            queueBuildLimit = config.queueBuildLimit,
417	            queuePreviewLimit = config.queuePreviewLimit,
418	            historySampleLimit = config.historySampleLimit,
419	            linkEyeCareSignal = config.linkEyeCareSignal,
420	            showUpRank = config.showUpRank,
421	            showReasonHint = config.showReasonHint,
422	            enableWaterfallAnimation = config.enableWaterfallAnimation,
423	            waterfallExponent = config.waterfallExponent,
424	            collapsed = config.collapsed
425	        )
426	    }

428	    private fun syncTodayWatchPluginState(clearWhenDisabled: Boolean): TodayWatchRuntimeConfig {
429	        val info = PluginManager.plugins.find { it.plugin.id == TodayWatchPlugin.PLUGIN_ID }
430	        val pluginEnabled = info?.enabled == true
431	        val plugin = info?.plugin as? TodayWatchPlugin
432	        val config = plugin?.configState?.value ?: TodayWatchPluginConfig()
433	        val runtime = resolveTodayWatchRuntimeConfig(pluginEnabled = pluginEnabled, config = config)
434	
435	        val currentState = _uiState.value
436	        var nextState = currentState.copy(
437	            todayWatchPluginEnabled = runtime.enabled,
438	            todayWatchMode = runtime.mode,
439	            todayWatchCollapsed = runtime.collapsed,
440	            todayWatchCardConfig = TodayWatchCardUiConfig(
441	                showUpRank = runtime.showUpRank,
442	                showReasonHint = runtime.showReasonHint,
443	                queuePreviewLimit = runtime.queuePreviewLimit,
444	                enableWaterfallAnimation = runtime.enableWaterfallAnimation,
445	                waterfallExponent = runtime.waterfallExponent
446	            )
447	        )
448	
449	        if (!runtime.enabled && clearWhenDisabled) {
450	            nextState = nextState.copy(
451	                todayWatchPlan = null,
452	                todayWatchLoading = false,
453	                todayWatchError = null
454	            )
455	        }
456	        if (nextState != currentState) {
457	            _uiState.value = nextState
458	        }
459	        return runtime
460	    }

462	    fun switchTodayWatchMode(mode: TodayWatchMode) {

467	        plugin?.setCurrentMode(mode.toPluginMode())

476	        val plugin = info?.plugin as? TodayWatchPlugin
477	        plugin?.updateConfig { current -> current.copy(collapsed = collapsed) }
478	
479	        val current = _uiState.value
480	        if (current.todayWatchCollapsed == collapsed) return
481	        _uiState.value = current.copy(todayWatchCollapsed = collapsed)

484	            viewModelScope.launch {

486	                if (shouldAutoRebuildTodayWatchPlan(

498	    fun refreshTodayWatchOnly() {
499	        val runtime = syncTodayWatchPluginState(clearWhenDisabled = true)
500	        if (!runtime.enabled) return
501	
502	        todayConsumedBvids += collectTodayWatchConsumedForManualRefresh(
503	            plan = _uiState.value.todayWatchPlan,
504	            previewLimit = _uiState.value.todayWatchCardConfig.queuePreviewLimit
505	        )
506	        viewModelScope.launch {
507	            rebuildTodayWatchPlan(forceReloadHistory = false)
508	        }

511	    private suspend fun rebuildTodayWatchPlan(forceReloadHistory: Boolean = false) {
512	        val runtime = syncTodayWatchPluginState(clearWhenDisabled = true)
513	        if (!runtime.enabled) {
514	            return
515	        }
516	        syncTodayWatchFeedbackFromStore()
517	
518	        val recommendVideos = getRecommendCandidates()
519	        if (recommendVideos.isEmpty()) {
520	            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(
521	                todayWatchPlan = null,
522	                todayWatchLoading = false,
523	                todayWatchError = null
524	            )
525	            return
526	        }
527	
528	        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(todayWatchLoading = true, todayWatchError = null)
529	
530	        val historySample = loadHistorySample(
531	            forceReload = forceReloadHistory,
532	            sampleLimit = runtime.historySampleLimit
533	        )
534	        val creatorSignals = TodayWatchProfileStore.getCreatorSignals(
535	            context = getApplication(),
536	            limit = runtime.historySampleLimit / 4
537	        ).map {
538	            RecommendationCreatorSignal(
539	                mid = it.mid,
540	                name = it.name,
541	                score = it.score,
542	                watchCount = it.watchCount
543	            )
544	        }
545	        val eyeCareNightActive = runtime.linkEyeCareSignal &&
546	            EyeProtectionPlugin.getInstance()?.isNightModeActive?.value == true
547	
548	        val recommendationPlugin = PluginManager.plugins
549	            .firstOrNull { it.enabled && it.plugin.id == TodayWatchPlugin.PLUGIN_ID }
550	            ?.plugin as? RecommendationPluginApi
551	        if (recommendationPlugin == null) {
552	            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(
553	                todayWatchPlan = null,
554	                todayWatchLoading = false,
555	                todayWatchError = "今日推荐插件不可用"
556	            )
557	            return
558	        }
559	
560	        val result = recommendationPlugin.buildRecommendations(
561	            RecommendationRequest(
562	                historyVideos = historySample,
563	                candidateVideos = recommendVideos,
564	                mode = runtime.mode.toRecommendationMode(),
565	                sceneSignals = RecommendationSceneSignals(
566	                    eyeCareNightActive = eyeCareNightActive
567	                ),
568	                groupLimit = runtime.upRankLimit,
569	                queueLimit = runtime.queueBuildLimit,
570	                creatorSignals = creatorSignals,
571	                feedbackSignals = RecommendationFeedbackSignals(
572	                    consumedBvids = todayConsumedBvids.toSet(),
573	                    dislikedBvids = todayDislikedBvids.toSet(),
574	                    dislikedCreatorMids = todayDislikedCreatorMids.toSet(),
575	                    dislikedKeywords = todayDislikedKeywords.toSet()
576	                )
577	            )
578	        )
579	        val plan = result.toTodayWatchPlan()
580	
581	        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(
582	            todayWatchPlan = plan,
583	            todayWatchMode = runtime.mode,
584	            todayWatchLoading = false,
585	            todayWatchError = null
586	        )
587	    }
588	
589	    private suspend fun loadHistorySample(forceReload: Boolean, sampleLimit: Int): List<VideoItem> {
590	        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
591	        if (!forceReload &&
592	            historySampleCache.isNotEmpty() &&
593	            now - historySampleLoadedAtMs < HISTORY_SAMPLE_CACHE_TTL_MS
594	        ) {
595	            return historySampleCache.take(sampleLimit.coerceIn(20, 120))
596	        }
597	
598	        val firstPage = HistoryRepository.getHistoryList(ps = 50, max = 0, viewAt = 0).getOrNull()
599	        if (firstPage == null) {
600	            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(
601	                todayWatchLoading = false,
602	                todayWatchError = "历史记录不可用，已按当前推荐生成"
603	            )
604	            return emptyList()
605	        }
606	
607	        val merged = firstPage.list.map { it.toVideoItem() }.toMutableList()
608	        val cursor = firstPage.cursor
609	        if (cursor != null && cursor.max > 0 && merged.size < 80) {
610	            val secondPage = HistoryRepository.getHistoryList(
611	                ps = 50,
612	                max = cursor.max,
613	                viewAt = cursor.view_at,
614	                business = cursor.business
615	            ).getOrNull()
616	            if (secondPage != null) {
617	                merged += secondPage.list.map { it.toVideoItem() }
618	            }
619	        }
620	
621	        historySampleCache = merged
622	            .filter { it.bvid.isNotBlank() }
623	            .distinctBy { it.bvid }
624	        historySampleLoadedAtMs = now
625	        return historySampleCache.take(sampleLimit.coerceIn(20, 120))
626	    }

641	    fun switchCategory(category: HomeCategory) {
642	        val currentState = _uiState.value
643	        if (currentState.currentCategory == category) return
644	        
645	        //  [修复] 标记正在切换分类，避免入场动画产生收缩效果
646	        com.android.purebilibili.core.util.CardPositionManager.isSwitchingCategory = true
647	        
648	        viewModelScope.launch {
649	            //  [修复] 如果切换到直播分类，未登录用户默认显示热门
650	            val liveSubCategory = if (category == HomeCategory.LIVE) {
651	                val isLoggedIn = !com.android.purebilibili.core.store.TokenManager.sessDataCache.isNullOrEmpty()
652	                if (isLoggedIn) currentState.liveSubCategory else LiveSubCategory.POPULAR
653	            } else {
654	                currentState.liveSubCategory
655	            }
656	            
657	            _uiState.value = currentState.copy(
658	                currentCategory = category,
659	                liveSubCategory = liveSubCategory,
660	                displayedTabIndex = currentState.displayedTabIndex
661	            )
662	
663	            //  [修复] 恢复“追番”分类的数据拉取逻辑，确保滑动到这些页面时有内容显示
664	            /* 之前禁用了此处拉取，导致滑动展示空白页。现在移除提前返回。 */
665	
666	            val targetState = _uiState.value
667	            val targetCategoryState = if (category == HomeCategory.POPULAR) {
668	                targetState.popularCategoryStates[targetState.popularSubCategory] ?: CategoryContent()
669	            } else {
670	                targetState.categoryStates[category] ?: CategoryContent()
671	            }
672	            val needFetch = targetCategoryState.videos.isEmpty() && 
673	                           targetCategoryState.liveRooms.isEmpty() && 
674	                           !targetCategoryState.isLoading && 
675	                           targetCategoryState.error == null
676	
677	            // 如果目标分类没有数据，则加载
678	            if (needFetch) {
679	                 fetchData(isLoadMore = false)
680	            } else if (category == HomeCategory.RECOMMEND) {
681	                val runtime = syncTodayWatchPluginState(clearWhenDisabled = true)
682	                if (shouldAutoRebuildTodayWatchPlan(
683	                        currentCategory = category,
684	                        isTodayWatchEnabled = runtime.enabled,
685	                        isTodayWatchCollapsed = runtime.collapsed
686	                    )
687	                ) {
688	                    rebuildTodayWatchPlan()
689	                }
690	            }
691	        }

707	    //  [新增] 完成消散动画（从列表移除并记录到已过滤集合）
708	    //  [新增] 完成消散动画（从列表移除并记录到已过滤集合）
709	    fun completeVideoDissolve(bvid: String) {
710	        val currentCategory = _uiState.value.currentCategory
711	        val shouldRefilterAfterRemove = pendingNotInterestedRefilterBvids.remove(bvid)
712	        
713	        // Update global dissolving list
714	        val newDissolving = (_uiState.value.dissolvingVideos - bvid).toImmutableSet()
715	        
716	        // Update category state
717	        updateCategoryState(currentCategory) { oldState ->
718	            oldState.copy(
719	                videos = oldState.videos.filterNot { it.bvid == bvid }.toImmutableList()
720	            )
721	        }
722	        
723	        // Also update the global dissolving set in UI state
724	        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(dissolvingVideos = newDissolving)
725	        if (shouldRefilterAfterRemove) {
726	            reFilterAllContent()
727	        }
728	        if (currentCategory == HomeCategory.RECOMMEND) {
729	            viewModelScope.launch {
730	                val runtime = syncTodayWatchPluginState(clearWhenDisabled = true)
731	                if (shouldAutoRebuildTodayWatchPlan(
732	                        currentCategory = currentCategory,
733	                        isTodayWatchEnabled = runtime.enabled,
734	                        isTodayWatchCollapsed = runtime.collapsed
735	                    )
736	                ) {
737	                    rebuildTodayWatchPlan()
738	                }
739	            }
740	        }
741	    }

820	    fun markNotInterested(
821	        video: VideoItem,
822	        reason: RecommendationFeedbackReason,
823	        cardAnimationEnabled: Boolean = true
824	    ) {
825	        viewModelScope.launch {
826	            val action = resolveHomeNotInterestedAction(video, reason)
827	            recordTodayWatchNegativeFeedback(video, action)
828	            if (action.shouldBlockCreator) {
829	                blockedUpRepository.blockUp(
830	                    mid = action.creatorMid,
831	                    name = action.creatorName,
832	                    face = action.creatorFace
833	                )
834	                blockedMids = blockedMids + action.creatorMid
835	            }
836	            if (action.shouldBlockCreator || action.keywords.isNotEmpty()) {
837	                pendingNotInterestedRefilterBvids += video.bvid
838	            }
839	
840	            val transition = resolveHomeDismissVisualTransition(
841	                isFeedbackRecorded = true,
842	                cardAnimationEnabled = cardAnimationEnabled
843	            )
844	            if (transition.shouldStartDissolve) {
845	                startVideoDissolve(video.bvid)
846	            } else if (transition.shouldRemoveImmediately) {
847	                completeVideoDissolve(video.bvid)
848	            }
849	
850	            if (action.shouldSyncCreatorToBilibiliBlockedList) {
851	                viewModelScope.launch {
852	                    val writeResult = blockedUpRepository.blockUpWithBilibiliSync(
853	                        mid = action.creatorMid,
854	                        name = action.creatorName,
855	                        face = action.creatorFace
856	                    )
857	                    Logger.d("HomeVM", writeResult.message)
858	                }
859	            }
860	
861	            val metadata = video.recommendationFeedback
862	            val supportsServerSync = metadata?.supportsServerSync == true && reason.id != null
863	            if (supportsServerSync) {
864	                viewModelScope.launch {
865	                    ActionRepository.submitRecommendationFeedback(metadata, reason)
866	                        .onSuccess {
867	                            _feedbackEvents.send(
868	                                reason.toast.ifBlank { "已减少相关内容推荐" }
869	                            )
870	                        }
871	                        .onFailure {
872	                            _feedbackEvents.send("已在本地生效，服务器同步失败")
873	                        }
874	                }
875	            } else {
876	                _feedbackEvents.send(reason.toast.ifBlank { "已减少相关内容推荐" })
877	            }
878	            Logger.d("HomeVM", "已记录不感兴趣: ${video.bvid}, reason=${reason.name}")
879	        }
880	    }

969	    fun refresh(category: HomeCategory = _uiState.value.currentCategory) {
970	        if (_isRefreshing.value) return
971	        viewModelScope.launch {
972	            _isRefreshing.value = true
973	            val refreshingCategory = category
974	            syncCurrentCategoryForRefresh(refreshingCategory)
975	            _undoSnapshot = buildHomeRefreshUndoSnapshot(
976	                refreshingCategory = refreshingCategory,
977	                recommendCategoryState = _uiState.value.categoryStates[HomeCategory.RECOMMEND],
978	                fallbackVideos = _uiState.value.videos
979	            )
980	            //  [新增] 刷新前保存推荐视频快照（用于撤销）
981	            val previousRecommendTopBvid = if (refreshingCategory == HomeCategory.RECOMMEND) {
982	                (_uiState.value.categoryStates[HomeCategory.RECOMMEND]?.videos
983	                    ?: _uiState.value.videos).firstOrNull()?.bvid?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
984	            } else null
985	            val newItemsCount = fetchData(
986	                isLoadMore = false,
987	                isManualRefresh = true,
988	                category = refreshingCategory
989	            )
990	            
991	            //  数据加载完成后再更新 refreshKey，避免闪烁
992	            //  刷新成功后显示趣味提示
993	            val refreshMessage = com.android.purebilibili.core.util.EasterEggs.getRefreshMessage()
994	            val oldBoundary = _uiState.value.recommendOldContentStartIndex
995	            val newBoundary = if (refreshingCategory == HomeCategory.RECOMMEND) {
996	                if ((newItemsCount ?: 0) > 0) newItemsCount else null
997	            } else {
998	                oldBoundary
999	            }
1000	            val oldAnchor = _uiState.value.recommendOldContentAnchorBvid
1001	            val newAnchor = if (refreshingCategory == HomeCategory.RECOMMEND) {
1002	                if ((newItemsCount ?: 0) > 0) previousRecommendTopBvid else null
1003	            } else {
1004	                oldAnchor
1005	            }
1006	            val undoAvailable = shouldExposeHomeRefreshUndo(
1007	                refreshingCategory = refreshingCategory,
1008	                snapshot = _undoSnapshot
1009	            )
1010	            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(
1011	                refreshKey = System.currentTimeMillis(),
1012	                refreshMessage = refreshMessage,
1013	                refreshNewItemsCount = newItemsCount,
1014	                refreshNewItemsKey = if (newItemsCount != null) System.currentTimeMillis() else _uiState.value.refreshNewItemsKey,
1015	                recommendOldContentAnchorBvid = newAnchor,
1016	                recommendOldContentStartIndex = newBoundary,
1017	                recommendOldContentRevealKey = if (refreshingCategory == HomeCategory.RECOMMEND) 0L else _uiState.value.recommendOldContentRevealKey,
1018	                //  刷新成功且是推荐分类时标记可撤销
1019	                undoAvailable = undoAvailable
1020	            )
1021	            if (undoAvailable) {
1022	                scheduleUndoDismiss()
1023	            } else {
1024	                cancelUndoDismiss()
1025	            }
1026	            _isRefreshing.value = false
1027	        }
1028	    }

1030	    private fun syncCurrentCategoryForRefresh(category: HomeCategory) {
1031	        val current = _uiState.value
1032	        if (current.currentCategory == category) return
1033	        val categoryState = current.categoryStates[category] ?: CategoryContent()
1034	        // 下拉刷新发生在具体 Pager 页上，先同步当前分类，避免刷新态和数据请求落到旧页面。
1035	        _uiState.value = current.copy(
1036	            currentCategory = category,
1037	            videos = categoryState.videos,
1038	            liveRooms = categoryState.liveRooms,
1039	            followedLiveRooms = categoryState.followedLiveRooms,
1040	            isLoading = categoryState.isLoading,
1041	            error = categoryState.error
1042	        )
1043	    }

1053	        if (key <= 0L) return
1054	        val current = _uiState.value
1055	        if (current.currentCategory != HomeCategory.RECOMMEND) return
1056	        if (key != current.refreshNewItemsKey || current.recommendOldContentRevealKey == key) return
1057	        if (current.recommendOldContentAnchorBvid == null && current.recommendOldContentStartIndex == null) return
1058	        _uiState.value = current.copy(recommendOldContentRevealKey = key)
1059	    }

1062	    fun undoRefresh() {
1063	        val snapshot = _undoSnapshot ?: return
1064	        cancelUndoDismiss()
1065	        updateCategoryState(HomeCategory.RECOMMEND) { oldState ->
1066	            applyHomeRefreshUndoSnapshot(oldState = oldState, snapshot = snapshot)
1067	        }
1068	        _undoSnapshot = null
1069	        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(
1070	            undoAvailable = false,
1071	            recommendOldContentAnchorBvid = null,
1072	            recommendOldContentStartIndex = null,
1073	            recommendOldContentRevealKey = 0L
1074	        )
1075	        Logger.d("HomeVM", "↩️ Undo refresh: restored ${snapshot.videos.size} videos")
1076	    }

1140	    private suspend fun refreshMessageUnreadCount() {
1141	        if (com.android.purebilibili.core.store.TokenManager.sessDataCache.isNullOrEmpty()) {
1142	            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(messageUnreadCount = 0)
1143	            return
1144	        }
1145	
1146	        val unreadResult = MessageRepository.getUnreadCount()
1147	        val feedUnreadResult = MessageRepository.getFeedUnread()
1148	        if (unreadResult.isSuccess && feedUnreadResult.isSuccess) {

1158	    private suspend fun fetchData(
1159	        isLoadMore: Boolean,
1160	        isManualRefresh: Boolean = false,
1161	        category: HomeCategory = _uiState.value.currentCategory
1162	    ): Int? {
1163	        val currentCategory = category
1164	        val popularSubCategory = _uiState.value.popularSubCategory
1165	        var refreshNewItemsCount: Int? = null
1166	        
1167	        // 更新当前分类为加载状态
1168	        if (currentCategory == HomeCategory.POPULAR) {
1169	            updatePopularCategoryState(popularSubCategory) { it.copy(isLoading = true, error = null) }
1170	        } else {
1171	            updateCategoryState(currentCategory) { it.copy(isLoading = true, error = null) }
1172	        }
1173	        
1174	        //  直播分类单独处理 (TODO: Adapt fetchLiveRooms to use categoryStates)
1175	        if (currentCategory == HomeCategory.LIVE) {
1176	            fetchLiveRooms(isLoadMore)
1177	            return refreshNewItemsCount
1178	        }
1179	        
1180	        //  关注动态分类单独处理 (TODO: Adapt fetchFollowFeed to use categoryStates)
1181	        if (currentCategory == HomeCategory.FOLLOW) {
1182	            return fetchFollowFeed(
1183	                isLoadMore = isLoadMore,
1184	                isManualRefresh = isManualRefresh
1185	            )
1186	        }
1187	        
1188	        val currentCategoryState = if (currentCategory == HomeCategory.POPULAR) {
1189	            _uiState.value.popularCategoryStates[popularSubCategory] ?: CategoryContent()
1190	        } else {
1191	            _uiState.value.categoryStates[currentCategory] ?: CategoryContent()
1192	        }
1193	        val advanceOnManualRefresh = shouldAdvancePagedFeedOnManualRefresh(
1194	            category = currentCategory,
1195	            popularSubCategory = popularSubCategory
1196	        )
1197	        // 分区/热门综合：手动刷新翻下一页换一批；其它分类仍回第 1 页
1198	        val pageToFetch = resolvePagedFeedPageToFetch(
1199	            isLoadMore = isLoadMore,
1200	            isManualRefresh = isManualRefresh,
1201	            currentPageIndex = currentCategoryState.pageIndex,
1202	            advanceOnManualRefresh = advanceOnManualRefresh
1203	        )
1204	        val recommendRequestIndex = resolveRecommendFeedRequestIndex(
1205	            isLoadMore = isLoadMore,
1206	            isManualRefresh = isManualRefresh,
1207	            currentRefreshIndex = refreshIdx
1208	        )
1209	
1210	        //  视频类分类处理
1211	        val videoResult = when (currentCategory) {
1212	            HomeCategory.RECOMMEND -> VideoRepository.getHomeVideos(recommendRequestIndex) // Recommend uses idx, slightly different
1213	            HomeCategory.POPULAR -> {
1214	                when (popularSubCategory) {
1215	                    PopularSubCategory.COMPREHENSIVE -> VideoRepository.getPopularVideos(pageToFetch)
1216	                    PopularSubCategory.RANKING -> VideoRepository.getRankingVideos(rid = 0, type = "all")
1217	                    PopularSubCategory.WEEKLY -> VideoRepository.getWeeklyMustWatchVideos()
1218	                    PopularSubCategory.PRECIOUS -> VideoRepository.getPreciousVideos()
1219	                }
1220	            }
1221	            else -> {
1222	                //  Generic categories (Game, Tech, etc.)
1223	                if (currentCategory.tid > 0) {
1224	                     VideoRepository.getRegionVideos(tid = currentCategory.tid, page = pageToFetch)
1225	                } else {
1226	                     Result.failure(Exception("Unknown category"))
1227	                }
1228	            }
1229	        }
1230	        
1231	        if (shouldRefreshHomeUserInfoAfterFeedLoad(isLoadMore)) {
1232	            refreshUserInfoInBackground()
1233	        }
1234	
1235	        if (isLoadMore) delay(100)
1236	
1237	        videoResult.onSuccess { videos ->
1238	            val validVideos = videos.filter { it.bvid.isNotEmpty() && it.title.isNotEmpty() }
1239	            if (shouldAdvanceRecommendFeedRequestIndex(
1240	                    category = currentCategory,
1241	                    isLoadMore = isLoadMore,
1242	                    isManualRefresh = isManualRefresh,
1243	                    validVideoCount = validVideos.size
1244	                )
1245	            ) {
1246	                refreshIdx = maxOf(refreshIdx, recommendRequestIndex)
1247	            }
1248	            
1249	            //  [Feature] 应用屏蔽 + 原生插件 + JSON 规则插件过滤器
1250	            val blockedFiltered = validVideos.filter { video -> video.owner.mid !in blockedMids }
1251	            val feedbackFiltered = filterHomeFeedbackVideos(blockedFiltered)
1252	            val builtinFiltered = PluginManager.filterFeedItems(feedbackFiltered)
1253	            val filteredVideos = com.android.purebilibili.core.plugin.json.JsonPluginManager
1254	                .filterVideos(builtinFiltered)
1255	            
1256	            // Global deduplication for RECOMMEND only? Or per category? 
1257	            // Usually Recommend needs global deduplication. Other categories might just need simple append.
1258	            // For now, let's keep sessionSeenBvids for RECOMMEND, or apply globally to avoid seeing same video across tabs?
1259	            // Let's apply globally for now as per existing logic, but maybe we should scope it?
1260	            // Existing logic had a single sessionSeenBvids.
1261	            
1262	            val uniqueNewVideos = if (currentCategory == HomeCategory.RECOMMEND) {
1263	                filteredVideos.filter { it.bvid !in sessionSeenBvids }
1264	            } else {
1265	                filteredVideos
1266	            }
1267	            
1268	            val useIncrementalRecommendRefresh = !isLoadMore &&
1269	                currentCategory == HomeCategory.RECOMMEND &&
1270	                incrementalTimelineRefreshEnabled
1271	
1272	            val incomingVideos = if (useIncrementalRecommendRefresh) {
1273	                trimIncrementalRefreshVideosToEvenCount(uniqueNewVideos)
1274	            } else {
1275	                uniqueNewVideos
1276	            }
1277	
1278	            if (currentCategory == HomeCategory.RECOMMEND) {
1279	                sessionSeenBvids.addAll(incomingVideos.map { it.bvid })
1280	            }
1281	            
1282	            if (incomingVideos.isNotEmpty() || useIncrementalRecommendRefresh) {
1283	                var addedCount = 0
1284	                val updateContent: (CategoryContent) -> CategoryContent = { oldState ->
1285	                    val mergedVideos = when {
1286	                        isLoadMore -> appendDistinctByKey(oldState.videos, incomingVideos, ::videoItemKey).toImmutableList()
1287	                        useIncrementalRecommendRefresh -> {
1288	                            val merged = prependDistinctByKey(oldState.videos, incomingVideos, ::videoItemKey)
1289	                            addedCount = (merged.size - oldState.videos.size).coerceAtLeast(0)
1290	                            merged.toImmutableList()
1291	                        }
1292	                        else -> incomingVideos.toImmutableList()
1293	                    }
1294	
1295	                    oldState.copy(
1296	                        videos = mergedVideos,
1297	                        liveRooms = emptyList<LiveRoom>().toImmutableList(),
1298	                        isLoading = false,
1299	                        error = null,
1300	                        pageIndex = if (useIncrementalRecommendRefresh) {
1301	                            oldState.pageIndex
1302	                        } else {
1303	                            resolvePagedFeedPageIndexAfterFetch(
1304	                                isLoadMore = isLoadMore,
1305	                                isManualRefresh = isManualRefresh,
1306	                                advanceOnManualRefresh = advanceOnManualRefresh,
1307	                                pageToFetch = pageToFetch,
1308	                                incomingCount = incomingVideos.size,
1309	                                previousPageIndex = oldState.pageIndex
1310	                            )
1311	                        },
1312	                        hasMore = if (currentCategory == HomeCategory.POPULAR) {
1313	                            supportsPopularLoadMore(popularSubCategory)
1314	                        } else {
1315	                            true
1316	                        }
1317	                    )
1318	                }
1319	                if (currentCategory == HomeCategory.POPULAR) {
1320	                    updatePopularCategoryState(popularSubCategory, updateContent)
1321	                } else {
1322	                    updateCategoryState(currentCategory, updateContent)
1323	                }
1324	
1325	                if (useIncrementalRecommendRefresh && isManualRefresh) {
1326	                    refreshNewItemsCount = addedCount
1327	                }
1328	            } else {
1329	                 //  全被过滤掉了 OR 空列表
1330	                 val updateContent: (CategoryContent) -> CategoryContent = { oldState ->
1331	                    oldState.copy(
1332	                        isLoading = false,
1333	                        error = if (!isLoadMore && oldState.videos.isEmpty()) "没有更多内容了" else null,
1334	                        hasMore = false,
1335	                        pageIndex = resolvePagedFeedPageIndexAfterFetch(
1336	                            isLoadMore = isLoadMore,
1337	                            isManualRefresh = isManualRefresh,
1338	                            advanceOnManualRefresh = advanceOnManualRefresh,
1339	                            pageToFetch = pageToFetch,
1340	                            incomingCount = 0,
1341	                            previousPageIndex = oldState.pageIndex
1342	                        )
1343	                    )
1344	                 }
1345	                 if (currentCategory == HomeCategory.POPULAR) {
1346	                     updatePopularCategoryState(popularSubCategory, updateContent)
1347	                 } else {
1348	                     updateCategoryState(currentCategory, updateContent)
1349	                 }
1350	            }
1351	            if (currentCategory == HomeCategory.RECOMMEND) {
1352	                viewModelScope.launch {
1353	                    val runtime = syncTodayWatchPluginState(clearWhenDisabled = true)
1354	                    if (shouldAutoRebuildTodayWatchPlan(
1355	                            currentCategory = currentCategory,
1356	                            isTodayWatchEnabled = runtime.enabled,
1357	                            isTodayWatchCollapsed = runtime.collapsed
1358	                        )
1359	                    ) {
1360	                        rebuildTodayWatchPlan(forceReloadHistory = !isLoadMore && isManualRefresh)
1361	                    }
1362	                }
1363	            }
1364	        }.onFailure { error ->
1365	            val updateContent: (CategoryContent) -> CategoryContent = { oldState ->
1366	                oldState.copy(
1367	                    isLoading = false,
1368	                    error = if (!isLoadMore && oldState.videos.isEmpty()) error.message ?: "网络错误" else null,
1369	                    hasMore = if (shouldKeepHomeCategoryAutoPagingAfterFailure(isLoadMore)) {
1370	                        oldState.hasMore
1371	                    } else {
1372	                        false
1373	                    }
1374	                )
1375	            }
1376	            if (currentCategory == HomeCategory.POPULAR) {
1377	                updatePopularCategoryState(popularSubCategory, updateContent)
1378	            } else {
1379	                updateCategoryState(currentCategory, updateContent)
1380	            }
1381	            if (currentCategory == HomeCategory.RECOMMEND) {
1382	                val runtime = syncTodayWatchPluginState(clearWhenDisabled = true)
1383	                if (runtime.enabled) {
1384	                    _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(
1385	                        todayWatchLoading = false,
1386	                        todayWatchError = error.message ?: "今日推荐单生成失败"
1387	                    )
1388	                }
1389	            }
1390	        }
1391	        return refreshNewItemsCount
1392	    }

1394	    private fun updatePopularCategoryState(
1395	        subCategory: PopularSubCategory,
1396	        update: (CategoryContent) -> CategoryContent
1397	    ) {
1398	        val current = _uiState.value
1399	        val currentSubCategoryState = current.popularCategoryStates[subCategory] ?: CategoryContent()
1400	        val newSubCategoryState = update(currentSubCategoryState)
1401	        val newPopularStates = current.popularCategoryStates.toMutableMap()
1402	        newPopularStates[subCategory] = newSubCategoryState
1403	
1404	        var newState = current.copy(popularCategoryStates = newPopularStates.toImmutableMap())
1405	        if (current.currentCategory == HomeCategory.POPULAR && current.popularSubCategory == subCategory) {
1406	            val newCategoryStates = current.categoryStates.toMutableMap()
1407	            newCategoryStates[HomeCategory.POPULAR] = newSubCategoryState
1408	            newState = newState.copy(
1409	                categoryStates = newCategoryStates.toImmutableMap(),
1410	                videos = newSubCategoryState.videos,
1411	                liveRooms = newSubCategoryState.liveRooms,
1412	                followedLiveRooms = newSubCategoryState.followedLiveRooms,
1413	                isLoading = newSubCategoryState.isLoading,
1414	                error = newSubCategoryState.error
1415	            )
1416	        }
1417	        _uiState.value = newState
1418	    }

1420	    // Helper to update state for a specific category
1421	    private fun updateCategoryState(category: HomeCategory, update: (CategoryContent) -> CategoryContent) {
1422	        val currentStates = _uiState.value.categoryStates
1423	        val currentCategoryState = currentStates[category] ?: CategoryContent()
1424	        val newCategoryState = update(currentCategoryState)
1425	        val newStates = currentStates.toMutableMap()
1426	        newStates[category] = newCategoryState
1427	        
1428	        // Also update legacy fields if it is current category, to keep UI working until full migration
1429	        // Or if we fully migrated UI, we don't need to update legacy fields 'videos', 'liveRooms' etc in HomeUiState root.
1430	        // But HomeScreen.kt still uses `state.videos`. So we MUST sync variables.
1431	        
1432	        var newState = _uiState.value.copy(categoryStates = newStates.toImmutableMap())
1433	        
1434	        if (category == newState.currentCategory) {
1435	            newState = newState.copy(
1436	                videos = newCategoryState.videos,
1437	                liveRooms = newCategoryState.liveRooms,
1438	                followedLiveRooms = newCategoryState.followedLiveRooms,
1439	                isLoading = newCategoryState.isLoading,
1440	                error = newCategoryState.error
1441	            )
1442	        }
1443	        _uiState.value = newState
1444	    }

1447	    //  [新增] 获取关注动态列表
1448	    private suspend fun fetchFollowFeed(
1449	        isLoadMore: Boolean,
1450	        isManualRefresh: Boolean
1451	    ): Int? {
1452	        if (com.android.purebilibili.core.store.TokenManager.sessDataCache.isNullOrEmpty()) {
1453	             updateCategoryState(HomeCategory.FOLLOW) { oldState ->
1454	                oldState.copy(
1455	                    isLoading = false,
1456	                    error = "未登录，请先登录以查看关注内容",
1457	                    videos = emptyList<VideoItem>().toImmutableList() // Ensure empty to trigger error state
1458	                )
1459	            }
1460	            return null
1461	        }
1462	
1463	        if (!isLoadMore) {
1464	            fetchUserInfo()
1465	        }
1466	
1467	        if (isLoadMore) delay(100)
1468	
1469	        val followScope = com.android.purebilibili.data.repository.DynamicFeedScope.HOME_FOLLOW
1470	        val followType = "video"
1471	        val establishedBaseline = com.android.purebilibili.data.repository.DynamicRepository
1472	            .currentUpdateBaseline(scope = followScope, type = followType)
1473	        // 手动下拉且已有基线：按 API 文档带 update_baseline 探测新动态（update_num）。
1474	        val probeWithBaseline = isManualRefresh &&
1475	            !isLoadMore &&
1476	            establishedBaseline.isNotBlank()
1477	
1478	        val result = com.android.purebilibili.data.repository.DynamicRepository.getDynamicFeed(
1479	            refresh = !isLoadMore,
1480	            scope = followScope,
1481	            type = followType,
1482	            incrementalRefresh = if (probeWithBaseline) {
1483	                true
1484	            } else {
1485	                !isLoadMore && incrementalTimelineRefreshEnabled
1486	            }
1487	        )
1488	
1489	        var tipCount: Int? = null
1490	        result.onSuccess { feedResult ->
1491	            val videos = mapHomeFollowDynamicItemsToVideos(feedResult.items)
1492	            val apiUpdateNum = feedResult.updateNum
1493	            val usedBaseline = feedResult.usedUpdateBaseline
1494	
1495	            if (
1496	                probeWithBaseline &&
1497	                shouldFullReplaceFollowFeedAfterBaselineProbe(
1498	                    incrementalRefreshEnabled = incrementalTimelineRefreshEnabled,
1499	                    apiUpdateNum = apiUpdateNum
1500	                )
1501	            ) {
1502	                // 关闭「增量刷新」但探测到新动态：再拉一整页替换列表。
1503	                val fullResult = com.android.purebilibili.data.repository.DynamicRepository.getDynamicFeed(
1504	                    refresh = true,
1505	                    scope = followScope,
1506	                    type = followType,
1507	                    incrementalRefresh = false
1508	                )
1509	                fullResult.onSuccess { fullFeed ->
1510	                    val fullVideos = mapHomeFollowDynamicItemsToVideos(fullFeed.items)
1511	                    tipCount = resolveHomeFollowRefreshNewItemsCount(
1512	                        usedUpdateBaseline = true,
1513	                        apiUpdateNum = apiUpdateNum,
1514	                        insertedVideoCount = apiUpdateNum
1515	                    )
1516	                    updateCategoryState(HomeCategory.FOLLOW) { oldState ->
1517	                        oldState.copy(
1518	                            videos = fullVideos.toImmutableList(),
1519	                            liveRooms = emptyList<LiveRoom>().toImmutableList(),
1520	                            isLoading = false,
1521	                            error = if (fullVideos.isEmpty()) "暂无关注动态，请先关注一些UP主" else null,
1522	                            hasMore = com.android.purebilibili.data.repository.DynamicRepository.hasMoreData(
1523	                                scope = followScope,
1524	                                type = followType
1525	                            )
1526	                        )
1527	                    }
1528	                }.onFailure { error ->
1529	                    updateCategoryState(HomeCategory.FOLLOW) { oldState ->
1530	                        oldState.copy(
1531	                            isLoading = false,
1532	                            error = if (oldState.videos.isEmpty()) error.message ?: "请先登录" else null
1533	                        )
1534	                    }
1535	                }
1536	                return tipCount
1537	            }
1538	
1539	            updateCategoryState(HomeCategory.FOLLOW) { oldState ->
1540	                val oldSize = oldState.videos.size
1541	                val mergedVideos = when {
1542	                    isLoadMore -> appendDistinctByKey(oldState.videos, videos, ::videoItemKey).toImmutableList()
1543	                    usedBaseline || (!isLoadMore && incrementalTimelineRefreshEnabled) -> {
1544	                        prependDistinctByKey(oldState.videos, videos, ::videoItemKey).toImmutableList()
1545	                    }
1546	                    else -> videos.toImmutableList()
1547	                }
1548	                val insertedCount = (mergedVideos.size - oldSize).coerceAtLeast(0)
1549	                if (isManualRefresh && !isLoadMore) {
1550	                    tipCount = resolveHomeFollowRefreshNewItemsCount(
1551	                        usedUpdateBaseline = usedBaseline,
1552	                        apiUpdateNum = apiUpdateNum,
1553	                        insertedVideoCount = insertedCount
1554	                    )
1555	                }
1556	                oldState.copy(
1557	                    videos = mergedVideos,
1558	                    liveRooms = emptyList<LiveRoom>().toImmutableList(),
1559	                    isLoading = false,
1560	                    error = if (!isLoadMore && mergedVideos.isEmpty()) "暂无关注动态，请先关注一些UP主" else null,
1561	                    hasMore = com.android.purebilibili.data.repository.DynamicRepository.hasMoreData(
1562	                        scope = followScope,
1563	                        type = followType
1564	                    )
1565	                )
1566	            }
1567	        }.onFailure { error ->
1568	             updateCategoryState(HomeCategory.FOLLOW) { oldState ->
1569	                oldState.copy(
1570	                    isLoading = false,
1571	                    error = if (!isLoadMore && oldState.videos.isEmpty()) error.message ?: "请先登录" else null
1572	                )
1573	            }
1574	        }
1575	        return tipCount
1576	    }

1578	    private fun mapHomeFollowDynamicItemsToVideos(
1579	        items: List<com.android.purebilibili.data.model.response.DynamicItem>
1580	    ): List<com.android.purebilibili.data.model.response.VideoItem> {
1581	        return items.mapNotNull { item ->
1582	            if ((item.modules.module_author?.mid ?: 0) in blockedMids) return@mapNotNull null
1583	
1584	            val archive = item.modules.module_dynamic?.major?.archive ?: return@mapNotNull null
1585	            if (!shouldIncludeHomeFollowDynamicInVideoFeed(archive.bvid)) {
1586	                return@mapNotNull null
1587	            }
1588	
1589	            val resolvedAid = resolveDynamicArchiveAid(
1590	                archiveAid = archive.aid,
1591	                fallbackId = 0L
1592	            )
1593	            com.android.purebilibili.data.model.response.VideoItem(
1594	                id = resolvedAid,
1595	                bvid = archive.bvid,
1596	                dynamicId = item.id_str.trim(),
1597	                aid = resolvedAid,
1598	                title = archive.title,
1599	                pic = archive.cover,
1600	                duration = parseDurationText(archive.duration_text),
1601	                owner = com.android.purebilibili.data.model.response.Owner(
1602	                    mid = item.modules.module_author?.mid ?: 0,
1603	                    name = item.modules.module_author?.name ?: "",
1604	                    face = item.modules.module_author?.face ?: ""
1605	                ),
1606	                stat = com.android.purebilibili.data.model.response.Stat(
1607	                    view = parseStatText(archive.stat.play),
1608	                    danmaku = parseStatText(archive.stat.danmaku)
1609	                )
1610	            )
1611	        }
1612	    }

1614	    private fun videoItemKey(item: com.android.purebilibili.data.model.response.VideoItem): String {
1615	        if (item.dynamicId.isNotBlank()) return "dyn:${item.dynamicId}"
1616	        if (item.bvid.isNotBlank()) return "bvid:${item.bvid}"
1617	        if (item.aid > 0) return "aid:${item.aid}"
1618	        if (item.id > 0) return "id:${item.id}"
1619	        return "${item.owner.mid}:${item.title}:${item.pubdate}"
1620	    }

1622	    //  解析时长文本 "10:24" -> 624 秒
1623	    private fun parseDurationText(text: String): Int {
1624	        val parts = text.split(":")
1625	        return try {
1626	            when (parts.size) {
1627	                2 -> parts[0].toInt() * 60 + parts[1].toInt()
1628	                3 -> parts[0].toInt() * 3600 + parts[1].toInt() * 60 + parts[2].toInt()
1629	                else -> 0
1630	            }
1631	        } catch (e: Exception) { 0 }
1632	    }
1633	    
1634	    //  解析统计文本 "123.4万" -> 1234000
1635	    private fun parseStatText(text: String): Int {
1636	        return try {
1637	            if (text.contains("万")) {
1638	                (text.replace("万", "").toFloat() * 10000).toInt()
1639	            } else if (text.contains("亿")) {
1640	                (text.replace("亿", "").toFloat() * 100000000).toInt()
1641	            } else {
1642	                text.toIntOrNull() ?: 0
1643	            }
1644	        } catch (e: Exception) { 0 }
1645	    }

1647	    //  🔴 [改进] 获取直播间列表（同时获取关注和热门）
1648	    private suspend fun fetchLiveRooms(isLoadMore: Boolean) {
1649	        val page = if (isLoadMore) livePage else 1
1650	        
1651	        com.android.purebilibili.core.util.Logger.d("HomeVM", "🔴 fetchLiveRooms: isLoadMore=$isLoadMore, page=$page")
1652	        
1653	        if (!isLoadMore) {
1654	            fetchUserInfo()
1655	            
1656	            // 🔴 [改进] 首次加载时同时获取关注和热门直播
1657	            val isLoggedIn = !com.android.purebilibili.core.store.TokenManager.sessDataCache.isNullOrEmpty()
1658	            
1659	            // 并行获取关注和热门直播
1660	            val followedResult = if (isLoggedIn) LiveRepository.getFollowedLive(1) else Result.success(emptyList())
1661	            val popularResult = LiveRepository.getLiveRooms(1)
1662	            
1663	            // 处理关注直播结果
1664	            val followedRooms = followedResult.getOrDefault(emptyList())
1665	            
1666	            // 处理热门直播结果
1667	            popularResult.onSuccess { rooms ->
1668	                if (rooms.isNotEmpty() || followedRooms.isNotEmpty()) {
1669	                    updateCategoryState(HomeCategory.LIVE) { oldState ->
1670	                        oldState.copy(
1671	                            followedLiveRooms = followedRooms.toImmutableList(),
1672	                            liveRooms = rooms.toImmutableList(),
1673	                            videos = emptyList<VideoItem>().toImmutableList(),
1674	                            isLoading = false,
1675	                            error = null,
1676	                            hasMore = true
1677	                        )
1678	                    }
1679	                } else {

1700	            delay(100)

1704	                    val currentLiveRooms = _uiState.value.categoryStates[HomeCategory.LIVE]?.liveRooms ?: emptyList()

1783	    //  获取关注列表（并行分页获取，支持更多关注，带本地缓存）
1784	    private suspend fun fetchFollowingList(mid: Long) {
1785	        val context = getApplication<android.app.Application>()
1786	        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences("following_cache", android.content.Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
1787	        val cacheKey = "following_mids_$mid"
1788	        val cacheTimeKey = "following_time_$mid"
1789	        
1790	        //  检查缓存（1小时内有效）
1791	        val cachedTime = prefs.getLong(cacheTimeKey, 0)
1792	        val cacheValidDuration = 60 * 60 * 1000L  // 1小时
1793	        if (System.currentTimeMillis() - cachedTime < cacheValidDuration) {
1794	            val cachedMids = prefs.getStringSet(cacheKey, null)
1795	            if (!cachedMids.isNullOrEmpty()) {
1796	                val mids = cachedMids.mapNotNull { it.toLongOrNull() }.toSet()
1797	                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(followingMids = mids.toImmutableSet())
1798	                com.android.purebilibili.core.util.Logger.d("HomeVM", " Loaded ${mids.size} following mids from cache")
1799	                return
1800	            }
1801	        }
1802	        
1803	        //  动态获取所有关注列表（无上限）
1804	        try {
1805	            val allMids = mutableSetOf<Long>()
1806	            
1807	            kotlinx.coroutines.withContext(kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers.IO) {
1808	                var page = 1
1809	                while (true) {  //  无限循环，直到获取完所有关注
1810	                    try {
1811	                        val result = com.android.purebilibili.core.network.NetworkModule.api.getFollowings(mid, page, 50)
1812	                        if (result.code == 0 && result.data != null) {
1813	                            val list = result.data.list ?: break
1814	                            if (list.isEmpty()) break
1815	                            
1816	                            list.forEach { user -> allMids.add(user.mid) }
1817	                            
1818	                            // 如果这一页不满50，说明已经获取完所有关注
1819	                            if (list.size < 50) {
1820	                                com.android.purebilibili.core.util.Logger.d("HomeVM", " Reached end at page $page, total: ${allMids.size}")
1821	                                break
1822	                            }
1823	                            page++
1824	                        } else {
1825	                            break
1826	                        }
1827	                    } catch (e: Exception) {
1828	                        com.android.purebilibili.core.util.Logger.e("HomeVM", " Error at page $page", e)
1829	                        break
1830	                    }
1831	                }
1832	            }
1833	            
1834	            //  保存到本地缓存
1835	            prefs.edit()
1836	                .putStringSet(cacheKey, allMids.map { it.toString() }.toSet())
1837	                .putLong(cacheTimeKey, System.currentTimeMillis())
1838	                .apply()
1839	            
1840	            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(followingMids = allMids.toImmutableSet())
1841	            com.android.purebilibili.core.util.Logger.d("HomeVM", " Total following mids fetched and cached: ${allMids.size}")
1842	        } catch (e: Exception) {
1843	            com.android.purebilibili.core.util.Logger.e("HomeVM", " Error fetching following list", e)
1844	        }
1845	    }
1846

1851	        } catch (e: Exception) {

1854	        }

150	    return if (screenWidthDp < 360) 2 else 3
151	}

153	internal enum class ProfileWallpaperActionLabelMode {
154	    SINGLE_LINE,
155	    TWO_LINE
156	}
157	
158	internal fun resolveProfileWallpaperActionLabelMode(
159	    screenWidthDp: Int,
160	    columnCount: Int
161	): ProfileWallpaperActionLabelMode {
162	    return if (columnCount == 3 && screenWidthDp in 360 until 430) {
163	        ProfileWallpaperActionLabelMode.TWO_LINE
164	    } else {
165	        ProfileWallpaperActionLabelMode.SINGLE_LINE
166	    }
167	}
168	
169	internal fun resolveProfileWallpaperActionTitleLines(
170	    title: String,
171	    labelMode: ProfileWallpaperActionLabelMode
172	): List<String> {
173	    if (labelMode == ProfileWallpaperActionLabelMode.SINGLE_LINE || title.length <= 2) {
174	        return listOf(title)
175	    }
176	    return listOf(title.take(2), title.drop(2))
177	}

180	    return 196f
181	}

183	internal fun resolveProfileWallpaperDecodeSizePx(screenWidthDp: Int, density: Float): Pair<Int, Int> {
184	    val widthPx = (screenWidthDp.coerceAtLeast(320) * density)
185	        .toInt()
186	        .coerceIn(720, 1440)
187	    return widthPx to (widthPx * 16 / 9).coerceAtLeast(1280)
188	}

191	    headerBlurEnabled: Boolean,

129	fun Modifier.shimmer(
130	    durationMillis: Int = 1500,  //  [优化] 稍微放慢动画速度，更显优雅 (1000 -> 1500)
131	    delayMillis: Int = 0
132	): Modifier = composed {

135	    val highlightColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface
136	    
137	    // [优化] 更柔和的渐变色阶

139	        baseColor,
140	        baseColor,
141	        highlightColor.copy(alpha = 0.2f),
142	        highlightColor.copy(alpha = 0.6f),
143	        highlightColor.copy(alpha = 0.2f),
144	        baseColor,
145	        baseColor
146	    )
147	    
148	    val transition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "shimmer")
149	    val translateAnim by transition.animateFloat(
150	        initialValue = -1000f,  // [优化] 扩大起始范围
151	        targetValue = 2000f,    // [优化] 扩大结束范围
152	        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
153	            animation = tween(
154	                durationMillis = durationMillis,
155	                delayMillis = delayMillis,
156	                easing = LinearOutSlowInEasing  //  [优化] 使用更自然的缓动
157	            ),
158	            repeatMode = RepeatMode.Restart
159	        ),
160	        label = "shimmer_translate"
161	    )
162	    
163	    background(
164	        brush = Brush.linearGradient(
165	            colors = shimmerColors,
166	            start = Offset(translateAnim, translateAnim * 0.3f),      // [优化] 调整倾斜角度

389	private data class HslColorModel(
390	    val hue: Float,
391	    val saturation: Float,
392	    val lightness: Float
393	)
394	
395	private fun Color.toHslColorModel(): HslColorModel {
396	    val red = red
397	    val green = green
398	    val blue = blue
399	    val max = maxOf(red, green, blue)
400	    val min = minOf(red, green, blue)
401	    val delta = max - min
402	    val lightness = (max + min) / 2f
403	
404	    val saturation = if (delta == 0f) {
405	        0f
406	    } else {
407	        delta / (1f - kotlin.math.abs(2f * lightness - 1f))
408	    }
409	
410	    val hue = when {
411	        delta == 0f -> 0f
412	        max == red -> 60f * positiveModulo((green - blue) / delta, 6f)
413	        max == green -> 60f * (((blue - red) / delta) + 2f)
414	        else -> 60f * (((red - green) / delta) + 4f)
415	    }
416	
417	    return HslColorModel(
418	        hue = normalizeHue(hue),
419	        saturation = saturation.coerceIn(0f, 1f),
420	        lightness = lightness.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
421	    )
422	}
423	
424	private fun normalizeHue(hue: Float): Float {
425	    val value = hue % 360f
426	    return if (value < 0f) value + 360f else value
427	}
428	
429	private fun positiveModulo(value: Float, modulus: Float): Float {
430	    val result = value % modulus
431	    return if (result < 0f) result + modulus else result
432	}
433	
434	private fun colorFromHsl(
435	    hue: Float,
436	    saturation: Float,
437	    lightness: Float
438	): Color {
439	    val normalizedHue = normalizeHue(hue)
440	    val normalizedSaturation = saturation.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
441	    val normalizedLightness = lightness.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
442	    val chroma = (1f - kotlin.math.abs(2f * normalizedLightness - 1f)) * normalizedSaturation
443	    val huePrime = normalizedHue / 60f
444	    val secondComponent = chroma * (1f - kotlin.math.abs(positiveModulo(huePrime, 2f) - 1f))
445	    val match = normalizedLightness - chroma / 2f
446	
447	    val (redPrime, greenPrime, bluePrime) = when {
448	        huePrime < 1f -> Triple(chroma, secondComponent, 0f)
449	        huePrime < 2f -> Triple(secondComponent, chroma, 0f)
450	        huePrime < 3f -> Triple(0f, chroma, secondComponent)
451	        huePrime < 4f -> Triple(0f, secondComponent, chroma)
452	        huePrime < 5f -> Triple(secondComponent, 0f, chroma)
453	        else -> Triple(chroma, 0f, secondComponent)
454	    }
455	
456	    return Color(
457	        redPrime + match,
458	        greenPrime + match,
459	        bluePrime + match,
460	        1f,
461	        ColorSpaces.Srgb
462	    )
463	}
464	
465	private fun blendColors(
466	    background: Color,
467	    foreground: Color,
468	    foregroundRatio: Float
469	): Color {
470	    val ratio = foregroundRatio.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
471	    val inverse = 1f - ratio
472	    return Color(
473	        background.red * inverse + foreground.red * ratio,
474	        background.green * inverse + foreground.green * ratio,
475	        background.blue * inverse + foreground.blue * ratio,
476	        background.alpha * inverse + foreground.alpha * ratio,
477	        ColorSpaces.Srgb
478	    )
479	}

486	    }
487	}

643	internal fun alignStaticColorSchemeWithThemePrimary(
644	    scheme: ColorScheme,
645	    themePrimaryColor: Color,
646	    darkTheme: Boolean
647	): ColorScheme {
648	    val primary = themePrimaryColor
649	    val primaryContainer = blendColors(
650	        background = scheme.background,
651	        foreground = primary,
652	        foregroundRatio = if (darkTheme) 0.34f else 0.18f
653	    )
654	    return scheme.copy(
655	        primary = primary,
656	        onPrimary = chooseReadableOnColor(primary),
657	        primaryContainer = primaryContainer,
658	        onPrimaryContainer = chooseReadableOnColor(primaryContainer)
659	    )
660	}

674	@Composable
675	private fun rememberSystemWallpaperRefreshToken(
676	    dynamicColorActive: Boolean
677	): Int {
678	    val context = LocalContext.current
679	    var token by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
680	    val shouldObserve = shouldObserveSystemWallpaperForDynamicColor(
681	        dynamicColorActive = dynamicColorActive,
682	        sdkInt = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT
683	    )
684	
685	    DisposableEffect(context, shouldObserve) {
686	        if (!shouldObserve) {
687	            return@DisposableEffect onDispose { }
688	        }
689	        val wallpaperManager = WallpaperManager.getInstance(context)
690	        val listener = WallpaperManager.OnColorsChangedListener { _, _ ->
691	            token += 1
692	        }
693	        wallpaperManager.addOnColorsChangedListener(
694	            listener,
695	            Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
696	        )
697	        onDispose {
698	            wallpaperManager.removeOnColorsChangedListener(listener)
699	        }
700	    }
701	
702	    return token
703	}
704	
705	@Composable
706	private fun rememberIosColorScheme(
707	    seedColor: Color,
708	    darkTheme: Boolean,
709	    amoledDarkTheme: Boolean,
710	    dynamicAccentScheme: ColorScheme? = null
711	): ColorScheme {
712	    val baseScheme = remember(seedColor, darkTheme, amoledDarkTheme) {
713	        createIosColorScheme(
714	            primaryColor = seedColor,
715	            darkTheme = darkTheme,
716	            amoledDarkTheme = amoledDarkTheme
717	        )
718	    }
719	    return remember(baseScheme, dynamicAccentScheme) {
720	        if (dynamicAccentScheme != null) {
721	            alignIosColorSchemeWithDynamicAccent(
722	                baseScheme = baseScheme,
723	                dynamicAccentScheme = dynamicAccentScheme
724	            )
725	        } else {
726	            baseScheme
727	        }
728	    }
729	}

736	    paletteStyle: PaletteStyle,
737	    colorSpec: ColorSpec.SpecVersion,

744	            isAmoled = amoledDarkTheme,
745	            style = paletteStyle,
746	            specVersion = colorSpec,
747	            primary = dynamicBaseScheme.primary,
748	            secondary = dynamicBaseScheme.secondary,
749	            tertiary = dynamicBaseScheme.tertiary,
750	            neutral = dynamicBaseScheme.surface,
751	            neutralVariant = dynamicBaseScheme.surfaceVariant,
752	            error = dynamicBaseScheme.error
753	        )
754	    } else {
755	        rememberDynamicColorScheme(
756	            seedColor = seedColor,
757	            isDark = darkTheme,
758	            isAmoled = amoledDarkTheme,
759	            style = paletteStyle,
760	            specVersion = colorSpec
761	        )
762	    }
763	
764	    val readableScheme = if (!darkTheme) {
765	        enforceDynamicLightTextContrast(scheme)

773	            darkTheme = darkTheme
774	        )
775	    } else {

777	    }

780	@Composable
781	fun PureBiliBiliTheme(
782	    uiPreset: UiPreset = UiPreset.IOS,
783	    androidNativeVariant: AndroidNativeVariant = AndroidNativeVariant.MATERIAL3,
784	    themeMode: AppThemeMode = AppThemeMode.FOLLOW_SYSTEM,
785	    darkTheme: Boolean = isSystemInDarkTheme(),
786	    dynamicColor: Boolean = false,
787	    amoledDarkTheme: Boolean = false,
788	    themeColorIndex: Int = 0, //  默认 0 = iOS 蓝色
789	    md3ColorSource: Md3ColorSource = if (dynamicColor) {
790	        Md3ColorSource.FOLLOW_WALLPAPER
791	    } else {
792	        Md3ColorSource.CUSTOM
793	    },
794	    md3CustomColorHex: String = "#007AFF",
795	    themeRoleOverrides: ThemeRoleOverrides = ThemeRoleOverrides(),
796	    colorStyle: PaletteStyle = PaletteStyle.TonalSpot,
797	    colorSpec: ColorSpec.SpecVersion = ColorSpec.SpecVersion.SPEC_2021,
798	    fontSizePreset: AppFontSizePreset = AppFontSizePreset.DEFAULT,
799	    appFontFileName: String = "",
800	    content: @Composable () -> Unit
801	) {
802	    val context = LocalContext.current
803	    
804	    //  获取 MD3 主题种子色。跟随壁纸时仍保留旧预设色作为非 S 设备后备。
805	    val customPrimaryColor = resolveMd3ThemeSeedColor(
806	        source = md3ColorSource,
807	        customColorHex = md3CustomColorHex,
808	        themeColorIndex = themeColorIndex
809	    )
810	
811	    val isDynamicColorActive = resolveEffectiveDynamicColorEnabled(
812	        dynamicColorEnabled = resolveMd3DynamicColorEnabled(
813	            source = md3ColorSource,
814	            sdkInt = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT
815	        ),
816	        amoledDarkTheme = amoledDarkTheme,
817	        uiPreset = uiPreset
818	    )
819	    val shapes = resolveMaterialShapes(uiPreset, androidNativeVariant)
820	    val appFontFamily = remember(context, appFontFileName) {
821	        loadStoredAppFontFamily(context, appFontFileName)
822	    }
823	    val materialTypography = resolveMaterialTypography(
824	        uiPreset = uiPreset,
825	        androidNativeVariant = androidNativeVariant
826	    ).scaled(fontSizePreset.multiplier)
827	        .withFontFamily(appFontFamily)
828	    val materialMotionScheme = remember(uiPreset, androidNativeVariant) {
829	        resolveMaterialMotionScheme(uiPreset, androidNativeVariant)
830	    }
831	    val miuixTextStyles = remember(fontSizePreset, appFontFamily) {
832	        defaultTextStyles()
833	            .scaled(fontSizePreset.multiplier)
834	            .withFontFamily(appFontFamily)
835	    }
836	    val systemWallpaperRefreshToken = rememberSystemWallpaperRefreshToken(isDynamicColorActive)
837	    val dynamicLightBaseScheme = if (isDynamicColorActive) {
838	        key(systemWallpaperRefreshToken) {
839	            dynamicLightColorScheme(context)
840	        }
841	    } else {
842	        null
843	    }
844	    val dynamicDarkBaseScheme = if (isDynamicColorActive) {
845	        key(systemWallpaperRefreshToken) {
846	            dynamicDarkColorScheme(context)
847	        }
848	    } else {
849	        null
850	    }
851	    val lightMaterialScheme = if (uiPreset == UiPreset.IOS) {
852	        rememberIosColorScheme(
853	            seedColor = customPrimaryColor,
854	            darkTheme = false,
855	            amoledDarkTheme = false,
856	            dynamicAccentScheme = dynamicLightBaseScheme
857	        )
858	    } else {
859	        rememberKernelSuStyleColorScheme(
860	            seedColor = customPrimaryColor,
861	            darkTheme = false,
862	            amoledDarkTheme = false,
863	            paletteStyle = colorStyle,
864	            colorSpec = colorSpec,
865	            dynamicBaseScheme = dynamicLightBaseScheme
866	        )
867	    }
868	    val darkMaterialScheme = if (uiPreset == UiPreset.IOS) {
869	        rememberIosColorScheme(
870	            seedColor = customPrimaryColor,
871	            darkTheme = true,
872	            amoledDarkTheme = amoledDarkTheme,
873	            dynamicAccentScheme = dynamicDarkBaseScheme
874	        )
875	    } else {
876	        rememberKernelSuStyleColorScheme(
877	            seedColor = customPrimaryColor,
878	            darkTheme = true,
879	            amoledDarkTheme = amoledDarkTheme,
880	            paletteStyle = colorStyle,
881	            colorSpec = colorSpec,
882	            dynamicBaseScheme = dynamicDarkBaseScheme
883	        )
884	    }
885	
886	    val resolvedLightMaterialScheme = remember(lightMaterialScheme, themeRoleOverrides) {
887	        applyThemeRoleOverrides(lightMaterialScheme, themeRoleOverrides, darkTheme = false)
888	    }
889	    val resolvedDarkMaterialScheme = remember(darkMaterialScheme, themeRoleOverrides) {
890	        applyThemeRoleOverrides(darkMaterialScheme, themeRoleOverrides, darkTheme = true)
891	    }
892	    val baseThemeRoleOverrides = remember(lightMaterialScheme, darkMaterialScheme) {
893	        themeRoleOverridesFromSchemes(
894	            lightScheme = lightMaterialScheme,
895	            darkScheme = darkMaterialScheme
896	        )
897	    }
898	    val staticMaterialScheme = if (darkTheme) resolvedDarkMaterialScheme else resolvedLightMaterialScheme
899	    val miuixLightColors = remember(resolvedLightMaterialScheme) {
900	        resolveMiuixColorsFromMaterialBridge(
901	            bridge = createMiuixMaterialBridge(resolvedLightMaterialScheme),
902	            darkTheme = false
903	        )
904	    }
905	    val miuixDarkColors = remember(resolvedDarkMaterialScheme) {
906	        resolveMiuixColorsFromMaterialBridge(
907	            bridge = createMiuixMaterialBridge(resolvedDarkMaterialScheme),
908	            darkTheme = true
909	        )
910	    }
911	    val controller = remember(
912	        themeMode,
913	        dynamicColor,
914	        darkTheme,
915	        customPrimaryColor,
916	        themeRoleOverrides,
917	        amoledDarkTheme,
918	        colorStyle,
919	        colorSpec,
920	        systemWallpaperRefreshToken,
921	        miuixLightColors,
922	        miuixDarkColors
923	    ) {
924	        ThemeController(
925	            colorSchemeMode = resolveMiuixColorSchemeMode(
926	                themeMode = themeMode,
927	                dynamicColorEnabled = dynamicColor
928	            ),
929	            lightColors = miuixLightColors,
930	            darkColors = miuixDarkColors,
931	            isDark = darkTheme
932	        )
933	    }
934	    val materialColorScheme = staticMaterialScheme
935	
936	    //  [新增] 动态设置状态栏图标颜色
937	    val view = LocalView.current
938	    if (!view.isInEditMode) {
939	        SideEffect {
940	            val window = (view.context as Activity).window
941	            // 设置状态栏图标颜色：
942	            // - 深色模式：使用浅色图标 (isAppearanceLightStatusBars = false)
943	            // - 浅色模式：使用深色图标 (isAppearanceLightStatusBars = true)
944	            WindowCompat.getInsetsController(window, view).isAppearanceLightStatusBars = !darkTheme
945	        }
946	    }
947	
948	    CompositionLocalProvider(
949	        LocalUiPreset provides uiPreset,
950	        LocalAndroidNativeVariant provides androidNativeVariant,
951	        LocalDynamicColorActive provides isDynamicColorActive,
952	        LocalBaseThemeRoleOverrides provides baseThemeRoleOverrides,
953	        LocalCornerRadiusScale provides resolveCornerRadiusScale(
954	            uiPreset = uiPreset,
955	            androidNativeVariant = androidNativeVariant
956	        )
957	    ) {
958	        MiuixTheme(
959	            controller = controller,
960	            textStyles = miuixTextStyles
961	        ) {
962	            MaterialTheme(
963	                colorScheme = materialColorScheme,
964	                typography = materialTypography,
965	                shapes = shapes,
966	                motionScheme = materialMotionScheme,
967	                content = content
968	            )
969	        }
970	    }
971	}
972

17	enum class BlurIntensity {

19	    THICK,       // 浓郁 - 背景透色 + 磨砂质感

27	 */
28	object BlurStyles {
29	    
30	    @OptIn(ExperimentalHazeMaterialsApi::class)
31	    @Composable
32	    fun getBlurStyle(intensity: BlurIntensity): HazeStyle {
33	        return when (resolveBlurHazeMaterial(intensity)) {
34	            BlurHazeMaterial.THIN -> HazeMaterials.thin()
35	            BlurHazeMaterial.ULTRA_THIN -> HazeMaterials.ultraThin()
36	            BlurHazeMaterial.THICK -> HazeMaterials.thick()
37	        }
38	    }
39	
40	    @OptIn(ExperimentalHazeMaterialsApi::class)
41	    @Composable
42	    fun getBlurStyle(
43	        intensity: BlurIntensity,
44	        budget: BlurBudget?
45	    ): HazeStyle {
46	        val effectiveIntensity = if (budget != null) {
47	            resolveBudgetedBlurIntensity(intensity, budget)
48	        } else {
49	            intensity
50	        }
51	        return getBlurStyle(effectiveIntensity)
52	    }
53	    
54	    fun getBackgroundAlpha(intensity: BlurIntensity): Float {
55	        return resolveBlurBackgroundAlpha(intensity)
56	    }
57	
58	    fun getBackgroundAlpha(
59	        intensity: BlurIntensity,
60	        budget: BlurBudget?
61	    ): Float {
62	        val effectiveIntensity = if (budget != null) {
63	            resolveBudgetedBlurIntensity(intensity, budget)
64	        } else {
65	            intensity
66	        }
67	        val alpha = getBackgroundAlpha(effectiveIntensity)

25	internal fun resolveUnifiedBlurIntensity(

32	internal fun resolveUnifiedBlurredEdgeTreatment(shape: Shape?): BlurredEdgeTreatment {
33	    return if (shape != null) {
34	        BlurredEdgeTreatment(shape)
35	    } else {
36	        BlurredEdgeTreatment.Rectangle
37	    }
38	}
39	
40	@Composable

42	    content: @Composable () -> Unit
43	) {
44	    val context = LocalContext.current
45	    val blurIntensity by SettingsManager.getBlurIntensity(context)
46	        .collectAsStateWithLifecycle(initialValue = BlurIntensity.THIN)
47	    CompositionLocalProvider(
48	        LocalUnifiedBlurIntensity provides blurIntensity,
49	        content = content
50	    )
51	}
52	
53	@Composable
54	fun currentUnifiedBlurIntensity(): BlurIntensity {
55	    val providedBlurIntensity = LocalUnifiedBlurIntensity.current
56	    if (providedBlurIntensity != null) {
57	        return providedBlurIntensity
58	    }
59	
60	    val context = LocalContext.current
61	    val fallbackBlurIntensity by SettingsManager.getBlurIntensity(context)
62	        .collectAsStateWithLifecycle(initialValue = BlurIntensity.THIN)
63	    return fallbackBlurIntensity
64	}
