```json
66	/**
67	 *  统一的模糊Modifier
68	 * 
69	 * 自动根据用户设置选择模糊强度
70	 * 
71	 * @param hazeState Haze状态
72	 * @param enabled 是否启用模糊
73	 * @return 应用了用户偏好模糊的Modifier
74	 */
75	@Composable
76	fun Modifier.unifiedBlur(
77	    hazeState: HazeState,
78	    enabled: Boolean = true,
79	    shape: androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Shape? = null,
80	    surfaceType: BlurSurfaceType = BlurSurfaceType.GENERIC,
81	    motionTier: MotionTier = MotionTier.Normal,
82	    isScrolling: Boolean = false,
83	    isTransitionRunning: Boolean = false,
84	    forceLowBudget: Boolean = false
85	): Modifier = composed {
86	    if (!enabled) return@composed this
87	    if (!shouldAllowRuntimeShaderBackedHazeEffect(Build.VERSION.SDK_INT)) return@composed this
88	
89	    val blurIntensity = currentUnifiedBlurIntensity()
90	    val budget = resolveBlurBudget(
91	        surfaceType = surfaceType,
92	        motionTier = motionTier,
93	        isScrolling = isScrolling,
94	        isTransitionRunning = isTransitionRunning,
95	        forceLowBudget = forceLowBudget
96	    )
97	    
98	    // 根据用户选择获取对应的模糊样式
99	    val blurStyle = BlurStyles.getBlurStyle(blurIntensity, budget)
100	    
101	    //  [修复] HazeEffect 不支持 shape 参数，需使用 clip 修饰符
102	    //  仅当提供了 shape 时才应用 clip，避免破坏现有圆角组件 (如 BottomBar)
103	    if (shape != null) {
104	        this.clip(shape)
105	    } else {
106	        this
107	    }.hazeEffect(
108	        state = hazeState,
109	        style = blurStyle
110	    ) {
111	        blurEnabled = true
112	        blurredEdgeTreatment = resolveUnifiedBlurredEdgeTreatment(shape)
113	        @OptIn(ExperimentalHazeApi::class)
114	        run {
115	            val inputScaleFactor = resolveBlurInputScale(
116	                budget = budget,
117	                surfaceType = surfaceType
118	            )
119	            inputScale = if (inputScaleFactor >= 1f) {
120	                HazeInputScale.None
121	            } else {
122	                HazeInputScale.Fixed(inputScaleFactor)
123	            }
124	        }
125	    }
126	}
```

```json
47	        ContainerLevel.Card -> 12f
48	        ContainerLevel.Dialog -> 14f

54	    fun resolveContainerCornerDp(

60	            return resolveAndroidNativeChromeTokens(uiPreset, androidNativeVariant)
61	                .pillCornerRadiusDp.dp
62	        }
63	        val scale = resolveCornerRadiusScale(uiPreset, androidNativeVariant)
64	        return (baseDp(level) * scale).dp
65	    }
66	
67	    fun resolveContainerShape(
68	        level: ContainerLevel,
69	        uiPreset: UiPreset,
70	        androidNativeVariant: AndroidNativeVariant
71	    ): Shape {
72	        val dp = resolveContainerCornerDp(level, uiPreset, androidNativeVariant)
73	        return if (shouldUseIosContinuousRounding(uiPreset)) {

80	                )
81	            } else {

83	            }
```

```json
728	): Modifier = composed {
729	    val isGlassEnabled = renderMode == HomeTopChromeRenderMode.LIQUID_GLASS_BACKDROP ||
730	        renderMode == HomeTopChromeRenderMode.LIQUID_GLASS_HAZE
731	    val isBlurEnabled = renderMode != HomeTopChromeRenderMode.PLAIN
732	    val blurIntensity = currentUnifiedBlurIntensity()
733	    val isDarkTheme = resolveBottomBarDarkTheme(AppSurfaceTokens.chromeBackground())

736	        darkTheme = isDarkTheme
737	    )

742	        glassEnabled = isGlassEnabled,
743	        blurEnabled = isBlurEnabled,

745	        liquidGlassPreset = liquidGlassPreset
746	    )
```

```json
1	package com.android.purebilibili.feature.home
2	
3	import com.android.purebilibili.core.store.HomeFeedCardWidthPreset
4	
5	internal fun resolveHomeFeedGridColumns(
6	    contentWidthDp: Int,
7	    displayMode: Int,
8	    fixedColumnCount: Int,
9	    cardWidthPreset: HomeFeedCardWidthPreset
10	): Int {
11	    val isSingleColumnMode = displayMode == 1
12	    if (!isSingleColumnMode && fixedColumnCount > 0) {
13	        return fixedColumnCount
14	    }
15	
16	    val minColumnWidthDp = if (isSingleColumnMode) {
17	        280
18	    } else {
19	        cardWidthPreset.minCardWidthDp ?: 180
20	    }
21	    val maxColumns = if (isSingleColumnMode) 2 else 6
22	    val columns = contentWidthDp / minColumnWidthDp
23	    val minColumns = if (!isSingleColumnMode && contentWidthDp >= 300) 2 else 1
24	    return columns.coerceIn(minColumns, maxColumns)
25	}
26
```

Actually, I want to use a simpler approach for the build system. For a Compose Multiplatform Desktop project, I can use the `org.jetbrains.compose` Gradle plugin directly. Let me check the exact syntax.

For a desktop-only project:
```kotlin
plugins {
    kotlin("jvm") version "2.0.21"
    id("org.jetbrains.compose") version "1.7.1"
    id("org.jetbrains.kotlin.plugin.compose") version "2.0.21"
}

repositories {
    mavenCentral()
    google()
    maven("https://maven.pkg.jetbrains.space/com/p/compose/dev")
}

dependencies {
    implementation(compose.desktop.currentOs)
    implementation(compose.material3)
    implementation(compose.foundation)
    implementation(compose.animation)
    implementation("dev.chrisbanes.haze:haze:1.0.2")
    implementation("org.jetbrains.compose.material:material-icons-extended:1.7.1")
}

compose.desktop {
    application {
        mainClass = "com.winwin.MainKt"
        nativeDistributions {
            targetFormats(org.jetbrains.compose.desktop.application.dsl.TargetFormat.Msi, org.jetbrains.compose.desktop.application.dsl.TargetFormat.Dmg)
            packageName = "WinWin"
            packageVersion = "1.0.0"
            windows {
                menuGroup = "WinWin"
                upgradeUuid = "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890"
            }
        }
    }
}
```

Actually, I need to be more careful with the dependency coordinates. In Compose Multiplatform, the `compose` extension provides:

- `compose.material3` - Material 3
- `compose.foundation` - Foundation
- `compose.runtime` - Runtime
- `compose.animation` - Animation
- `compose.ui` - UI

For material icons, I can use:

```kotlin
implementation("org.jetbrains.compose.material:material-icons-extended:${compose.version}")
```

or just use the compose extension:

```kotlin
implementation(compose.materialIconsExtended)
```

Actually, I need to be more careful. The `application` function is:
```kotlin
fun application(content: @Composable ApplicationScope.() -> Unit)
```

And `ApplicationScope` has:
```kotlin
fun exitApplication()
```

So `::exitApplication` references `ApplicationScope::exitApplication`. But in Kotlin, you can use `::exitApplication` only if it's in scope. Since the lambda has `ApplicationScope` as receiver, `this::exitApplication` works, but `::exitApplication` might not.

The correct way is:
```kotlin
fun main() = application {
    Window(
        onCloseRequest = ::exitApplication,
        title = "WinWin",
    ) {
        // content
    }
}
```

Where `::exitApplication` is `this::exitApplication` because the lambda has `ApplicationScope` as receiver. This should work.

```kotlin
}
```

Actually, I realize I need to think more carefully about the Haze integration. In Haze, the `hazeSource` marks a composable as the content that will be blurred. The `hazeEffect` is applied on a composable that is ON TOP of the source (overlapping it). So the structure needs to be:

1. Content area is marked with `hazeSource(hazeState)`
2. Top bar and bottom bar, which are on top of the content, use `hazeEffect(hazeState)`

The key is that the top bar and bottom bar must be visually overlapping the content for the blur to work.

Let me structure it like:

```kotlin

            .fillMaxSize()

    ) {
        // Home feed or Profile content

    Surface(
        Modifier

    ) {
        // Top bar content
    }
    
    // Bottom bar — blur consumer
    Surface(
        Modifier
            .hazeEffect(hazeState, style = HazeMaterials.thin())
    ) {
        // Bottom bar content
    }
}
```

This is the correct structure for Haze to work. The content is the source, and the bars are consumers that blur the content behind them.


But these flags are for Maven, not for the Gradle wrapper download. The SSL issue is with the Gradle wrapper trying to download the Gradle distribution from `services.gradle.org`.

There are a few approaches to fix this:
1. Set `javax.net.ssl.trustStore` to a custom trust store that includes the Gradle SSL certificate
2. Set `javax.net.ssl.trustAll=true` (but this is a JVM flag, not a Gradle flag)
3. Download the Gradle distribution manually and place it in the expected location
4. Use an already-downloaded Gradle distribution if one exists somewhere on the system

## 技术验证结论

项目已在 `D:\Documents\GitHub\WinWin` 创建并成功构建。三个 commit 记录了完整的验证过程。

### 已验证的技术栈

| 组件 | 版本 | 状态 |
|---|---|---|
| Kotlin | 2.0.21 | 编译通过 |
| Compose Multiplatform | 1.7.1 | 编译通过 |
| Material 3 | (随 CMP 1.7.1) | 组件全部可用 |
| Haze 毛玻璃 | 1.0.2 | `haze()`/`hazeChild()` API 可用 |
| Gradle | 8.13 | 构建通过 |

### 已实现的页面

**首页（Home）** — 浮动顶部栏（头像 + 搜索药丸 + 设置图标）、可滚动分类标签行（推荐/关注/热门/影视/知识/游戏/科技）、双列视频卡片网格（4:3 封面 + 播放量/弹幕数徽章 + 时长 + 标题 + UP 主头像/名称 + 会员角标）。

**我的（Profile）** — 渐变壁纸背景、用户信息卡片（72dp 头像 + 用户名 + 等级徽章 + 大会员标识）、四列统计数据行（动态/关注/粉丝/硬币）、iOS 风格设置列表（离线缓存/历史记录/我的收藏/稍后再看/消息中心/账号切换）。

**底部导航栏** — 浮动药丸形状、5 个导航项（首页/动态/历史/听视频/我的）、每项独立颜色（iOS Blue/Orange/Teal/Pink/Green）、按下缩放动画。

**Haze 毛玻璃** — 底部导航栏通过 `hazeChild(hazeState, HazeMaterials.thin())` 实现毛玻璃模糊，内容区域通过 `haze(hazeState)` 注册为模糊源。

### 关键发现

Haze 1.0.2 的 API 是 `haze()`/`hazeChild()`（旧名称），而非 `hazeSource()`/`hazeEffect()`（新名称）。新 API 在 Haze 1.7.2 中可用，但 1.7.2 要求 Kotlin 2.2.0+，与 Compose Multiplatform 1.7.1（Kotlin 2.0.21）不兼容。如果需要新版 API，需要升级到 Kotlin 2.2.0 + Compose Multiplatform 1.7.3+。

腾讯镜像（`mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/gradle`）下载速度 24MB/s，对比 GitHub 直连 6KB/s 和 gh-proxy 42KB/s，是从中国网络环境获取 Gradle 发行版的最佳选择。

### 项目结构

17 个源文件，约 1,900 行 Kotlin 代码，按 BiliPai 原项目的架构模式组织：`theme/`（设计令牌）、`model/`（数据模型 + Mock 数据）、`ui/components/`（共享组件）、`ui/home/`（首页）、`ui/profile/`（我的页面）。

---

## 三个值得考虑的方向

**WinUI 3 + C#/.NET** 仍然是最直接的 Windows 原生选择。你在 MoePlayer 中已经验证了 libmpv 集成、HWND 分层管理、Composition 模糊效果这条完整路径。BiliPai 的毛玻璃、液态玻璃、Mica 背景、弹幕渲染管线在 WinUI 3 上都有原生 API 支撑——Composition EffectBrush 做 GPU 高斯模糊、Direct2D Pixel Shader 做透镜折射、Win2D 做弹幕 Canvas 渲染、SMTC 做系统媒体控制、CompactOverlay 做画中画。这些在 Compose Multiplatform Desktop 上要么缺失要么需要自建。代价是全部 Kotlin 业务逻辑需要翻译到 C#，UI 层需要从 Compose 重写为 XAML。

**WPF + C#/.NET** 是一个容易被忽略的老牌选项。虽然 WinUI 3 是微软主推的新一代 UI 框架，但 WPF 在某些方面仍然有优势：控件库更成熟、社区资源更丰富、自定义渲染更灵活（`DrawingVisual` + `RenderTargetBitmap` 可以做任意自绘）、`VisualBrush` 可以实现实时模糊和反射效果。WPF 的 `BlurEffect` 和 `DropShadowEffect` 在桌面端表现稳定。对于弹幕渲染，WPF 的 `WriteableBitmap` + `D3DImage` 互操作可以接入 Direct3D 做高性能渲染。缺点是 XAML 引擎较老（不支持 Fluent Design 的 Mica/Acrylic）、窗口管理 API 不如 WinUI 3 现代。如果你不需要 Mica 背景和系统级亚克力效果，WPF 的开发体验其实比 WinUI 3 更顺滑——尤其是 `Effect` 链式叠加和 `ShaderEffect` 自定义着色器。

**Qt 6 + QML（C++ 或 Python 绑定）** 是另一个值得审视的选项。QML 是声明式 UI 语言，与 Compose 的声明式范式高度相似——属性绑定、组件组合、动画状态机都是核心概念。Qt 的 `QQuickPaintedItem` 可以用 QPainter 做自定义 Canvas 渲染（弹幕、Squircle 形状），`QGraphicsBlurEffect` 做实时模糊，`QOpenGLWidget` 接入 GPU 渲染管线。Qt 的渲染后端在 Windows 上走 Direct3D 11 或 OpenGL，性能足够处理大量弹幕。最大的优势是 Qt 的 `QMediaPlayer` 基于 FFmpeg，原生支持 DASH/HLS 流媒体——Bilibili 的分离音视频流可以直接处理，不需要额外集成 libmpv。代价是语言换型（Kotlin → C++ 或 Python），且 Qt 的商业授权需要评估。

---

## 一个你可能没考虑过的方向

**Kotlin/JVM + Compose Desktop（非 Multiplatform）** 实际上是一个折中选项。如果你不用 Compose Multiplatform 的跨平台能力，但仍然想用 Kotlin 和 Compose，可以直接用 `org.jetbrains.compose` 插件的 Desktop only 模式——这和我们刚做的 WinWin spike 是同一个技术栈，只是不需要 KMP 的 common/desktop 分层。好处是 BiliPai 的全部 Kotlin 业务逻辑可以几乎原样搬过来（前面分析的第一档和第二档代码），UI 层的 Compose 代码也能大量复用。坏处是 Skiko 渲染后端在 Windows 上不如 Direct2D 原生——毛玻璃需要 Haze 库（我们已验证可行），但 Mica、系统亚克力、SMTC、CompactOverlay 这些 Windows 原生 API 都没有现成绑定。

---

## 如果让我在这个条件下推荐

不考虑跨平台，视觉还原度优先：**WinUI 3**。原因是 BiliPai 的视觉识别度建立在 Composition API 级别的效果上——毛玻璃预算策略、液态玻璃透镜折射、BlurIntensityVisualPolicy 这些在 WinUI 3 上有直接的 Composition API 对应物。你在 MoePlayer 中已经写过这套渲染管线，迁移成本可控。Haze 库虽然验证了在 Compose Desktop 上可行，但 Mica 背景和系统级亚克力效果是 Windows 独有的，Compose Desktop 拿不到。

不考虑跨平台，开发效率优先（最大化代码复用）：**Compose Desktop（JVM）**。BiliPai 65-70% 的业务逻辑可以原样保留，UI 层大量复用，我们刚验证过的 WinWin spike 证明了构建链路可行。代价是放弃 Mica 和系统级效果，需要用 Haze 补齐毛玻璃。

不考虑跨平台，渲染性能优先（弹幕密集场景）：**Qt 6 + QML**。QML 的声明式 UI 与 Compose 概念对齐，Qt 的 FFmpeg 后端省去 libmpv 集成，Direct3D 渲染管线处理同屏大量弹幕的性能上限最高。但语言换型成本最大。

### **You**

Flutter架构可以用Haze依赖库实现材质效果吗？

### **Assistant**

#### Thinking

The user is asking whether Flutter can use the Haze library to implement material/glass effects. Let me think about this carefully.

The Haze library (`dev.chrisbanes.haze`) is specifically a **Jetpack Compose / Compose Multiplatform** library. It's built on top of Compose's rendering pipeline and uses Compose's `Modifier` system, `GraphicsLayer`, and platform-specific blur APIs (RenderEffect on Android, NSVisualEffectView on macOS, etc.).

Flutter has a completely different rendering pipeline (Skia/Impeller) and widget system. The Haze library cannot be used with Flutter because:

1. Haze is a Kotlin/Compose library — it's written in Kotlin and uses Compose APIs
2. Haze depends on Compose's `Modifier` system, `Composable` functions, and rendering tree
3. Flutter uses Dart and its own widget/rendering system

However, Flutter has its own equivalents for blur/glass effects:

1. **`BackdropFilter` + `ImageFilter.blur`** — Flutter's built-in API for frosted glass effects. This is the standard way to implement blur in Flutter. It works by capturing the content behind the `BackdropFilter` widget and applying a Gaussian blur.

2. **`frosted_glass` package** — A community package that wraps `BackdropFilter` with a more convenient API.

3. **`blur` package** — Another community package for blur effects.

4. **`ShaderMask` + FragmentShader** — For more advanced effects like liquid glass (refraction, highlights), Flutter supports custom GLSL fragment shaders via `FragmentShader`. This is the equivalent of what Haze's liquid glass effects do.

5. **`dart:ui` `BackdropFilter`** — The low-level API that `BackdropFilter` widget uses internally.

The key comparison:
- Compose Haze: `Modifier.haze(state)` / `Modifier.hazeChild(state, style)` — declarative blur with source/consumer pattern
- Flutter: `BackdropFilter(filter: ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX: 10, sigmaY: 10))` — widget-based blur

Flutter's `BackdropFilter` is actually quite capable:
- It blurs the content behind the widget in real-time
- It works on both mobile and desktop (Skia/Impeller)
- Performance is generally good (GPU-accelerated)
- Can be combined with `Container` with semi-transparent background for frosted glass look

For liquid glass effects (like BiliPai's Backdrop library), Flutter would need:
- Custom `FragmentShader` (GLSL) for refraction
- `CustomPainter` for the glass highlights
- `ShaderMask` for applying the shader to content

So the answer is: No, Flutter cannot use the Haze library (it's Compose-only), but Flutter has its own built-in `BackdropFilter` API that achieves the same frosted glass effect, and `FragmentShader` for advanced effects like liquid glass.

Let me also think about whether there are Flutter packages that specifically mimic what Haze does (the source/consumer pattern with intelligent blur management). 

Looking at the Flutter ecosystem:
- `BackdropFilter` is the built-in solution
- There's no direct equivalent to Haze's `HazeState` + source/consumer pattern in Flutter
- But you can achieve the same effect by wrapping content in a `BackdropFilter` widget

The main difference is that Haze provides a more declarative API where you mark a composable as a "source" and then apply blur "effects" on top, while in Flutter you directly use `BackdropFilter` as a widget in the tree.

Let me give a clear, concise answer.

不能。Haze 是纯 Compose 库——它的 `haze()`/`hazeChild()` 修饰符构建在 Compose 的 `Modifier` 系统和渲染树上，用 Kotlin 编写，依赖 Compose 的 `GraphicsLayer` 和平台原生模糊 API。Flutter 用的是完全不同的渲染管线（Skia/Impeller）和组件系统（Widget/Dart），无法跨框架调用。

但 Flutter 有自己的等价方案实现相同的视觉效果：

**毛玻璃**直接用内置的 `BackdropFilter`：

```dart
ClipRRect(
  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(28),
  child: BackdropFilter(
    filter: ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX: 15, sigmaY: 15),
    child: Container(
      color: Colors.white.withOpacity(0.72),
      child: yourContent,
    ),
  ),
)
```

这和 Haze 的 `hazeChild(state, HazeMaterials.thin())` 效果等价——实时捕获后方内容做高斯模糊，叠加半透明背景色。`BackdropFilter` 在桌面端走 Skia GPU 路径，性能足够处理导航栏和顶栏的实时模糊。

**液态玻璃**（折射+高光，对应 BiliPai 的 Backdrop 库效果）需要用 Flutter 的 `FragmentShader` 写 GLSL 着色器。Flutter 1.16+ 原生支持自定义片段着色器：

```glsl
// liquid_glass.frag
#include <flutter/runtime_effect.glsl>
uniform vec2 uResolution;
uniform sampler2D uContentTexture;
out vec4 fragColor;
void main() {
  vec2 uv = FlutterFragCoord().xy / uResolution;
  // 折射偏移
  vec2 offset = vec2(sin(uv.y * 20.0) * 0.005, 0.0);
  // 高光
  float highlight = smoothstep(0.0, 0.3, uv.y) * 0.3;
  fragColor = texture(uContentTexture, uv + offset) + vec4(highlight);
}
```

然后通过 `ShaderMask` 或 `CustomPaint` 应用。这和 WinUI 3 用 HLSL Pixel Shader 实现液态玻璃是同一条路线。

**与 Haze 的关键差异**：Haze 提供了一个 `HazeState` + source/consumer 模式——你在内容区域标记 `Modifier.haze(state)`，然后在导航栏上用 `Modifier.hazeChild(state)`，Haze 自动处理模糊源的捕获和渲染。Flutter 没有这种声明式的 source/consumer 抽象，`BackdropFilter` 是直接放在 Widget 树中的，它自己捕获身后内容做模糊，不需要显式标记模糊源。两种方式效果相同，Flutter 的方式实际上更简单直接。

总结：Haze 库本身不可用于 Flutter，但 `BackdropFilter` 能实现等效的毛玻璃效果，`FragmentShader` 能实现等效的液态玻璃效果。不需要额外的第三方库。

四个框架移植 BiliPai 的核心开发要点对比：

---

## 语言与代码复用

Compose Multiplatform 是唯一能直接保留 BiliPai 全部 Kotlin 业务逻辑（WBI 签名、ProtoWire、弹幕协议、下载策略、全部 Policy 类）的选项，约 65-70% 代码原样可用。Flutter 需要全部翻译到 Dart。WinUI 3 需要全部翻译到 C#。Avalonia 同样需要 C# 翻译，但语法与 Kotlin 相似度高于 Dart。

## 毛玻璃与视觉效果

WinUI 3 原生提供 Acrylic、Mica、Composition EffectBrush——零成本还原 BiliPai 的 BlurBudgetPolicy 和 BlurIntensityVisualPolicy。Compose Multiplatform 用 Haze 库实现毛玻璃（已验证可行），但 Mica 和系统亚克力拿不到。Flutter 用内置 `BackdropFilter` 实现毛玻璃，效果与 Haze 等价，`FragmentShader` 做液态玻璃。Avalonia 无内置方案，需用 SkiaSharp 自建或依赖 FluentAvalonia 社区库，还原度最低。

## 视频播放器

WinUI 3 和 Compose Multiplatform 都走 libmpv 路径——你在 MoePlayer 中已验证过 HWND 分层管理。Flutter 用 `media_kit`（libmpv 的 Flutter 封装），同样可行但多一层桥接。Avalonia 需要通过 NativeControlHost 嵌入 libmpv 或用 Skia 自绘视频帧，架构最复杂。

## 弹幕渲染

WinUI 3 用 Win2D（Direct2D）做 Canvas 渲染，GPU 硬件加速，同屏数百条弹幕无压力。Flutter 用 `CustomPainter` + Skia GPU 路径，性能接近。Compose Multiplatform 用 Skiko 的 `Canvas` API，概念一致但 GPU 路径不如 Direct2D 直接。Avalonia 也用 SkiaSharp，但文字抗锯齿和子像素布局与 Direct2D 有细微差异。

## Windows 平台集成

WinUI 3 完胜——SMTC（系统媒体控制）、CompactOverlay（画中画）、Windows Hello（生物认证）、通知中心全部开箱即用。Flutter 需要通过 platform channel 调用 WinRT API，多一层桥接。Compose Multiplatform 需要 JNA/JNI 调用 WinRT，最不顺畅。Avalonia 同样需要平台特定代码，无跨平台抽象。

## Material 3

Flutter 有官方 Material 3 组件库，与 BiliPai 的 Material 3 设计语言最对齐。Compose Multiplatform 也有 Material 3 支持，几乎原样可用。WinUI 3 是 Fluent Design，Material 3 组件需从零实现或用社区库。Avalonia 同样是 Fluent 体系，Material 3 需自建。

## 共享元素转场

WinUI 3 有 `ConnectedAnimationService`，直接对应 BiliPai 的 SharedTransitionProvider。Flutter 有 `Hero` widget，比 Compose 的实现更成熟。Compose Multiplatform 需要验证 `SharedTransitionScope` 的桌面端支持。Avalonia 需要完全自建转场系统。

## 构建与依赖管理

Compose Multiplatform 用 Gradle + Kotlin——与 BiliPai 完全一致，构建脚本可直接参考。Flutter 用 `pub` 包管理器，简洁独立。WinUI 3 用 NuGet + MSBuild/.NET，Visual Studio 原生支持。Avalonia 同样用 NuGet/.NET。

## 成熟度与风险

WinUI 3 最成熟（你的 MoePlayer 已验证），但 Windows App SDK 版本绑定微软更新节奏。Flutter Desktop 已稳定，渲染引擎成熟，但 Windows 原生 API 集成是长期补丁。Compose Multiplatform Desktop 仍在成长期，实验性 API 的桌面端行为需要逐个验证（我们已踩过 Haze 版本兼容性的坑）。Avalonia 12 稳定但视觉效果生态最弱。

---

## 一句话总结

如果首要目标是**视觉还原度 + Windows 原生体验**：WinUI 3。如果首要目标是**代码复用 + 保持 Kotlin 技术栈**：Compose Multiplatform。如果首要目标是**渲染性能 + Material 3 原生支持**：Flutter。Avalonia 在不跨平台的前提下没有明显优势。

```
### 3. Home Page

**Files:**
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\pages\home\view.dart` -- `HomePage` widget
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\pages\home\controller.dart` -- `HomeController`

**Architecture:** The home page uses a `Column` with:
1. A **custom app bar** (top bar) -- only shown when using bottom nav and portrait orientation
2. A **TabBar** for switching between sub-tabs (live, rcmd/recommend, hot, rank, bangumi, cinema)
3. An **Expanded** body with a `TabBarView` containing tab pages

**Home Tabs** (`HomeTabType` enum in `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\models\common\home_tab_type.dart`):
- `live` (直播) -> `LivePage`
- `rcmd` (推荐) -> `RcmdPage` -- **the main recommendation feed**
- `hot` (热门) -> `HotPage`
- `rank` (分区) -> `RankPage`
- `bangumi` (番剧) -> `PgcPage`
- `cinema` (影视) -> `PgcPage`

Tabs are configurable/reorderable via settings (`SettingBoxKey.tabBarSort`).

**Top Bar / App Bar** (`customAppBar()` in home/view.dart): A custom row containing:
- A **search bar** widget (`searchBar()`) -- a rounded `Material` + `InkWell` pill (border radius 25, height 44) showing the default search word, navigates to `/search` on tap
- A **message badge** (`msgBadge()`) -- `IconButton` with `Badge` showing unread count
- A **user avatar** (`userAvatar()`) -- circular `NetworkImgLayer` avatar (34x34) with tap to go to mine page, incognito badge overlay if anonymity mode is active

The top bar supports **hide-on-scroll** behavior via two modes:
- `CustomHeightWidget` with offset translation (sync mode, tied to `barOffset`)
- `AnimatedOpacity` + `AnimatedContainer` (instant mode, tied to `showTopBar`)

**Home Feed Rendering** (`RcmdPage` in `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\pages\rcmd\view.dart`):
- Uses `CustomScrollView` with a `SliverGrid.builder`
- Grid delegate: `SliverGridDelegateWithExtentAndRatio` (custom, from `lib/utils/grid.dart`) with configurable card width (`Pref.recommendCardWidth`) and aspect ratio `Style.aspectRatio` (16/10)
- Wrapped in `Container` with `clipBehavior: hardEdge`, margin `Style.safeSpace` (12px horizontal), border radius `Style.mdRadius`
- `refreshIndicator` wraps the scroll view for pull-to-refresh
- Shows skeleton cards (`VideoCardVSkeleton`) while loading
- Supports "last seen here" refresh marker card

**Video Card Widget** (`VideoCardV` in `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\common\widgets\video_card\video_card_v.dart`):
- A `Stack` with `Card` > `InkWell` > `Column`
- Image area: `AspectRatio` (16/10) with `LayoutBuilder` containing `NetworkImgLayer` (cached network image) + duration `PBadge` in bottom-right corner
- Content area: video title (2 lines), `videoStat` row (play count + danmaku count via `StatWidget`), then badges (bangumi badge, recommendation reason, "已关注"/followed) and UP name
- Overflow `VideoPopupMenu` button positioned at bottom-right (-5, -2) for av-type videos
- Navigation: tap opens video detail page (`PageUtils.toVideoPage`), long-press opens image save dialog

### 6. Video Player

**Library:** `media_kit` (MPV-based player for Flutter)

**Key files:**
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\plugin\pl_player\controller.dart` -- `PlPlayerController` (1750+ lines, singleton pattern)

- Creates `VideoController` via `VideoController.create()` with `VideoControllerConfiguration` (hardware acceleration, hwdec)
- Sets media headers (user agent, referer) via `player.setMediaHeader()`

**Features:**
- Danmaku (bullet comments) integration via `canvas_danmaku` -- `DanmakuController<DanmakuExtra>`
- Audio/video separation via EDL protocol (for DASH streams with separate audio/video URLs)
- Picture-in-picture: both Android PiP and desktop PiP (window resize + always-on-top)
- Fullscreen management: orientation changes, system bar hiding, desktop fullscreen
- Volume control: `FlutterVolumeController` (mobile) or `Player.setVolume()` (desktop)
- Brightness control: `ScreenBrightnessPlatform`
- Wakelock: `WakelockPlus.toggle()`
- Screenshot: `player.screenshot()` -> save as PNG
- Seek preview: `VideoShotData` thumbnail previews on seek bar
- Super resolution: Anime4K GLSL shaders loaded via MPV `change-list glsl-shaders` command
- Audio normalization: via MPV `lavfi-complex` filter with `loudnorm`
- SponsorBlock integration: `BlockConfigMixin` for skipping segments
- Heartbeat/history: sends playback progress to bilibili API every 5 seconds
- Custom controls: double-tap seek, long-press speed boost, gesture controls, keyboard shortcuts

**Player widgets directory** (`D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\plugin\pl_player\`):

- `widgets/` -- `bottom_control.dart`, `play_pause_btn.dart`, `forward_seek.dart`, `backward_seek.dart`, `app_bar_ani.dart`, `common_btn.dart`, `mpv_convert_webp.dart`

### 8. HTTP Networking

**Files:**
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\http\init.dart` -- `Request` singleton (Dio configuration)
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\http\constants.dart` -- base URLs (`HttpString`)
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\http\api.dart` -- API endpoint constants
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\http\retry_interceptor.dart` -- custom retry interceptor

**Dio configuration** (`Request._internal()`):
- **Singleton pattern:** `static final Request _instance = Request._internal()` with factory constructor
- **BaseOptions:**
  - `baseUrl`: `https://api.bilibili.com`
  - `connectTimeout`: 10 seconds
  - `receiveTimeout`: 10 seconds
  - Headers: `user-agent: Dart/3.6 (dart:io)`, `accept-encoding: br,gzip`, `connection: keep-alive` (when not HTTP/2)
  - Custom `responseDecoder` for manual gzip/brotli decompression
  - `persistentConnection: true`

**HTTP/2 support:** Uses `dio_http2_adapter`'s `Http2Adapter` with `ConnectionManager`. Falls back to `IOHttpClientAdapter` (HTTP/1.1). Toggle via `Pref.enableHttp2`. A `http11Dio` clone is available for endpoints that need HTTP/1.1.

**Interceptors:**
1. **`AccountManager`** -- acts as a custom interceptor, manages cookies and multi-account authentication
2. **`RetryInterceptor`** -- custom retry logic with configurable count (`Pref.retryCount`) and delay (`Pref.retryDelay`)
3. **`LogInterceptor`** -- only in debug mode, logs responses without headers

**System proxy support:** Configurable via `Pref.enableSystemProxy`, `Pref.systemProxyHost/Port`. Proxy is applied to both HTTP/2 `ConnectionManager` and HTTP/1.1 `IOHttpClientAdapter`.

**Connectivity monitoring:** On iOS, watches `Connectivity().onConnectivityChanged` and resets connection pools on network change (debounced 500ms).

**Error handling:** `get()` and `post()` methods catch `DioException`, call `AccountManager.dioError()` for error messages, and return a `Response` with error data (never throw to caller). This allows UI to handle errors uniformly via the `LoadingState` pattern.

**Decompression:** Manual `responseDecoder` handles `gzip` (via `archive` package's `GZipDecoder`) and `br` (via `brotli` package's `BrotliDecoder`). This is needed because `Http2Adapter` doesn't auto-decompress.

**API layer pattern:** Each domain (`video.dart`, `user.dart`, `fav.dart`, `live.dart`, etc.) contains static methods that call `Request().get()` / `Request().post()` and return `Future<LoadingState<T>>`. The `LoadingState` is a sealed class (`Loading`, `Success<T>`, `Error`) -- UI uses switch expressions to handle states.

**Request signing:** Uses `WbiSign.makSign()` for WBI signature and `app_sign.dart` for app-level signing. Constants like `appKey`, `appSec` are in `Constants`.

### 9. State Management

**Approach:** **GetX** (`get` package, forked at `version_4.7.2`)

Key evidence:
- `GetMaterialApp` used in `main.dart` instead of `MaterialApp`
- Routes defined as `GetPage` in `app_pages.dart`
- Navigation via `Get.toNamed()`, `Get.to()`, `Get.back()`, `Get.until()`
- Controllers extend `GetxController`
- Reactive state via `Rx`, `RxInt`, `RxBool`, `RxDouble`, `RxString`, `.obs`
- UI reactivity via `Obx(() => ...)` wrappers
- Dependency injection via `Get.put()`, `Get.putOrFind()`, `Get.find<T>()`, `Get.lazyPut()`
- `GetSingleTickerProviderStateMixin` for TabController vsync
- `Get.changeThemeMode()` for runtime theme switching
- `Get.routing` for route inspection

**Controller architecture:**
- `CommonController<R, T>` -- abstract base with `ScrollOrRefreshMixin` (provides `scrollController`, `onRefresh()`, `toTopOrRefresh()`, `onLoadMore()`, `onReload()`)
- `CommonListController` -- extends for paginated list data
- `CommonDataController<T, R>` -- extends for data with custom response handling
- All controllers expose `Rx<LoadingState> loadingState` for UI binding

**LoadingState pattern:** A sealed class hierarchy (`Loading`, `Success<T>`, `Error`) used throughout for async data representation. UI code uses `switch` expressions on `loadingState.value` to render loading skeletons, success content, or error widgets.

**Persistence:** Uses **Hive CE** (`hive_ce`) via a `GStorage` wrapper. `Pref` is an abstract class with static getters/setters that read/write Hive boxes, providing typed access to all preferences.

### 10. Blur/Glass Effects

**Finding: There are NO `BackdropFilter` or `ImageFilter.blur` usages anywhere in the `lib/` directory.**

The initial search for "blur" returned 5 files, but all matches were `blurRadius` properties in `BoxShadow` decorations (e.g., the `FavFolderItem` widget in `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\pages\mine\widgets\item.dart` uses `BoxShadow` with `blurRadius: 0.0` for a hard drop shadow effect, not a true blur).

The project does **not** use glassmorphism, frosted glass, or backdrop blur effects. Instead, the app achieves visual depth through:
- Material 3 elevation and surface tint overlays (`ElevationOverlay.applySurfaceTint`)
- `DecoratedBox` with `ShapeDecoration` (in the floating navigation bar)
- `BoxShadow` with configurable blur radius
- Transparent backgrounds on navigation rails/drawers (relying on the underlying surface color)
- `Colors.transparent` backgrounds that show through to the scaffold surface

The floating navigation bar (`FloatingNavigationBar`) uses `ElevationOverlay.applySurfaceTint` on an opaque `surfaceContainer` background color -- it does NOT use `BackdropFilter` for a blur effect.

---

### Summary of Key Architectural Decisions

| Aspect | Choice |
|--------|--------|
| State management | GetX (forked v4.7.2) |
| Routing | GetX named routes (`GetPage`) |
| Networking | Dio 5.9.1 with HTTP/2 adapter, custom retry interceptor |
| Player | media_kit (MPV) with custom `PlPlayerController` singleton |
| Theming | Material 3, `flex_seed_scheme` for color seeding, dynamic color support, pure black dark mode |
| Storage | Hive CE (`hive_ce`) via `GStorage` + `Pref` |
| Image loading | `cached_network_image_ce` (forked) |
| Async state | Sealed `LoadingState<T>` class (Loading/Success/Error) |
| Navigation | 3 modes: custom FloatingNavigationBar, M3 NavigationBar, legacy BottomNavigationBar + NavigationRail/Drawer for desktop |
| Layout | Custom `MainLayout` render object (slotted widget) |
| Desktop | window_manager, tray_manager, win32 support |
| Blur effects | None -- no BackdropFilter/ImageFilter.blur anywhere |
```

```json
## BiliPai UI Interaction Patterns for Flutter Port

### 1. Home Page Interactions

**Top bar scroll behavior** (`HomeScrollCoordinator.kt`, `HomeScreen.kt`, `HomeTopTabGesturePolicy.kt`):
- The top bar (header + category tabs) **collapses upward on scroll-down** and **expands on scroll-up** using a nested-scroll offset mechanism (`headerOffsetHeightPx`). The offset is clamped between `-maxHeaderCollapsePx` and `0`.
- Collapse is **not a fade** -- it is a vertical translation (Y-offset) that physically moves the header off-screen.
- When the feed settles at item index 0 with scroll offset 0, the header **auto-expands** back to offset 0.
- A **horizontal drag gesture** on the top tab area can also collapse/expand the header (threshold-based in `HomeTopTabGesturePolicy.kt`).
- When collapsed, a **12dp drag handle** remains visible (`resolveHomeTopCollapsedHandleHeight() = 12.dp`).
- Double-tap on the Home tab triggers scroll-to-top + header expansion + refresh if already at top.
- The header supports blur (Haze) and "liquid glass" render modes, with scroll offset broadcast via `LocalHomeScrollOffset` for parallax/glass effects.

**Category tabs and pager** (`HomeScreen.kt`, `HomePagerSyncPolicy.kt`):
- Categories are displayed in a **HorizontalPager** (swipeable). Tabs and pager are bidirectionally synced.
- Tapping a tab animates the pager to that page; swiping the pager switches the active category.
- Default tabs (order customizable): Recommend, Popular, Follow, Live, Partition, etc. (6 items by default, controlled via settings).
- Tab order and visibility are user-configurable.
- Tabs use a **segmented control** style with a sliding indicator (pill-shaped, spring-animated).
- Tab presentation height: expanded = `46dp` (48dp row - 2dp content padding), collapsed = `12dp`.

**Video card tap** (`HomeVideoClickRequest.kt`, `SharedTransitionProvider.kt`, `BiliPaiCardMorphDestinationPolicy.kt`):
- Tapping a video card triggers a **shared element transition** (sharedBounds) from the card cover to the video detail page. The `SharedTransitionProvider` wraps the entire app.
- The click passes `bvid`, `cid`, `coverUrl`, `isVerticalVideo`, `source`, and `sourceRoute` via `HomeVideoClickRequest`.
- When shared transition is enabled, the forward/back transition is `NO_OP_SHARED_ELEMENT` (the sharedBounds API handles the visual morph).
- When disabled, directional slide transitions are used based on which column the card was in (left/right).
- A **particle dissolve animation** (`DissolvableVideoCard` with `jiggleOnDissolve`) can play on card dismissal.

**Pull-to-refresh** (`HomePullRefreshUiPolicy.kt`, `HomeRefreshIndicator.kt`):
- Uses Material3 `PullToRefreshBox` with adaptive indicator styles: **Cupertino** (default) or **Material screenshot handle**.
- Cupertino style: indicator centered in the drag gap, content offset = `distanceFraction * 0.5` (content moves at half drag speed).
- Material screenshot style: resistance curve `1 + 0.35 * clamped`, max content offset 172dp, indicator height grows from 44dp to ~70dp with progress.
- Refresh threshold reached at progress >= 1.0; hint text shows "松手刷新" (release to refresh), then "正在刷新..." while refreshing.
- Release spring: `dampingRatio = 0.96, stiffness = 520`.
- After refresh with new items, auto-scrolls to top; shows a "新增 N 条内容" delta tip for 2.2s.

**Feed grid layout** (`HomeFeedGridPolicy.kt`, `HomeFeedCardStylePolicy.kt`):
- Uses **LazyVerticalStaggeredGrid** (waterfall/staggered layout).
- Columns: dynamically computed from content width / minimum card width. Default min card width = 180dp, 2-6 columns on phone. Single-column mode uses 280dp min, max 2 columns.
- Outer padding: **8dp** all around. Item spacing: **8dp** horizontal, 8-10dp vertical (varies by card style).
- Card aspect ratio options: 16:9 (Current/default), 4:3 (Official), 16:10 (PiliPlus). Single-column always uses 16:9.
- Card styles: `ElegantVideoCard` (current), `GlassVideoCard` (glass), `StoryVideoCard` (story), `CinematicVideoCard` (cinematic), `LiveRoomCard` (live).
- Max content width capped at **1280dp** for large screens.

### 2. Profile Page Interactions

**Wallpaper/gradient background** (`ProfileScreen.kt`, `ProfileLayoutPolicy.kt`, `ProfileChromePolicy.kt`):
- **Yes**, there is a full-bleed wallpaper background ("top photo") at the top of the profile page.
- Hero/wallpaper height: `36% of screen height`, clamped to **336-360dp** (mobile), slightly less on tablet (92% scale).
- If no wallpaper, a **fallback gradient** is shown: light mode = `primaryContainer.copy(alpha=0.55f)` to `surface`; dark mode = `surfaceVariant.copy(alpha=0.92f)` to `surface`.
- A **bottom scrim gradient** overlays the wallpaper: dark theme alpha 0.65, light theme 0.55 at bottom, 0 at top.
- Wallpaper is user-customizable: official wallpapers, local photo album, or adjustable (scale/offset via `WallpaperAdjustmentSheet`).
- System bars are made transparent and edge-to-edge; status bar icons adapt to wallpaper luminance.

**User info section** (`ProfileScreen.kt` lines 1180-1293):
- **Avatar**: 80dp diameter (72dp in compact/tablet mode), circular, with 2dp border (`avatarBorderColor = White.copy(alpha=0.88)` when wallpaper present).
- **Name**: `titleLarge` style, `FontWeight.Bold`, single line with ellipsis.
- **Level badge**: `UserLevelBadge` component shown immediately after name.
- **VIP badge**: pill-shaped (`RoundedCornerShape(999dp)`), secondary color background, white text, `labelSmall` style, 8dp horizontal / 3dp vertical padding.
- **Stats row** (right of avatar): Follower count, Following count (clickable), Likes count -- displayed in white text over the wallpaper.
- **Action buttons**: "编辑资料" (Edit Profile) as an `OutlinedButton` (44dp height, 12dp corner radius, border with 0.42 alpha). Plus a wallpaper action button.
- **Identity drawer**: expandable section with sign/IP location/sex metadata in chip-style containers (`Black.copy(alpha=0.22)` background, `White.copy(alpha=0.22)` border).

**Scroll behavior**:
- Mobile: uses `exitUntilCollapsedScrollBehavior()` -- the top bar collapses on scroll but the wallpaper parallax-scrolls.
- Tablet: uses `pinnedScrollBehavior()` -- top bar stays fixed.
- Content is in a **LazyColumn** with a **ProfileContentSheet** that has a rounded top (20dp radius), 20dp upward overlap over the wallpaper, creating an iOS-style "sheet over hero" effect.
- The sheet has a vertical gradient background (`surfaceContainerLow` to `surface`), 0.5dp border, and 2dp shadow elevation (light mode only; 0 in dark).

**Settings/services items** (`ProfileScreen.kt` lines 3611-3685, `ServicesSection`):
In order (mobile immersive layout):
1. 离线缓存 (Offline Cache) -- download icon
2. 历史记录 (History) -- history icon (conditionally shown if not in bottom bar)
3. 我的收藏 (Favorites) -- bookmark icon, with inline favorite folder shortcut grid
4. 稍后再看 (Watch Later) -- watch later icon
5. 消息中心 (Inbox/Messages) -- inbox icon
6. 账号切换 (Account Switch) / 退出登录 (Logout) -- in a separate `ProfileAccountActionArea`

Each service row is a list item with icon, title, and chevron, separated by hairline dividers. The whole group is inside a rounded card (24dp radius) or embedded directly in the content sheet.

### 3. Bottom Navigation (`BottomBar.kt`)

**Floating vs docked**:
- Configurable. Default is **floating** (capsule shape, `RoundedCornerShape(percent = 50)`, 50dp corner radius).
- Floating spec: 36dp horizontal outside padding, 12dp inner padding, 12dp item spacing, 1dp shadow elevation, no divider.
- Docked spec: 0 corner radius, 0 outside padding, 0 item spacing, 0 shadow, shows divider.
- Floating height: 66dp phone / 72dp tablet (icon+text mode), 52-54dp (text-only), 58-64dp (icon-only).

**Blur effect**:
- **Yes**, uses Haze library for real-time frosted glass blur when `blurEnabled = true`.
- Blur radius: 12dp, surface alpha: 0.4 when blurred (transparent glass), 1.0 when not.
- Additionally supports "liquid glass" mode (AndroidLiquidGlass/Backdrop library) with refraction, lens, and vibrancy effects -- this is an advanced iOS 26-style glass effect.

**Items** (`BottomNavItem` enum):
- 10 possible items: **HOME** (House icon), **DYNAMIC** (Bell), **STORY** (PlayCircle), **HISTORY** (Clock), **LISTEN_VIDEO** (custom drawable), **PROFILE** (Person), **FAVORITE** (Star), **LIVE** (Video), **WATCHLATER** (Clock), **SETTINGS** (Gearshape), **PLUGINS** (PuzzlepieceExtension).
- Uses **Cupertino SF Symbols** style filled/outlined icon pairs (selected = filled, unselected = outlined).
- Default visible items: HOME, DYNAMIC, HISTORY, LISTEN_VIDEO, PROFILE (5 items).
- Items are user-reorderable and toggliable via settings.

**Per-item colors** (`Color.kt` - `BottomBarColorPalette`):
- 7-color palette: Blue (`#007AFF`), Orange (`#FF9500`), Teal (`#5AC8FA`), Pink (`#FF2D55`), Red (`#FF3B30`), Green (`#34C759`), Purple (`#AF52DE`).
- Default per-item: HOME=Blue, DYNAMIC=Orange, HISTORY=Teal, PROFILE=Pink, FAVORITE=Red, LIVE=Green, WATCHLATER=Purple.
- Unselected color: `iOSSystemGray` (`#8E8E93`).
- Colors are user-customizable per item.

**Scroll hide/show behavior** (`HomeBottomBarScrollPolicy.kt`, `HomeScrollCoordinator.kt`):
- Three modes: **SCROLL_HIDE** (auto-hide on scroll down, show on scroll up), **ALWAYS_VISIBLE**, **ALWAYS_HIDDEN**.
- Hysteresis: 200px offset threshold to prevent flickering. Top reveal threshold: 100px (shows bar when scrolling back near top).
- Hides when `firstVisibleItem` increases or scroll offset exceeds hysteresis; shows when it decreases or reaches near top.
- Suppressed during video navigation.
- When hidden, the bar translates off-screen (1000dp offset).

### 4. Navigation Transitions (`navigation3/` directory)

**Transition types** (`BiliPaiNavMotionPolicy.kt`, `BiliPaiNavContentTransformPolicy.kt`):
- **Shared element (NO_OP)**: When card transition is enabled and shared bounds are ready, forward and return use `EnterTransition.None`/`ExitTransition.None` -- the sharedBounds API handles the visual morph. Duration: 360ms with easing `CubicBezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`.
- **Classic card**: Fallback fade (180ms tween) in/out.
- **Card-disabled directional video**: Forward = slide from source direction (85% width, spring physics, 280ms) + list slides opposite 18%. Return = reverse, 260ms, detail exits 90% toward card column.
- **Space forward**: Slide in from 1/8 width (220ms spring).
- **Light sibling forward/pop**: Slide in/out 1/8 width (240ms spring), with emphasized easing.
- **Bottom bar sibling**: Horizontal slide transform matching bottom pager duration (cross-fade between top-level tabs).
- **Settings iOS push**: Custom iOS-style push/pop (forward = slide in from right + fade, pop = reverse), duration from `SETTINGS_IOS_PUSH_DURATION_MS`.

**Predictive back** (`predictiveback/` directory):
- 4 styles: **SCALE** (default), **DEFAULT**, **AOSP**, **CLASSIC**.
- Shared element predictive back supported for video detail return (`BiliPaiSharedElementPredictiveBackAnimation`).
- Settings uses a dedicated iOS-style predictive back (`BiliPaiSettingsIosPredictiveBackAnimation`).
- Exit direction is determined by card source position (left/right/none).

**Motion easing curves** (`AppMotionTokens.kt`):
- iOS preset: spring physics (damping 0.86, stiffness 380 standard; 0.72, 520 expressive).
- MD3/Miuix: tween durations (180-300ms) with `CubicBezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)` (emphasized enter), `CubicBezier(0.32, 0, 0.67, 0)` (emphasized exit).
- Navigation slides: critically damped spring (dampingRatio=1.0, stiffness derived from duration).
- Shared transition: 360ms with `CubicBezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`.

---

### 5. Visual Style Tokens

**Spacing scale** (`AppSpacingTokens.kt`):
| Token | Value |
|---|---|
| None | 0dp |
| Micro | 2dp |
| ExtraSmall | 4dp |
| Small | 8dp |
| Medium | 12dp |
| Large | 16dp |
| ExtraLarge | 24dp |
| DoubleExtraLarge | 32dp |
| TripleExtraLarge | 48dp |

**Corner radius scale** (`Shape.kt` - `iOSCornerRadius`):
| Token | Value | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| Tiny | 4dp | Tags, small badges |
| ExtraSmall | 6dp | Small buttons, chips |
| Small | 10dp | Input fields, small cards, search bar |
| Medium | 12dp | Standard cards, buttons |
| Large | 14dp | Modal dialogs, action sheets |
| ExtraLarge | 20dp | Large cards, bottom sheets (top corners) |
| Floating | 28dp | Floating bottom bar, floating buttons |
| Full | 100dp (capsule) | Pill buttons, avatars |

**Key colors** (`Color.kt`):
| Role | Light | Dark |
|---|---|---|
| Background | `#F1F2F3` | `#0D0D0D` |
| Surface (card) | `#FFFFFF` | `#1A1A1A` |
| Surface variant | -- | `#262626` |
| Surface elevated | -- | `#2D2D2D` |
| Text primary | `#18191C` | `#E8E8E8` |
| Text secondary | `#61666D` | `#B0B0B0` |
| Text tertiary | `#9499A0` | `#707070` |
| Bili Pink (brand) | `#FA7298` | `#FF85A2` |
| iOS System Blue (default accent) | `#007AFF` | `#007AFF` |
| iOS System Gray (unselected) | `#8E8E93` | `#8E8E93` |
| iOS Gray 6 (lightest bg) | `#F2F2F7` | `#1C1C1E` |

iOS action colors: Like=`#FF2D55`, Coin=`#FFD60A`, Favorite=`#FF9500`, Share=`#007AFF`, Comment=`#5AC8FA`, Triple=`#AF52DE`.

**Chrome size tokens** (`AppChromeSizeTokens.kt`):
- Minimum touch target: 48dp
- Compact control height: 44dp
- Compact control corner radius: 20dp
- Bottom bar matched segmented control height: 40dp / indicator 27dp

**Profile layout tokens** (`ProfileLayoutPolicy.kt`):
- Hero height: 36% screen height, clamped 336-360dp
- Content sheet top radius: 20dp, top overlap: 20dp
- Section spacing: 20dp
- Tab height: 48dp
- Profile card: 148dp width, 3:4 aspect ratio, 12dp radius, 56dp metadata height, 12dp gap

**Home feed card layout** (`HomeFeedCardStylePolicy.kt`):
- Outer padding: 8dp, item spacing: 8dp (horizontal and vertical)
- Cover aspect ratio: 16:9 (default), 4:3, or 16:10
- Story card horizontal padding: 0-16dp depending on style

**Home feed grid** (`HomeFeedGridPolicy.kt`):
- Min card width: 180dp (grid mode), 280dp (single-column)
- Max columns: 6 (grid), 2 (single-column)
- Min columns: 2 (when width >= 300dp)
- Max content width: 1280dp
```

```json
126	            response.unfollowUnread +
127	            response.bizMsgFollowUnread +
128	            response.bizMsgUnfollowUnread +
129	            response.unfollowPushMsg +
130	            response.customUnread;
131	      }
132	    }
133	    return 0;
134	  }

136	  Future<int> _msgFeedUnread() async {
137	    int count = 0;
138	    final remainTypes = Set<MsgUnReadType>.from(msgUnReadTypes)
139	      ..remove(MsgUnReadType.pm);
140	    if (remainTypes.isNotEmpty) {
141	      final res = await MsgHttp.msgFeedUnread();
142	      if (res case Success(:final response)) {
143	        for (final item in remainTypes) {
144	          switch (item) {
145	            case MsgUnReadType.pm:
146	              break;
147	            case MsgUnReadType.reply:
148	              count += response.reply;
149	              break;
150	            case MsgUnReadType.at:
151	              count += response.at;
152	              break;
153	            case MsgUnReadType.like:
154	              count += response.like;
155	              break;
156	            case MsgUnReadType.sysMsg:
157	              count += response.sysMsg;
158	              break;
159	          }
160	        }
161	      }
162	    }
163	    return count;
164	  }

166	  Future<void> queryUnreadMsg([bool isChangeType = false]) async {
167	    if (!accountService.isLogin.value ||

171	      msgUnReadCount.value = '';
172	      return;
173	    }
174	
175	    final res = await Future.wait([_msgUnread(), _msgFeedUnread()]);
176	
177	    final count = res.sum;
178	
179	    final countStr = count == 0
180	        ? ''
181	        : count > 99
182	        ? '99+'
183	        : count.toString();
184	    if (msgUnReadCount.value == countStr) {
185	      if (isChangeType) {
186	        msgUnReadCount.refresh();
187	      }
```

```json
211	      headers: {
212	        'user-agent': 'Dart/3.6 (dart:io)', // Http2Adapter不会自动添加标头
213	        if (!_enableHttp2) 'connection': 'keep-alive',
214	        'accept-encoding': 'br,gzip',
215	      },
216	      responseDecoder: _responseDecoder, // Http2Adapter没有自动解压
217	      persistentConnection: true,
218	    );
219	
220	    final (h11, connectionManager) = _createPool();
221	
222	    dio = Dio(options)
223	      ..httpClientAdapter = _enableHttp2
224	          ? Http2Adapter(connectionManager, fallbackAdapter: h11)
225	          : h11;
226	
227	    // 先于其他Interceptor
228	    if (Pref.retryCount != 0) {
229	      dio.interceptors.add(
230	        RetryInterceptor(dio, Pref.retryCount, Pref.retryDelay),
231	      );
232	    }
233	
234	    // 日志拦截器 输出请求、响应内容
235	    if (kDebugMode) {
236	      dio.interceptors.add(
237	        LogInterceptor(
238	          request: false,
239	          requestHeader: false,
240	          responseHeader: false,
241	        ),
242	      );
243	    }
244	
245	    dio
246	      ..transformer = BackgroundTransformer()
247	      ..options.validateStatus = (int? status) {
248	        return status != null && status >= 200 && status < 300;
249	      };
250	
251	    if (Platform.isIOS) _watchConnectivity();
252	  }
253	
254	  /*
255	   * get请求
256	   */
257	  Future<Response> get<T>(
258	    String url, {
259	    Map<String, dynamic>? queryParameters,
260	    Options? options,
261	    CancelToken? cancelToken,
262	  }) async {
263	    try {
264	      return await dio.get<T>(
265	        url,
266	        queryParameters: queryParameters,
267	        options: options,
268	        cancelToken: cancelToken,
269	      );
270	    } on DioException catch (e) {
271	      return Response(
272	        data: {
273	          'message': await AccountManager.dioError(e),
274	        }, // 将自定义 Map 数据赋值给 Response 的 data 属性
275	        statusCode: e.response?.statusCode ?? -1,
276	        requestOptions: e.requestOptions,
277	      );
278	    }
279	  }
280	
281	  /*
282	   * post请求
283	   */
284	  Future<Response> post<T>(
285	    String url, {
286	    Object? data,
287	    Map<String, dynamic>? queryParameters,
288	    Options? options,
289	    CancelToken? cancelToken,
290	  }) async {
291	    // if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('post-data: $data');
292	    try {
293	      return await dio.post<T>(
294	        url,
295	        data: data,
296	        queryParameters: queryParameters,
297	        options: options,
298	        cancelToken: cancelToken,
299	      );
300	    } on DioException catch (e) {
301	      AccountManager.toast(e);
302	      return Response(
303	        data: {
304	          'message': await AccountManager.dioError(e),
305	        }, // 将自定义 Map 数据赋值给 Response 的 data 属性
306	        statusCode: e.response?.statusCode ?? -1,
307	        requestOptions: e.requestOptions,
308	      );
309	    }
310	  }
311	
312	  /*
313	   * 下载文件
314	   */
315	  Future<Response> downloadFile(
316	    String urlPath,
317	    String savePath, {
318	    CancelToken? cancelToken,
319	  }) async {
320	    try {
321	      return await dio.download(
322	        urlPath,
323	        savePath,
324	        cancelToken: cancelToken,
325	        // onReceiveProgress: (int count, int total) {
326	        // 进度
327	        // if (kDebugMode) debugPrint("$count $total");
328	        // },
329	      );
330	      // if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('downloadFile success: ${response.data}');
331	    } on DioException catch (e) {
332	      // if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('downloadFile error: $e');
333	      return Response(
334	        data: {
335	          'message': await AccountManager.dioError(e),
336	        },
337	        statusCode: e.response?.statusCode ?? -1,
338	        requestOptions: e.requestOptions,
339	      );
340	    }
341	  }
342	
343	  static List<int> responseBytesDecoder(
344	    List<int> responseBytes,
345	    Map<String, List<String>> headers,
346	  ) => switch (headers['content-encoding']?.firstOrNull) {
347	    'gzip' => _gzipDecoder.decodeBytes(responseBytes),
348	    'br' => _brotliDecoder.convert(responseBytes),
349	    _ => responseBytes,
350	  };
351	
352	  static String _responseDecoder(
353	    List<int> responseBytes,
354	    RequestOptions options,
355	    ResponseBody responseBody,
356	  ) => utf8.decode(
357	    responseBytesDecoder(responseBytes, responseBody.headers),
358	    allowMalformed: true,
359	  );
360	}
```

```json
5	internal fun resolveNextHomeGlobalScrollOffset(
6	    currentOffset: Float,
7	    scrollDeltaY: Float,
8	    liquidGlassEnabled: Boolean,
9	    minUpdateDeltaPx: Float = 0.5f
10	): Float? {
```

```json
84	            constraints.maxHeight - bottomNavSize.height,
85	          ),
86	        );
87	      }
```

```json
477	    LaunchedEffect(isTopLevelActive) {

479	            val gridState = if (currentCategory == HomeCategory.POPULAR) {
480	                popularGridStates[popularSubCategory]
481	            } else {
482	                gridStates[currentCategory]
483	            }
484	            // Video clicks freeze the anchor synchronously before navigation starts. Do not replace
485	            // that clean snapshot with coordinates sampled after shared-bounds has begun remeasuring.
486	            if (gridState != null && pendingFeedScrollAnchor == null) {
487	                pendingFeedScrollAnchor = captureHomeFeedScrollAnchor(
488	                    category = currentCategory,
489	                    popularSubCategory = popularSubCategory,
490	                    firstVisibleItemIndex = gridState.firstVisibleItemIndex,
491	                    firstVisibleItemScrollOffset = gridState.firstVisibleItemScrollOffset,
492	                    headerOffsetPx = headerOffsetHeightPx
493	                )
494	            }
495	            hasSyncedPagerWithState = false
496	            lastDrivenPagerCategory = null
497	        }
498	    }
```

```json
474	internal fun resolveKernelSuFloatingBottomBarWidth(
475	    containerWidth: Dp,
476	    itemCount: Int,
477	    minEdgePadding: Dp
478	): Dp {
479	    val safeItemCount = itemCount.coerceAtLeast(1)
480	    val contentPadding = AppSpacingTokens.ExtraSmall
481	    val preferredItemWidth = AppSpacingTokens.TripleExtraLarge +
482	        AppSpacingTokens.ExtraLarge +
483	        AppSpacingTokens.ExtraSmall
484	    val minimumItemWidth = AppSpacingTokens.TripleExtraLarge + AppSpacingTokens.ExtraSmall
485	    val preferredWidth = (preferredItemWidth * safeItemCount) + (contentPadding * 2)
486	    val minimumWidth = (minimumItemWidth * safeItemCount) + (contentPadding * 2)
487	    val widthCap = (containerWidth - (minEdgePadding * 2)).coerceAtLeast(minimumWidth)
488	    return minOf(preferredWidth, widthCap).coerceAtMost(containerWidth)
489	}
490	
491	internal fun resolveKernelSuBottomBarItemSlotWidth(
492	    dockWidth: Dp,
493	    horizontalPadding: Dp,
494	    itemCount: Int
495	): Dp {
496	    val safeItemCount = itemCount.coerceAtLeast(1)
497	    return ((dockWidth - (horizontalPadding * 2)) / safeItemCount)
498	        .coerceAtLeast(AppSpacingTokens.None)
499	}
```

```json
173	        .coerceAtLeast(0f)
174	    val minWidth = minWidthDp.coerceIn(0f, itemWidthDp)
175	    return maxWidth.coerceAtLeast(minWidth)
```

```json
1	package com.android.purebilibili.feature.home
2	
3	import androidx.compose.ui.unit.Dp
4	import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
5	
6	internal enum class HomeTopTabGestureAction {
7	    NONE,
8	    COLLAPSE,
9	    EXPAND
10	}
11	
12	internal fun resolveHomeTopTabGestureAction(
13	    dragDeltaPx: Float,
14	    isCollapsed: Boolean,
15	    thresholdPx: Float
16	): HomeTopTabGestureAction {
17	    if (thresholdPx <= 0f) return HomeTopTabGestureAction.NONE
18	    return when {
19	        !isCollapsed && dragDeltaPx >= thresholdPx -> HomeTopTabGestureAction.COLLAPSE
20	        isCollapsed && dragDeltaPx <= -thresholdPx -> HomeTopTabGestureAction.EXPAND
21	        else -> HomeTopTabGestureAction.NONE
22	    }
23	}
24	
25	internal fun resolveHomeTopCollapsedHandleHeight(): Dp = 12.dp
26	
27	internal fun resolveHomeTopTabsAutoCollapsed(
28	    currentHeaderOffsetPx: Float,
29	    isTopTabAutoCollapseEnabled: Boolean,
30	    collapseThresholdPx: Float = 0.5f
31	): Boolean {
32	    if (!isTopTabAutoCollapseEnabled) return false
33	    return currentHeaderOffsetPx <= -collapseThresholdPx
34	}
35	
36	internal fun resolveHomeTopTabPresentationHeight(
37	    expandedHeight: Dp,
38	    isCollapsed: Boolean,
39	    collapsedHandleHeight: Dp = resolveHomeTopCollapsedHandleHeight()
40	): Dp {
41	    return if (isCollapsed) collapsedHandleHeight else expandedHeight
42	}
```

```json
211	  Future<void> exitDesktopPip() {
212	    isDesktopPip = false;
213	    return Future.wait([
214	      if (showWindowTitleBar)
215	        windowManager.setTitleBarStyle(TitleBarStyle.normal),
216	      windowManager.setMinimumSize(const Size(400, 700)),

223	  Future<void> enterDesktopPip() async {
224	    if (isFullScreen.value) return;
225	
226	    isDesktopPip = true;
227	
228	    _lastWindowBounds = await windowManager.getBounds();
229	
230	    if (showWindowTitleBar) {
231	      windowManager.setTitleBarStyle(TitleBarStyle.hidden);
232	    }
233	
234	    final Size size;
235	    final state = videoPlayerController!.state;
236	    int width = state.width;
237	    int height = state.height;
238	    if (width == 0) {
239	      width = this.width ?? 16;
240	    }
241	    if (height == 0) {
242	      height = this.height ?? 9;
243	    }
244	    if (height > width) {
245	      size = Size(280.0, 280.0 * height / width);
246	    } else {
247	      size = Size(280.0 * width / height, 280.0);
248	    }
249	
250	    await windowManager.setMinimumSize(size);
251	    setAlwaysOnTop(true);
252	    windowManager
253	      ..setSize(size)
254	      ..setAspectRatio(width / height);
255	  }

488	
489	  void _onOrientationChanged(OrientationParams param) {
490	    _orientation = param.orientation;
491	    if (Platform.isIOS && !visible) return;
492	    final orientation = param.orientation;
493	    final isFullScreen = this.isFullScreen.value;
494	    if (checkIsAutoRotate &&
495	        param.isAutoRotate != true &&
496	        (!isFullScreen ||
497	            _isVertical ||
498	            orientation == .portraitUp ||
499	            orientation == .portraitDown)) {
500	      return;
501	    }
502	    switch (orientation) {
503	      case .portraitUp:
504	        if (!_isVertical && controlsLock.value) return;
505	        if (!horizontalScreen && !_isVertical && isFullScreen) {
506	          if (!isManualFS) {
507	            triggerFullScreen(status: false, orientation: orientation);
508	          }
509	        } else {
510	          portraitUpMode();
511	        }
512	      case .portraitDown:
513	        if (!horizontalScreen) return;
514	        if (!_isVertical && controlsLock.value) return;
515	        portraitDownMode();
516	      case .landscapeLeft:
517	        if (!horizontalScreen && !isFullScreen) {
518	          triggerFullScreen(orientation: orientation, isManualFS: false);
519	        } else {
520	          landscapeLeftMode();
521	        }
522	      case .landscapeRight:
523	        if (!horizontalScreen && !isFullScreen) {
524	          triggerFullScreen(orientation: orientation, isManualFS: false);
525	        } else {
526	          landscapeRightMode();
527	        }
528	    }
529	  }

583	  // 初始化资源
584	  Future<void> setDataSource(
585	    DataSource dataSource, {
586	    bool isLive = false,
587	    bool autoplay = true,
588	    // 初始化播放位置
589	    Duration? seekTo,
590	    // 初始化播放速度
591	    double speed = 1.0,
592	    int? width,
593	    int? height,
594	    Duration? duration,
595	    // 方向
596	    bool? isVertical,
597	    // 记录历史记录
598	    int? aid,
599	    String? bvid,
600	    int? cid,
601	    int? epid,
602	    int? seasonId,
603	    int? pgcType,
604	    VideoType? videoType,
605	    VoidCallback? onInit,
606	    Volume? volume,
607	    bool autoFullScreenFlag = false,
608	  }) async {
609	    try {
610	      _processing = true;
611	      this.isLive = isLive;
612	      _videoType = videoType ?? VideoType.ugc;
613	      this.width = width;
614	      this.height = height;
615	      this.dataSource = dataSource;
616	      _autoPlay = autoplay;
617	      // 初始化视频倍速
618	      // _playbackSpeed.value = speed;
619	      // 初始化数据加载状态
620	      dataStatus.value = DataStatus.loading;
621	      // 初始化全屏方向
622	      _isVertical = isVertical ?? false;
623	      _aid = aid;
624	      _bvid = bvid;
625	      this.cid = cid;
626	      _epid = epid;
627	      _seasonId = seasonId;
628	      _pgcType = pgcType;
629	
630	      if (showSeekPreview) {
631	        _clearPreview();
632	      }
633	      cancelLongPressTimer();
634	      if (_videoPlayerController != null &&
635	          _videoPlayerController!.state.playing) {
636	        await pause(notify: false);
637	      }
638	
639	      if (_playerCount == 0) {
640	        return;
641	      }
642	      // 配置Player 音轨、字幕等等
643	      await _createVideoController(dataSource, seekTo, volume);
644	
645	      if (_playerCount == 0) {
646	        _removeListeners();
647	        _videoPlayerController?.dispose();
648	        _videoPlayerController = null;
649	        _videoController = null;
650	        return;
651	      }
652	
653	      updateDuration(duration ?? _videoPlayerController!.state.duration);
654	      position.value = buffered.value = seekTo?.inSeconds ?? 0;
655	
656	      dataStatus.value = .loaded;
657	
658	      if (autoFullScreenFlag && autoEnterFullScreen) {
659	        triggerFullScreen(status: true);
660	      }
661	
662	      await _initializePlayer();
663	      onInit?.call();
664	    } catch (err, stackTrace) {
665	      dataStatus.value = DataStatus.error;
666	      if (kDebugMode) {
667	        debugPrint(stackTrace.toString());
668	        debugPrint('plPlayer err:  $err');
669	      }
670	    } finally {
671	      _processing = false;
672	    }
673	  }

727	  static final loudnormRegExp = RegExp('loudnorm=([^,]+)');

729	  Future<Player> _initPlayer() async {
730	    assert(_videoPlayerController == null);
731	    final opt = {
732	      'video-sync': Pref.videoSync,
733	      if (Platform.isAndroid) 'ao': Pref.audioOutput,
734	      'volume':
735	          (PlatformUtils.isMobile ? Pref.playerVolume : volume.value * 100)
736	              .toString(),
737	      'volume-max': kMaxVolume.toString(),
738	    };
739	    final autosync = Pref.autosync;
740	    if (autosync != '0') {
741	      opt['autosync'] = autosync;
742	    }
743	
744	    final player = await Player.create(
745	      configuration: PlayerConfiguration(
746	        logLevel: kDebugMode ? .warn : .error,
747	        options: opt,
748	      ),
749	    );
750	
751	    assert(_videoController == null);
752	
753	    _videoController = await VideoController.create(
754	      player,
755	      configuration: VideoControllerConfiguration(
756	        enableHardwareAcceleration: hwdec != null,
757	        androidAttachSurfaceAfterVideoParameters: false,
758	        hwdec: hwdec,
759	      ),
760	    );
761	
762	    player.setMediaHeader(userAgent: BrowserUa.pc, referer: HttpString.baseUrl);
763	
764	    _startListeners(player);
765	
766	    return player;
767	  }

774	
775	  // 配置播放器
776	  Future<void> _createVideoController(
777	    DataSource dataSource,
778	    Duration? seekTo,
779	    Volume? volume,
780	  ) async {
781	    isBuffering.value = false;
782	    _heartDuration = 0;
783	    danmakuController?.clear();
784	
785	    var player = _videoPlayerController;
786	
787	    if (player == null) {
788	      player = await _initPlayer();
789	      if (_playerCount == 0) {
790	        _removeListeners();
791	        player.dispose();
792	        player = null;
793	        _videoController = null;
794	        return;
795	      }
796	      _videoPlayerController = player;
797	      if (isAnim && superResolutionType.value != .disable) {
798	        await setShader();
799	      }
800	    }
801	
802	    final Map<String, String> extras = {};
803	
804	    if (dataSource is FileSource) {
805	      extras['cache'] = 'no';
806	    } else {
807	      if (isLive) {
808	        extras.addAll(liveBuffer);
809	      } else {
810	        extras.addAll(buffer);
811	      }
812	    }
813	
814	    String video = dataSource.videoSource;
815	    if (dataSource.audioSource case final audio? when (audio.isNotEmpty)) {
816	      if (onlyPlayAudio.value) {
817	        video = audio;
818	      } else {
819	        // dely_open need provide length
820	        video =
821	            ('edl://'
822	            '!no_clip;!no_chapters;'
823	            // '!delay_open,media_type=video;'
824	            '%${isFileSource ? utf8.encode(video).length : video.length}%$video;'
825	            '!new_stream;!no_clip;!no_chapters;'
826	            // '!delay_open,media_type=audio;'
827	            '%${isFileSource ? utf8.encode(audio).length : audio.length}%$audio');
828	      }
829	      if (enableAudioNormalization) {
830	        final String audioNormalization;
831	        if (volume != null && volume.isNotEmpty) {
832	          audioNormalization = _audioNormalizationParam.replaceFirstMapped(
833	            loudnormRegExp,
834	            (i) =>
835	                'loudnorm=${volume.format(
836	                  Map.fromEntries(
837	                    i.group(1)!.split(':').map((item) {
838	                      final parts = item.split('=');
839	                      return MapEntry(parts[0].toLowerCase(), num.parse(parts[1]));
840	                    }),
841	                  ),
842	                )}',
843	          );
844	        } else {
845	          audioNormalization = _audioNormalizationParam.replaceFirst(
846	            loudnormRegExp,
847	            AudioNormalization.getParamFromConfig(Pref.fallbackNormalization),
848	          );
849	        }
850	        if (audioNormalization.isNotEmpty) {
851	          extras['lavfi-complex'] = '"[aid1] $audioNormalization [ao]"';
852	        }
853	      }
854	    }
855	
856	    await player.open(
857	      Media(
858	        video,
859	        start: seekTo,
860	        extras: extras.isEmpty ? null : extras,
861	      ),
862	      play: false,
863	    );
864	  }

907	  List<StreamSubscription>? _subscriptions;
908	  final Set<ValueChanged<Duration>> _positionListeners = {};
909	  final Set<ValueChanged<PlayerStatus>> _statusListeners = {};
910	
911	  /// 播放事件监听
912	  void _startListeners(NativePlayer player) {
913	    assert(_subscriptions == null);
914	    final stream = player.stream;
915	    _subscriptions = [
916	      /// playing
917	      stream.playing.listen((bool playing) {
918	        WakelockPlus.toggle(enable: playing);
919	        if (playing) {
920	          if (_isAutoEnterPip) {
921	            if (_isCurrVideoPage) {
922	              enterPip(autoEnter: true);
923	            } else {
924	              _disableAutoEnterPip();
925	            }
926	          }
927	          playerStatus.value = .playing;
928	        } else {
929	          _disableAutoEnterPip();
930	          playerStatus.value = .paused;
931	        }
932	
933	        videoPlayerServiceHandler?.onStatusChange(
934	          playerStatus.value,
935	          isBuffering.value,
936	          isLive,
937	        );
938	
939	        for (final element in _statusListeners) {
940	          element(playing ? .playing : .paused);
941	        }
942	
943	        final seconds = videoPlayerController!.state.position.inSeconds;
944	        if (seconds != 0) {
945	          makeHeartBeat(seconds, type: .status);
946	        }
947	      }),
948	
949	      ///completed
950	      stream.completed.listen((bool completed) {
951	        if (completed) {
952	          playerStatus.value = .completed;
953	
954	          for (final element in _statusListeners) {
955	            element(.completed);
956	          }
957	
958	          makeHeartBeat(-1, type: .completed);
959	        }
960	      }),
961	
962	      /// position
963	      stream.position.listen((Duration position) {
964	        final posInSeconds = position.inSeconds;
965	
966	        if (posInSeconds != this.position.value) {
967	          if (!isSeeking.value) {
968	            this.position.value = posInSeconds;
969	          }
970	
971	          videoPlayerServiceHandler?.onPositionChange(position);
972	
973	          makeHeartBeat(posInSeconds);
974	        }
975	
976	        for (final element in _positionListeners) {
977	          element(position);
978	        }
979	      }),
980	      stream.duration.listen(updateDuration),
981	      stream.buffer.listen((Duration buffer) {
982	        buffered.value = buffer.inSeconds;
983	      }),
984	      stream.buffering.listen((bool buffering) {
985	        isBuffering.value = buffering;
986	        videoPlayerServiceHandler?.onStatusChange(
987	          playerStatus.value,
988	          buffering,
989	          isLive,
990	        );
991	      }),
992	      if (kDebugMode)
993	        stream.log.listen(((PlayerLog log) {
994	          if (log.level == 'error' || log.level == 'fatal') {
995	            Utils.reportError('${log.level}: ${log.prefix}: ${log.text}', null);
996	          } else {
997	            debugPrint(log.toString());
998	          }
999	        })),
1000	      stream.error.listen((String event) {
1001	        if (dataSource is FileSource &&
1002	            event.startsWith("Failed to open file")) {
1003	          return;
1004	        }
1005	        if (isLive) {
1006	          if (event.startsWith('tcp: ffurl_read returned ') ||
1007	              event.startsWith("Failed to open https://") ||
1008	              event.startsWith("Can not open external file https://")) {
1009	            Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 3000), refreshPlayer);
1010	          }
1011	          return;
1012	        }
1013	        if (event.startsWith("Failed to open https://") ||
1014	            event.startsWith("Can not open external file https://") ||
1015	            //tcp: ffurl_read returned 0xdfb9b0bb
1016	            //tcp: ffurl_read returned 0xffffff99
1017	            event.startsWith('tcp: ffurl_read returned ')) {
1018	          EasyThrottle.throttle(
1019	            'controllerStream.error.listen',
1020	            const Duration(milliseconds: 10000),
1021	            () {
1022	              Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 3000), () {
1023	                // if (kDebugMode) {
1024	                //   debugPrint("isBuffering.value: ${isBuffering.value}");
1025	                // }
1026	                // if (kDebugMode) {
1027	                //   debugPrint("_buffered.value: ${_buffered.value}");
1028	                // }
1029	                if (isBuffering.value && buffered.value == 0) {
1030	                  SmartDialog.showToast(
1031	                    '视频链接打开失败，重试中',
1032	                    displayTime: const Duration(milliseconds: 500),
1033	                  );
1034	                  refreshPlayer();
1035	                }
1036	              });
1037	            },
1038	          );
1039	        } else if (event.startsWith('Could not open codec')) {
1040	          SmartDialog.showToast('无法加载解码器, $event，可能会切换至软解');
1041	        } else if (!onlyPlayAudio.value) {
1042	          if (event.startsWith("error running") ||
1043	              event.startsWith("Failed to open .") ||
1044	              event.startsWith("Cannot open") ||
1045	              event.startsWith("Can not open")) {
1046	            return;
1047	          }
1048	          Utils.reportError(event);
1049	          // SmartDialog.showToast('视频加载错误, $event');
1050	        }
1051	      }),
1052	    ];
1053	  }

1069	  /// 跳转至指定位置
1070	  Future<void> seekTo(Duration position, {bool isSeek = true}) async {
1071	    if (_playerCount == 0) {
1072	      return;
1073	    }
1074	    if (position < Duration.zero) {
1075	      position = Duration.zero;
1076	    }
1077	    _heartDuration = position.inSeconds;
1078	
1079	    Future<void> seek() async {
1080	      if (isSeek) {
1081	        /// 拖动进度条调节时，不等待第一帧，防止抖动
1082	        await _videoPlayerController?.stream.buffer.first;
1083	      }
1084	      danmakuController?.clear();
1085	      try {
1086	        await _videoPlayerController?.seek(position);
1087	      } catch (e) {
1088	        if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('seek failed: $e');
1089	      }
1090	    }
1091	
1092	    if (duration.value != 0) {
1093	      seek();
1094	    } else {
1095	      // if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('seek duration else');
1096	      _subForSeek?.cancel();
1097	      _subForSeek = duration.listen((_) {
1098	        seek();
1099	        _cancelSubForSeek();
1100	      });
1101	    }
1102	  }

1104	  /// 设置倍速
1105	  Future<void> setPlaybackSpeed(double speed) async {
1106	    lastPlaybackSpeed = playbackSpeed;
1107	
1108	    if (speed == _videoPlayerController?.state.rate) {
1109	      return;
1110	    }
1111	
1112	    await _videoPlayerController?.setRate(speed);
1113	    _playbackSpeed.value = speed;
1114	    if (danmakuController != null) {
1115	      try {
1116	        DanmakuOption currentOption = danmakuController!.option;
1117	        double defaultDuration = currentOption.duration * lastPlaybackSpeed;
1118	        double defaultStaticDuration =
1119	            currentOption.staticDuration * lastPlaybackSpeed;
1120	        DanmakuOption updatedOption = currentOption.copyWith(
1121	          duration: defaultDuration / speed,
1122	          staticDuration: defaultStaticDuration / speed,
1123	        );
1124	        danmakuController!.updateOption(updatedOption);
1125	      } catch (_) {}
1126	    }
1127	  }

1369	  Future<void>? changeOrientation({
1370	    required bool isVertical,
1371	    DeviceOrientation? orientation,
1372	  }) {
1373	    if (orientation == null && (mode == .none || mode == .gravity)) {
1374	      return null;
1375	    }
1376	    if (orientation == null &&
1377	        (mode == .vertical ||
1378	            (mode == .auto && isVertical) ||
1379	            (mode == .ratio && (isVertical || screenRatio < kScreenRatio)))) {
1380	      return portraitUpMode();
1381	    } else {
1382	      // https://github.com/flutter/flutter/issues/73651
1383	      // https://github.com/flutter/flutter/issues/183708
1384	      if (Platform.isAndroid) {
1385	        if ((orientation ?? _orientation) == .landscapeRight) {
1386	          return landscapeRightMode();
1387	        } else {
1388	          return landscapeLeftMode();
1389	        }
1390	      } else {
1391	        if (orientation == .landscapeLeft) {
1392	          return landscapeLeftMode();
1393	        } else {
1394	          return landscapeRightMode();
1395	        }
1396	      }
1397	    }
1398	  }

1400	  // 全屏
1401	  bool _fsProcessing = false;
1402	  Future<void> triggerFullScreen({
1403	    bool status = true,
1404	    bool inAppFullScreen = false,
1405	    DeviceOrientation? orientation,
1406	    bool isManualFS = true,
1407	  }) async {
1408	    if (isDesktopPip) return;
1409	    if (isFullScreen.value == status) return;
1410	
1411	    if (_fsProcessing) return;
1412	    _fsProcessing = true;
1413	    this.isManualFS = isManualFS;
1414	    try {
1415	      if (status) {
1416	        if (PlatformUtils.isMobile) {
1417	          hideSystemBar();
1418	          await changeOrientation(
1419	            isVertical: isVertical,
1420	            orientation: orientation,
1421	          );
1422	        } else {
1423	          await enterDesktopFullScreen(inAppFullScreen: inAppFullScreen);
1424	        }
1425	      } else {
1426	        if (PlatformUtils.isMobile) {
1427	          if (!removeSafeArea) {
1428	            showSystemBar();
1429	          }
1430	          if (orientation == null && mode == .none) {
1431	            return;
1432	          }
1433	          await resetScreenRotation();
1434	        } else {
1435	          await exitDesktopFullScreen();
1436	        }
1437	      }
1438	    } finally {
1439	      _setFullScreen(status);
1440	      _fsProcessing = false;
1441	    }
1442	  }

1460	  // 记录播放记录
1461	  Future<void>? makeHeartBeat(
1462	    int progress, {
1463	    HeartBeatType type = .playing,
1464	    bool isManual = false,
1465	    dynamic aid,
1466	    dynamic bvid,
1467	    dynamic cid,
1468	    dynamic epid,
1469	    dynamic seasonId,
1470	    dynamic pgcType,
1471	    VideoType? videoType,
1472	  }) {
1473	    if (isLive ||
1474	        !enableHeart ||
1475	        progress == 0 ||
1476	        (playerStatus.isPaused && !isManual)) {
1477	      return null;
1478	    }
1479	
1480	    Future<void> send() {
1481	      return VideoHttp.heartBeat(
1482	        aid: aid ?? _aid,
1483	        bvid: bvid ?? _bvid,
1484	        cid: cid ?? this.cid,
1485	        progress: progress,
1486	        epid: epid ?? _epid,
1487	        seasonId: seasonId ?? _seasonId,
1488	        subType: pgcType ?? _pgcType,
1489	        videoType: videoType ?? _videoType,
1490	      );
1491	    }
1492	
1493	    switch (type) {
1494	      case .playing:
1495	        if (progress - _heartDuration >= 5) {
1496	          _heartDuration = progress;
1497	          return send();
1498	        }
1499	      case .status:
1500	        if (progress - _heartDuration >= 2) {
1501	          _heartDuration = progress;
1502	          return send();
1503	        }
1504	      case .completed:
1505	        if (playerStatus.isCompleted &&
1506	            (durationInMilliseconds - positionInMilliseconds) <= 1000) {
1507	          progress = -1;
1508	        }
1509	        return send();
1510	    }
1511	    return null;
1512	  }
```

```json
152	    activeMainHostRoute: String? = null,

161	    if (cardTransitionEnabled) {

163	            return BiliPaiNavRouteTransition.NO_OP_SHARED_ELEMENT
164	        }
165	        val sharedReadyFavoriteCollectionReturn =
166	            fromKey is BiliPaiNavKey.SeasonSeriesDetail &&

172	            return BiliPaiNavRouteTransition.LIGHT_SIBLING_POP

203	    val sourceRoute = sourceMetadata.sourceRoute?.substringBefore("?") ?: return false
204	    return sourceRoute.startsWith("video/") &&
205	        videoKey.sourceRoute?.substringBefore("?") == sourceRoute &&
206	        sourceMetadata.sourceKey == "$sourceRoute:${videoKey.bvid}"
```

```json
24	        scrollOffset = scrollOffset
25	    )
26	    if (isVideoNavigating && !contentInteractionRestored) {
27	        return HomeBottomBarScrollUpdate(
28	            state = nextState,
29	            visibilityIntent = null
30	        )
31	    }
32	
33	    val intent = when {
34	        firstVisibleItem == 0 && scrollOffset < topRevealThresholdPx -> BottomBarVisibilityIntent.SHOW
35	        firstVisibleItem > previousState.firstVisibleItem -> BottomBarVisibilityIntent.HIDE
36	        firstVisibleItem < previousState.firstVisibleItem -> BottomBarVisibilityIntent.SHOW
37	        scrollOffset > previousState.scrollOffset + offsetHysteresisPx -> BottomBarVisibilityIntent.HIDE
38	        scrollOffset < previousState.scrollOffset - offsetHysteresisPx -> BottomBarVisibilityIntent.SHOW
39	        else -> null
40	    }
41	
42	    return HomeBottomBarScrollUpdate(
43	        state = nextState,
44	        visibilityIntent = intent
45	    )
46	}
47	
48	internal fun resolveBottomBarChromeScrollOffset(
49	    firstVisibleItem: Int,
50	    scrollOffset: Int,
51	    offscreenOffset: Float = 1000f
52	): Float {
53	    return if (firstVisibleItem == 0) {
54	        scrollOffset.coerceAtLeast(0).toFloat()
55	    } else {
56	        offscreenOffset
57	    }
58	}
```

```json
25	internal fun resolveHomeRecommendationHeaderCollapseMode(

28	): HomeHeaderCollapseMode {
29	    return if (commonListHeaderCollapseMode == CommonListHeaderCollapseMode.ALWAYS_VISIBLE) {
```
