36	internal fun quantizeHomeHeaderOffset(
37	    offsetPx: Float,
38	    stepPx: Float
39	): Float {
40	    if (stepPx <= 0f) return offsetPx
41	    return round(offsetPx / stepPx) * stepPx
42	}
43	
44	internal fun shouldHandleHomeVerticalPreScroll(
45	    deltaX: Float,
46	    deltaY: Float,
47	    minimumVerticalDeltaPx: Float = 0.5f
48	): Boolean {
49	    val absoluteDeltaY = abs(deltaY)
50	    if (absoluteDeltaY < minimumVerticalDeltaPx) return false
51	    return absoluteDeltaY >= abs(deltaX)
52	}
53	
54	internal fun resolveHomeHeaderSettleTransition(
55	    currentHeaderOffsetPx: Float,
56	    targetHeaderOffsetPx: Float,
57	    animationThresholdPx: Float = 0.5f
58	): HomeHeaderSettleTransition {
59	    return HomeHeaderSettleTransition(
60	        targetOffsetPx = targetHeaderOffsetPx,
61	        shouldAnimate = abs(currentHeaderOffsetPx - targetHeaderOffsetPx) > animationThresholdPx
62	    )
63	}
64	
65	internal fun resolveHomeHeaderReleaseTarget(
66	    maxHeaderCollapsePx: Float,
67	    canRevealHeader: Boolean
68	): Float {
69	    if (maxHeaderCollapsePx <= 0f || canRevealHeader) return 0f
70	    return -maxHeaderCollapsePx
71	}
72	
73	internal fun resolveHomeHeaderTransitionRunning(
74	    isFeedScrolling: Boolean,
75	    isPagerScrolling: Boolean,
76	    isHeaderSettleAnimating: Boolean
77	): Boolean {
78	    return isFeedScrolling || isPagerScrolling || isHeaderSettleAnimating
79	}
80	
81	internal fun shouldExpandHomeHeaderForSettledPage(
82	    currentHeaderOffsetPx: Float,
83	    firstVisibleItemIndex: Int,
84	    firstVisibleItemScrollOffset: Int
85	): Boolean {
86	    if (currentHeaderOffsetPx >= 0f) return false
87	    if (firstVisibleItemIndex != 0) return false
88	    return firstVisibleItemScrollOffset == 0
89	}
90	
91	internal fun resolveHomeHeaderOffsetForSettledPage(
92	    currentHeaderOffsetPx: Float,
93	    firstVisibleItemIndex: Int,
94	    firstVisibleItemScrollOffset: Int,
95	    maxHeaderCollapsePx: Float
96	): Float {
97	    if (maxHeaderCollapsePx <= 0f) return 0f
98	    return if (firstVisibleItemIndex == 0 && firstVisibleItemScrollOffset == 0) {
99	        // 目标页在顶部时保留当前折叠态，避免切到「热门」等未滚动分区时把已折叠顶栏强行展开。
100	        // 回到顶部后的展开仍由列表上滑 + canRevealHeader 驱动。
101	        currentHeaderOffsetPx.coerceIn(-maxHeaderCollapsePx, 0f)
102	    } else {
103	        -maxHeaderCollapsePx
104	    }
105	}
106	
107	internal fun reduceHomePreScroll(
108	    currentHeaderOffsetPx: Float,
109	    deltaY: Float,
110	    minHeaderOffsetPx: Float,
111	    canRevealHeader: Boolean,
112	    isHeaderCollapseEnabled: Boolean,
113	    isBottomBarAutoHideEnabled: Boolean,
114	    useSideNavigation: Boolean,
115	    liquidGlassEnabled: Boolean,
116	    currentGlobalScrollOffset: Float,
117	    bottomBarVisibilityThresholdPx: Float = 10f
118	): HomeScrollUpdate {
119	    val nextHeaderOffset = when {
120	        !isHeaderCollapseEnabled -> 0f
121	        // 搜索框和标签页只在列表回到顶部时展开。
122	        !canRevealHeader -> minHeaderOffsetPx
123	        else -> (currentHeaderOffsetPx + deltaY).coerceIn(minHeaderOffsetPx, 0f)
124	    }
125	
126	    val nextBottomBarIntent = when {
127	        !isBottomBarAutoHideEnabled || useSideNavigation -> null
128	        deltaY <= -bottomBarVisibilityThresholdPx -> BottomBarVisibilityIntent.HIDE
129	        deltaY >= bottomBarVisibilityThresholdPx -> BottomBarVisibilityIntent.SHOW
130	        else -> null
131	    }
132	
133	    return HomeScrollUpdate(
134	        headerOffsetPx = nextHeaderOffset,
135	        bottomBarVisibilityIntent = nextBottomBarIntent,
136	        globalScrollOffset = resolveNextHomeGlobalScrollOffset(
137	            currentOffset = currentGlobalScrollOffset,
138	            scrollDeltaY = deltaY,
139	            liquidGlassEnabled = liquidGlassEnabled
140	        )
141	    )
142	}

15	internal const val HOME_FEED_OFFICIAL_COVER_ASPECT_RATIO = 4f / 3f
16	
17	/** 16:10，介于 16:9 与 4:3 之间。 */
18	internal const val HOME_FEED_PILIPLUS_COVER_ASPECT_RATIO = 16f / 10f
19	
20	/** 与投稿/CDN 源同比例，标准封面几乎不裁。 */
21	internal const val HOME_FEED_FULL_COVER_ASPECT_RATIO = 16f / 9f
22	
23	/** @deprecated 使用 [HOME_FEED_FULL_COVER_ASPECT_RATIO] */
24	internal const val HOME_FEED_CURRENT_COVER_ASPECT_RATIO = HOME_FEED_FULL_COVER_ASPECT_RATIO
25	
26	/**
27	 * 解析首页/相关推荐等视频卡封面框比例。
28	 */
29	internal fun resolveHomeFeedCoverAspectRatio(
30	    style: HomeFeedCardStyle,
31	    gridColumns: Int = 2,
32	): Float {
33	    // 单列封面横跨整个内容区，4:3 / 16:10 会占用过多纵向空间；统一回到投稿源
34	    // 常见的 16:9。双列及以上继续尊重用户选择的卡片风格。
35	    if (gridColumns <= 1) return HOME_FEED_FULL_COVER_ASPECT_RATIO
36	    return when (style) {
37	        HomeFeedCardStyle.CURRENT -> HOME_FEED_FULL_COVER_ASPECT_RATIO
38	        HomeFeedCardStyle.OFFICIAL -> HOME_FEED_OFFICIAL_COVER_ASPECT_RATIO
39	        HomeFeedCardStyle.PILIPLUS -> HOME_FEED_PILIPLUS_COVER_ASPECT_RATIO
40	    }
41	}
42	
43	internal fun resolveHomeFeedCardLayout(
44	    style: HomeFeedCardStyle,
45	    gridColumns: Int = 2,
46	): HomeFeedCardLayout {
47	    val coverAspectRatio = resolveHomeFeedCoverAspectRatio(
48	        style = style,
49	        gridColumns = gridColumns,
50	    )
51	    return when (style) {
52	        HomeFeedCardStyle.CURRENT -> HomeFeedCardLayout(
53	            coverAspectRatio = coverAspectRatio,
54	            outerPaddingDp = 8,
55	            itemSpacingDp = 8,
56	            verticalItemSpacingDp = 8,
57	            storyCardHorizontalPaddingDp = 16,
58	            compactMetadata = false
59	        )
60	
61	        HomeFeedCardStyle.OFFICIAL -> HomeFeedCardLayout(
62	            coverAspectRatio = coverAspectRatio,
63	            // 4:3 cards carry more visual mass than the wider variants. Give
64	            // each card a full 8dp gutter and a little more row separation so
65	            // adjacent covers do not read as one continuous image wall.
66	            outerPaddingDp = 8,
67	            itemSpacingDp = 8,
68	            verticalItemSpacingDp = 10,
69	            storyCardHorizontalPaddingDp = 0,
70	            compactMetadata = true
71	        )
72	
73	        HomeFeedCardStyle.PILIPLUS -> HomeFeedCardLayout(
74	            // 间距对齐 PiliPlus Style.cardSpace / safeSpace 系：8dp 卡间距
75	            coverAspectRatio = coverAspectRatio,

48	        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()  // 📐 [修复] 确保在平板上填充整个屏幕
49	    ) {
50	        val sharedTransitionScope = if (enabled) this else null
51	        CompositionLocalProvider(
52	            LocalSharedTransitionScope provides sharedTransitionScope,
53	            LocalSharedTransitionEnabled provides enabled
54	        ) {
55	            content()
56	        }
57	    }
58	}
59	
60	/**
61	 *  提供 AnimatedVisibilityScope 的辅助函数
62	 * 在 NavHost 的 composable 块中调用
63	 */
64	@Composable
65	fun ProvideAnimatedVisibilityScope(
66	    animatedVisibilityScope: AnimatedVisibilityScope,
67	    content: @Composable () -> Unit
68	) {
69	    CompositionLocalProvider(LocalAnimatedVisibilityScope provides animatedVisibilityScope) {
70	        content()
71	    }
72	}

#### Thinking

I now have a very comprehensive understanding of both PiliPlus (Flutter implementation) and BiliPai (interaction patterns). Let me summarize the key findings:

**PiliPlus (Flutter reference project):**
- Uses GetX for state management
- Dio for HTTP networking
- media_kit for video playback (libmpv)
- Material 3 with flex_seed_scheme for theming
- No blur/glass effects (uses Material elevation instead)
- FloatingNavigationBar (custom, no BackdropFilter)
- Video cards with 16:10 aspect ratio
- Hive CE for storage
- canvas_danmaku for danmaku

**BiliPai interaction patterns to replicate:**
- iOS-inspired design language (colors, shapes, spacing)
- Floating pill-shaped bottom bar with Haze blur
- Per-item colors for bottom nav (iOS Blue, Orange, Teal, Pink, Green, Purple)
- Top bar with collapse-on-scroll behavior
- Category tabs with swipeable pager
- Shared element transitions for video cards
- Pull-to-refresh with Cupertino indicator
- Staggered/waterfall grid layout
- Profile page with wallpaper background, rounded content sheet
- User info with avatar, level badge, VIP badge
- Stats row (dynamic/following/follower/coin)
- iOS-style settings list

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:get/get.dart';
import 'theme/app_theme.dart';
import 'ui/app.dart';

void main() {
  runApp(const WinWinApp());
}

class WinWinApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const WinWinApp({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return GetMaterialApp(
      title: 'WinWin — BiliPai Desktop Port',
      theme: AppTheme.light,
      darkTheme: AppTheme.dark,
      home: const AppRoot(),
    );
  }
}
```

For the app.dart:
```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'components/frosted_bottom_bar.dart';
import 'home/home_page.dart';
import 'profile/profile_page.dart';

class AppRoot extends StatefulWidget {
  const AppRoot({super.key});

  @override
  State<AppRoot> createState() => _AppRootState();
}

class _AppRootState extends State<AppRoot> {
  AppPage _currentPage = AppPage.home;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      body: Stack(
        children: [
          // Page content
          IndexedStack(
            index: _currentPage == AppPage.profile ? 1 : 0,
            children: [
              const HomePage(),
              const ProfilePage(),
            ],
          ),
          // Bottom bar
          Positioned(
            bottom: 0,
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            child: FrostedBottomBar(
              currentPage: _currentPage,
              onNavigate: (page) => setState(() => _currentPage = page),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

为什么构建并运行Flutter桌面程序必须需要安装Visual Studio Installer 并添加「使用 C++ 的桌面开发」工作负载？可以只保留Visual Studio Installer 的「使用 C++ 的桌面开发」工作负载而舍弃Visual Studio IDE吗？

### **Assistant**

#### Thinking

The user is asking two questions:

1. Why does building and running a Flutter Windows desktop app require Visual Studio with the C++ desktop development workload?

2. Can they keep only the "C++ desktop development" workload via Visual Studio Installer and remove the Visual Studio IDE itself?

Let me answer these questions:

**Question 1: Why is Visual Studio C++ needed?**

Flutter Windows desktop apps are compiled to native machine code. The Windows runner is a C++ application that hosts the Flutter engine. When you run `flutter build windows` or `flutter run -d windows`, Flutter needs to:

1. Compile the C++ runner code (the files in `windows/runner/` — `main.cpp`, `flutter_window.cpp`, `win32_window.cpp`, etc.) to a native Windows executable
2. Link it against the Flutter engine DLL and Windows APIs

This C++ compilation step requires:
- MSVC compiler (cl.exe) — the C++ compiler
- Windows SDK — provides Windows API headers, libraries, and tools
- CMake — the build system (Flutter uses CMake for Windows builds, see `windows/CMakeLists.txt`)
- The linker and build tools

These are all part of the "Desktop development with C++" workload in Visual Studio Installer.

**Question 2: Can you keep just the C++ workload without the IDE?**

Yes! There are actually two options:

**Option A: Visual Studio Build Tools (recommended for this use case)**

Visual Studio Build Tools is a standalone installer that provides the MSVC compiler, Windows SDK, CMake, and build tools WITHOUT the Visual Studio IDE. This is the lighter option — you get everything Flutter needs without the IDE.

You can install it via:
- Download from https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/visual-cpp-build-tools/
- Or via winget: `winget install Microsoft.VisualStudio.2022.BuildTools`

When installing Build Tools, you select the same "Desktop development with C++" workload, but you don't get the IDE (devenv.exe).

**Option B: Visual Studio Community with only the C++ workload**

Visual Studio Community is the full IDE. When you install it with only the "Desktop development with C++" workload, you get:
- The IDE (devenv.exe) — which you can just ignore
- MSVC compiler
- Windows SDK
- CMake

The IDE takes up additional disk space (~several GB) compared to just the Build Tools. But functionally, it provides the same C++ compilation capability.

**Can you "remove" the IDE after installation?**

Not really — the IDE and the build tools are bundled in the same installation. You can't uninstall just the IDE part. But you have options:

1. If you already installed Visual Studio Community with C++ workload → just don't open the IDE. The build tools work independently. Flutter only calls the compiler and CMake, it doesn't use the IDE.

2. If you want to save disk space → uninstall Visual Studio Community and install Visual Studio Build Tools instead (selecting the same "Desktop development with C++" workload). Build Tools provides exactly what Flutter needs without the IDE overhead.

Actually, let me be more precise. Visual Studio Installer installs "workloads" which are collections of components. The "Desktop development with C++" workload includes:
- MSVC v143 (or v180 in VS 2026) C++ x64/x86 build tools
- Windows SDK
- C++ CMake tools for Windows
- And optionally the IDE if you're using Visual Studio Community/Professional/Enterprise

If you use Visual Studio Build Tools (not Community), you get the same C++ tools without the IDE. The Build Tools edition doesn't include the IDE at all.

Let me give a clear answer to the user.

两个好问题。

## 为什么 Flutter Windows 需要它

Flutter Windows 桌面应用的 runner 是一个 C++ 程序。`windows/runner/` 目录下的 `main.cpp`、`flutter_window.cpp`、`win32_window.cpp` 等文件需要编译成原生 Windows 可执行文件（`.exe`），然后链接 Flutter 引擎 DLL 和 Windows API。这个编译步骤需要：

- **MSVC 编译器**（`cl.exe`）— 编译 C++ 源码到机器码
- **Windows SDK** — 提供 Windows API 头文件和链接库
- **CMake** — Flutter 的 Windows 构建系统（`windows/CMakeLists.txt`）

这三样东西都打包在「使用 C++ 的桌面开发」工作负载里。Dart 代码本身不需要它，但 C++ runner 需要。

## 可以只保留 C++ 工作负载而舍弃 IDE 吗

可以，而且有一个专门为此设计的产品：**Visual Studio Build Tools**。

微软提供了两个安装器：

**Visual Studio Community** — 你现在装的。包含 IDE（`devenv.exe`）+ C++ 工作负载。IDE 约占 3-5GB 额外空间。Flutter 只调用 MSVC 编译器和 CMake，完全不启动 IDE。

**Visual Studio Build Tools** — 轻量版安装器。只提供 MSVC 编译器 + Windows SDK + CMake，**不含 IDE**。安装时同样选择「使用 C++ 的桌面开发」工作负载即可。Flutter 检测到的是同一套工具链，功能完全一致。

如果你不需要用 Visual Studio IDE 写 C++ 代码，可以卸载 Community 改装 Build Tools 来节省空间：

```
winget install Microsoft.VisualStudio.2022.BuildTools
```

安装时勾选「使用 C++ 的桌面开发」工作负载。Flutter doctor 会显示同样的 `[√] Visual Studio` 检测结果。

**但如果你后续还打算用 Visual Studio IDE 做 WinUI 3 / WPF 的 C# 开发**（比如 Bili.Copilot 那条路线），就保留 Community 不要卸——同一个安装里 C++ 和 C# 工作负载共存，不冲突。

请再依据PiliPlus项目和BiliPai项目，将二者项目中适合Flutter框架的后端的各实现按照分类制定新的阶段性计划，依次实现到本项目中。本项目仍然按照BiliPai项目的前端为主进行设计。请开始制定移植和开发阶段性计划。

# PiliPlus Backend/Service Layer Analysis

## 1. HTTP/API Layer

### Files
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\http\init.dart` -- Dio configuration and Request singleton
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\http\api.dart` -- ~1000 lines of endpoint URL constants
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\http\constants.dart` -- Base URLs
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\http\loading_state.dart` -- Sealed result type
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\http\retry_interceptor.dart` -- Retry + redirect interceptor
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\http\error_msg.dart` -- Error code map
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\http\video.dart` -- Video API domain (recommend, playurl, like, coin, etc.)
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\http\user.dart` -- User API domain (info, history, favorites, etc.)
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\http\login.dart` -- Auth/login API domain
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\http\browser_ua.dart` -- PC/mobile browser User-Agent strings

### Dio Configuration (`init.dart`)

**Class `Request`** is a singleton (`Request._internal()` / `factory Request() => _instance`) wrapping a static `Dio dio`.

Key configuration in `BaseOptions`:
- `baseUrl`: `https://api.bilibili.com` (from `HttpString.apiBaseUrl`)
- `connectTimeout` / `receiveTimeout`: 10 seconds each
- Default headers: `user-agent: Dart/3.6 (dart:io)`, `accept-encoding: br,gzip`
- `persistentConnection: true`
- Custom `responseDecoder` that handles gzip (via `archive` package) and brotli (via `brotli` package) decompression manually, because `Http2Adapter` doesn't auto-decompress
- `validateStatus`: accepts 200-299 only

**HTTP/2 support**: Optional via `Pref.enableHttp2`. When enabled, uses `Http2Adapter` (from `dio_http2_adapter`) with a `ConnectionManager` and a fallback `IOHttpClientAdapter` for HTTP/1.1. The `http11Dio` getter provides a cloned Dio instance for HTTP/1.1-only requests.

**System proxy support**: When `Pref.enableSystemProxy` is set, configures `HttpClient.findProxy` and `badCertificateCallback` accordingly.

**Network change handling**: On iOS, listens to `connectivity_plus` and resets adapters on network change (debounced 500ms).

### Interceptors

1. **`AccountManager`** (in `lib/utils/accounts/account_manager/account_mgr.dart`) -- The main interceptor, extends `Interceptor`:
   - `onRequest`: Determines which account to use (via `options.extra['account']` or `_findAccount(path)` which maps API paths to `AccountType`). For app.bilibili.com requests with byte response, injects gRPC headers. For web requests, loads cookies from the `DefaultCookieJar`. For app API requests, injects `access_key` and calls `AppSign.appSign()`.
   - `onResponse`: Saves `Set-Cookie` headers back to the cookie jar.
   - `onError`: Toasts errors (with a skip-list for heartbeat etc.), saves cookies from error responses.

2. **`RetryInterceptor`** (in `retry_interceptor.dart`):
   - Retries on `connectionError`, `connectionTimeout`, `sendTimeout`, `unknown` (but NOT `TransportConnectionException`).
   - Handles HTTP 3xx redirects manually (follows `Location` header, decrements `maxRedirects`).
   - Configurable count and delay from `Pref.retryCount` / `Pref.retryDelay`.

3. **`LogInterceptor`** -- Only in debug mode, logs responses.

### API Endpoints (`api.dart`)

**Class `Api`** is an `abstract final class` with ~200+ `static const String` endpoint paths. Endpoints are relative paths (e.g., `/x/web-interface/wbi/index/top/feed/rcmd`) or full URLs with different base domains (e.g., `${HttpString.appBaseUrl}/x/v2/feed/index` for app APIs, `${HttpString.liveBaseUrl}/xlive/...` for live APIs).

Base URLs (`constants.dart` -- class `HttpString`):
- `apiBaseUrl`: `https://api.bilibili.com`
- `appBaseUrl`: `https://app.bilibili.com`
- `liveBaseUrl`: `https://api.live.bilibili.com`
- `passBaseUrl`: `https://passport.bilibili.com`
- `tUrl`: `https://api.vc.bilibili.com`
- `messageBaseUrl`: `https://message.bilibili.com`
- `spaceBaseUrl`, `accountBaseUrl`, `mallBaseUrl`, `dynamicShareBaseUrl`
- `sponsorBlockBaseUrl`: `https://www.bsbsb.top`

### LoadingState Pattern (`loading_state.dart`)

A sealed class hierarchy:
```dart
sealed class LoadingState<T> {
  factory LoadingState.loading() => const Loading._internal();
  bool get isSuccess;
  T get data;       // throws if not Success
  T? get dataOrNull; // returns null if not Success
  Future<void> toast();
}
class Loading extends LoadingState<Never> { ... }
class Success<T> extends LoadingState<T> { final T response; }
class Error extends LoadingState<Never> { final int? code; final String? errMsg; }
```

All API methods return `Future<LoadingState<T>>`. The pattern is:
```dart
final res = await Request().get(url, queryParameters: params);
if (res.data['code'] == 0) {
  return Success(SomeModel.fromJson(res.data['data']));
} else {
  return Error(res.data['message']);
}
```

### Domain API Files Pattern

Each domain file (e.g., `video.dart`, `user.dart`) is an `abstract final class` (e.g., `VideoHttp`, `UserHttp`) with static async methods. Each method:
1. Builds params (optionally WBI-signed via `WbiSign.makSign()` or app-signed via `AppSign.appSign()`)
2. Calls `Request().get()` or `Request().post()`
3. Checks `res.data['code'] == 0`
4. Returns `Success(parsedModel)` or `Error(message)`

**Dependencies**: `dio`, `dio_http2_adapter`, `brotli`, `archive`, `connectivity_plus`, `flutter_smart_dialog` (for toasts), `cookie_jar`.

### Reusability Assessment
- **Directly copyable**: `loading_state.dart`, `api.dart`, `constants.dart`, `error_msg.dart`, `retry_interceptor.dart`, `browser_ua.dart` -- These are self-contained or have minimal dependencies.
- **Needs adaptation**: `init.dart` -- Tightly coupled to `AccountManager`, `Pref`, `GlobalData`, `Accounts`. The core Dio setup is reusable but the interceptor wiring needs the accounts system ported first.

## 2. Authentication

### Files
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\utils\accounts\account.dart` -- Account sealed class hierarchy
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\utils\accounts.dart` -- Account registry and management
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\utils\accounts\account_manager\account_mgr.dart` -- Dio interceptor for auth
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\utils\accounts\api_type.dart` -- Maps API paths to AccountTypes
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\utils\accounts\grpc_headers.dart` -- gRPC metadata headers
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\utils\wbi_sign.dart` -- WBI signature (web API signing)
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\utils\app_sign.dart` -- App API signing (MD5)
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\utils\login_utils.dart` -- Login flow, buvid generation, device ID
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\utils\id_utils.dart` -- BV<->AV conversion, buvid3, aurora_eid, trace_id
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\http\login.dart` -- Login HTTP API methods
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\services\account_service.dart` -- GetX service for login state
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\models\common\account_type.dart` -- AccountType enum

### Cookie Management

**Account hierarchy** (`account.dart`):
- `sealed class Account` -- base with `accessKey`, `cookieJar`, `csrf`, `headers`, `grpcHeaders`, `isLogin`, `mid`
- `LoginAccount` (Hive type 9) -- Stores a `DefaultCookieJar` (from `cookie_jar` package), `accessKey`, `refreshToken`, and a `Set<AccountType>` of roles. The `csrf` is extracted from the `bili_jct` cookie. The `mid` is parsed from the `DedeUserID` cookie.
- `AnonymousAccount` -- Singleton with an empty cookie jar that has a generated `buvid3` cookie.
- `NoAccount` -- Sentinel for "skip auth entirely"

**Multi-account system** (`Accounts`):
- 4 account roles: `main`, `heartbeat`, `recommend`, `video` (defined in `AccountType` enum)
- Stored in a Hive box `'account'` as `LoginAccount` objects
- `Accounts.refresh()` populates `accountMode[]` from stored accounts and activates buvid
- `ApiType.apiTypeSet` maps specific API endpoint strings to AccountType, so the interceptor knows which account to use per-request

**Cookie persistence**: Cookies are stored as part of the `LoginAccount` Hive object (via `BiliCookieJarAdapter`). The `AccountManager` interceptor's `onResponse` saves `Set-Cookie` headers back to the jar and calls `account.onChange()` which persists to Hive.

**Web view sync**: `LoginUtils.setWebCookie()` syncs cookies to `flutter_inappwebview`'s `CookieManager` for webview-based login flows.

### WBI Signing (`wbi_sign.dart`)

**Class `WbiSign`** -- Implements Bilibili's WBI signature for web API requests:
1. Fetches `wbi_img` URLs from `Api.userInfo` (the `/x/web-interface/nav` endpoint)
2. Extracts `img_key` and `sub_key` from the URLs (filename without extension)
3. Concatenates them and applies a fixed permutation table (`_mixinKeyEncTab`, 32 indices) to get the `mixinKey`
4. For signing: adds `wts` (unix timestamp) to params, sorts keys alphabetically, URL-encodes values (removing certain characters), joins as query string, appends `mixinKey`, and MD5-hashes to get `w_rid`
5. Caches the `mixinKey` in Hive's `localCache` box, refreshing daily

### App Signing (`app_sign.dart`)

**Class `AppSign`** -- Implements Bilibili's app API signing:
1. Adds `appkey` (from `Constants.appKey`) and `ts` (unix timestamp) to params
2. Sorts entries alphabetically
3. Builds a query string (URL-encoding each key/value)
4. Appends `appsec` (from `Constants.appSec`)
5. MD5-hashes to get `sign`

### Token Storage

Tokens (`accessKey`, `refresh`) are stored as `@HiveField` annotations on the `LoginAccount` Hive type. The `cookieJar` (containing all cookies including `SESSDATA`, `bili_jct`/csrf, `DedeUserID`) is also stored as a Hive field via a custom `BiliCookieJarAdapter`.

### gRPC Headers (`grpc_headers.dart`)

**Class `GrpcHeaders`** -- Builds binary metadata headers for gRPC requests:
- `x-bili-metadata-bin`: Base64-encoded `Metadata` protobuf (accessKey, mobiApp, device, build, channel, buvid, platform)
- `x-bili-device-bin`: Base64-encoded `Device` protobuf
- `x-bili-network-bin`: Network type
- `x-bili-locale-bin`: Locale info
- `x-bili-fawkes-req-bin`: Fawkes request info
- `authorization`: `identify_v1 <accessKey>` when logged in
- Plus `user-agent`, `x-bili-trace-id`, `buvid`, `grpc-encoding: gzip`

### Login Flow (`login.dart`)

**Class `LoginHttp`** supports:
- **TV QR code login**: `getHDcode()` -> `codePoll()` (uses app signing)
- **App password login**: RSA-encrypts password with server-provided key, app-signs params
- **App SMS login**: App-signs params with captcha key
- **Web password login**: `getWebKey()` for RSA key/salt
- **Risk control flow**: `safeCenterGetInfo()` -> `preCapture()` -> `safeCenterSmsCode()` -> `safeCenterSmsVerify()` -> `oauth2AccessToken()`
- **Logout**: Posts `biliCSRF` to logout endpoint

### Key Constants (`constants.dart`)

**Class `Constants`**:
- `appKey`: `dfca71928277209b` (HD version)
- `appSec`: `b5475a8825547a4fc26c7d518eaaa02e` (TV version -- note: these appear swapped vs typical usage)
- `traceId`: fixed 32+16 char hex pattern
- `userAgent`: `Mozilla/5.0 BiliDroid/2.0.1 ... mobi_app/android_hd build/2001100`
- `statistics`: `{"appId":5,"platform":3,"version":"2.0.1","abtest":""}`
- `baseHeaders`: `{'env': 'prod', 'app-key': 'android64', 'x-bili-aurora-zone': 'sh001'}`

### ID Utils (`id_utils.dart`)

**Class `IdUtils`**:
- `av2bv(int aid)` / `bv2av(String bvid)` -- BV/AV conversion using XOR cipher with base-58 encoding
- `genBuvid3()` -- UUID v4 + random digits + "infoc" suffix
- `genAuroraEid(int uid)` -- XORs mid bytes with key `ad1va46a7lza`, base64 encodes
- `genTraceId()` -- 24 random chars + timestamp-derived 6 hex chars + 2 random chars

### Reusability Assessment
- **Directly copyable**: `wbi_sign.dart`, `app_sign.dart`, `id_utils.dart`, `login_utils.dart`, `grpc_headers.dart`, `account_type.dart`, `api_type.dart` -- These are pure logic with minimal Flutter dependencies (crypto, uuid, cookie_jar).
- **Needs adaptation**: `account.dart` (Hive adapters), `account_mgr.dart` (Dio interceptor, tightly coupled to `Accounts`, `Pref`, `SmartDialog`), `account_service.dart` (GetX-specific).

## 3. Storage

### Files
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\utils\storage.dart` -- Hive CE initialization and box management
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\utils\storage_pref.dart` -- ~1000 lines of preference getters/setters
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\utils\storage_key.dart` -- String key constants for settings

### Hive CE Configuration (`storage.dart`)

**Class `GStorage`** -- Static initializer:
- `Hive.init(path.join(appSupportDirPath, 'hive'))` -- Stores in app support directory
- Registers custom adapters: `OwnerAdapter`, `UserInfoDataAdapter`, `LevelInfoAdapter`, `BiliCookieJarAdapter`, `LoginAccountAdapter`, `AccountTypeAdapter`, `SetIntAdapter`, `RuleFilterAdapter`
- Opens 7 boxes in parallel via `Future.wait`:
  - `userInfo` (type `Box<UserInfoData>`) -- Cached logged-in user info
  - `localCache` (type `Box<dynamic>`) -- WBI mixin key, timestamps, black mids, buvid, danmaku filter rules
  - `setting` (type `Box<dynamic>`) -- All app settings
  - `historyWord` (type `Box<dynamic>`) -- Search history
  - `video` (type `Box<dynamic>`) -- Player-specific settings (speed, repeat mode)
  - `watchProgress` (type `Box<int>`) -- Video watch progress by CID
  - `reply` (type `Box<Uint8List>?`) -- Cached protobuf reply data (optional, based on `Pref.saveReply`)
- Also opens the `account` box via `Accounts.init()`
- Compaction strategies vary per box (e.g., `deletedEntries > 2` for userInfo, `> 10` for historyWord)
- `watchProgress` and `reply` use a custom `_intStrDescKeyComparator` for descending key ordering
- Provides `exportAllSettings()` / `importAllSettings()` for settings backup/restore

### Preference System (`storage_pref.dart`)

**Class `Pref`** -- An `abstract final class` with ~200+ static getters/setters backed by three Hive boxes (`_setting`, `_video`, `_localCache`). Categories include:

- **Player settings**: `defaultVideoQa`, `defaultAudioQa`, `preferCodecs`, `hardwareDecoding`, `videoSync`, `autosync`, `bufferSize`, `bufferSec`, `initBuffer()` (returns MPV cache options map), `initLiveBuffer()`, `audioOutput`, `playSpeedDefault`, `longPressSpeedDefault`, `playRepeat`, `superResolutionType`
- **Danmaku settings**: `enableShowDanmaku`, `danmakuFontScale`, `danmakuOpacity`, `danmakuShowArea`, `danmakuDuration`, `danmakuWeight`, `danmakuBlockType`, `danmakuStrokeWidth`, `danmakuFontWeight`, `mergeDanmaku`, `showVipDanmaku`, etc.
- **Subtitle settings**: `subtitlePreferenceV2`, `subtitleFontScale`, `subtitlePaddingH/B`, `subtitleBgOpacity`, `subtitleStrokeWidth`, `subtitleFontWeight`
- **Network settings**: `enableHttp2`, `enableSystemProxy`, `systemProxyHost/Port`, `badCertificateCallback`, `retryCount`, `retryDelay`
- **UI/Theme**: `themeType`, `themeMode`, `schemeVariant`, `dynamicColor`, `customColor`, `horizontalScreen`, `uiScale`, `defaultTextScale`
- **Content filters**: `banWordForRecommend`, `banWordForReply`, `banWordForZone`, `banWordForDyn`, `minDurationForRcmd`, `minPlayForRcmd`, `minLikeRatioForRecommend`, `appRcmd`
- **Live settings**: `liveQuality`, `liveQualityCellular`, `liveCdnUrl`, `liveStream`
- **SponsorBlock**: `enableSponsorBlock`, `blockSettings`, `blockColor`, `blockServer`, `blockUserID`, `blockLimit`
- **Desktop**: `windowSize`, `windowPosition`, `isWindowMaximized`, `desktopVolume`, `showTrayIcon`, `showWindowTitleBar`, `keyboardControl`
- **WebDAV**: `webdavUri`, `webdavUsername`, `webdavPassword`, `webdavDirectory`

### Storage Keys (`storage_key.dart`)

Three abstract final classes of string constants:
- `SettingBoxKey` -- ~150 setting keys
- `LocalCacheKey` -- 6 keys: `historyPause`, `blackMids`, `danmakuFilterRules`, `mixinKey`, `timeStamp`, `buvid`
- `VideoBoxKey` -- 5 keys: `playRepeat`, `playSpeedDefault`, `longPressSpeedDefault`, `speedsList`, `cacheVideoFit`

### Dependencies
- `hive_ce` (^2.19.3)
- `path` (^1.9.1)
- `path_provider` (^2.1.5)
- Custom Hive adapters (in `lib/utils/accounts/` and `lib/utils/`)

### Reusability Assessment
- **Directly copyable**: `storage_key.dart` -- Pure string constants.
- **Needs adaptation**: `storage.dart` -- Requires porting all custom Hive adapters. The box structure is clean and reusable. `storage_pref.dart` -- Enormous but mostly self-contained; some getters reference UI enums and player models.

## 5. gRPC

### Files
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\grpc\grpc_req.dart` -- Core gRPC request infrastructure
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\grpc\url.dart` -- gRPC endpoint paths
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\grpc\dm.dart` -- Danmaku gRPC service
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\grpc\view.dart` -- Video view gRPC service
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\grpc\reply.dart` -- Reply/comment gRPC service
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\grpc\dyn.dart` -- Dynamics gRPC service
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\grpc\space.dart` -- User space gRPC service
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\grpc\audio.dart`, `im.dart`, `bilibili/` -- Additional services and generated protobuf files

### Architecture

**Class `GrpcReq`** (`grpc_req.dart`) -- Does NOT use a real gRPC channel. Instead, it sends protobuf payloads via **Dio POST** to `app.bilibili.com` with `Content-Type: application/grpc`:

1. **Compression** (`compressProtobuf`): If payload > 64 bytes, gzip-compresss it. Prepends a 5-byte gRPC framing header (1 byte compress flag + 4 bytes big-endian length).
2. **Decompression** (`decompressProtobuf`): Reads the 5-byte header, decompresses if flag is set.
3. **Request**: `Request().post()` with `Options(contentType: 'application/grpc', responseType: ResponseType.bytes)`.
4. **Response parsing**: Checks `Grpc-Status` header. If '0', decompresses and parses via the provided `grpcParser` function. Supports isolate parsing for large responses (>256KB).
5. **Error handling**: Parses `Grpc-Status-Details-Bin` header as a `Status` protobuf message.

**gRPC URLs** (`url.dart` -- class `GrpcUrl`):
- Dynamics: `DynRed`, `OpusDetail`, `OpusSpaceFlow`
- Danmaku: `DmSegMobile` (segment danmaku), `DmView`
- Reply: `MainList`, `DetailList`, `DialogList`, `SearchItem`, `TranslateReply`
- IM: `SendMsg`, `SessionMain`, `SessionSecondary`, `ClearUnread`, etc.
- View: `View` (unified video detail)
- Audio: `PlayURL`, `Playlist`, `ThumbUp`, `TripleLike`, `CoinAdd`
- Space: `SearchArchive`

### Service Pattern

Each service file (e.g., `dm.dart`) is an `abstract final class` with static methods:
```dart
static Future<LoadingState<DmSegMobileReply>> dmSegMobile({
  required int cid,
  required int segmentIndex,
}) => GrpcReq.request(GrpcUrl.dmSegMobile, DmSegMobileReq(...), DmSegMobileReply.fromBuffer, isolate: true);
```

- `metadata.pb.dart`, `metadata/device.pb.dart`, `metadata/fawkes.pb.dart`, `metadata/locale.pb.dart`, `metadata/network.pb.dart`
- `rpc.pb.dart` (Status message for error handling)

- Service-specific: `community/service/dm/v1.pb.dart`, `main/community/reply/v1.pb.dart`, `app/dynamic/v1.pb.dart`, `app/dynamic/v2.pb.dart`, `app/viewunite/v1.pb.dart`, `app/interfaces/v1.pb.dart`, `app/listener/v1.pb.dart`, `im/...`

- `fixnum` (^1.1.1) -- For Int64
- `archive` (^4.0.0) -- For gzip compression/decompression

## 6. Danmaku Protocol

### Files
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\grpc\dm.dart` -- gRPC danmaku segment fetch
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\pages\danmaku\controller.dart` -- Danmaku segment management
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\pages\danmaku\danmaku_model.dart` -- Danmaku extra data models
- `D:\Documents\GitHub\PiliPlus\lib\tcp\live.dart` -- Live danmaku binary WebSocket protocol

### Video Danmaku (gRPC)

**Class `DmGrpc`** (`grpc/dm.dart`):
- `dmSegMobile(cid, segmentIndex)` -- Fetches a 6-minute segment of danmaku via gRPC. Returns `DmSegMobileReply` protobuf containing `List<DanmakuElem>`.
- `dmView(aid, cid)` -- Fetches danmaku view metadata.

**Class `PlDanmakuController`** (`pages/danmaku/controller.dart`):
- Segments are 360,000ms (6 minutes) each (`segmentLength = 60 * 6 * 1000`)
- `queryDanmaku(segmentIndex)`: Fetches via gRPC, stores `DanmakuElem` list in a `HashMap<int, List<DanmakuElem>>` keyed by `progress ~/ 100` (100ms resolution)
- Handles merging duplicate danmaku, filtering (via `RuleFilter`), and self-detection (via `midHash`)
- `getCurrentDanmaku(progress)`: Returns the list for the current 100ms bucket, triggering async fetch for unrequested segments

### Live Danmaku (Binary WebSocket Protocol)

**File `tcp/live.dart`** -- Implements the Bilibili live room binary protocol:

**`PackageHeader` / `PackageHeaderRes`** -- 16-byte binary header:
- Bytes 0-3: Total packet size (big-endian int32)
- Bytes 4-5: Header size (0x10 = 16, big-endian int16)
- Bytes 6-7: Protocol version (big-endian int16) -- 1=plain JSON, 2=zlib compressed, 3=brotil compressed
- Bytes 8-11: Operation code (big-endian int32) -- 7=auth, 8=auth reply, 2=heartbeat, 3=heartbeat reply, 5=message
- Bytes 12-15: Sequence number (big-endian int32)

**Packet types**:
- `AuthPackage` -- JSON body with roomid, uid, protover, platform, type, key. Marshalled as header + JSON bytes.
- `HeartbeatPackage` -- Empty body, just the header.

**`LiveMessageStream`**:
- Connects via `WebSocketChannel` to danmaku server URLs
- Sends auth package, listens for messages
- `_processingData()`: Parses header, extracts body. For protocol version 1, body is plain JSON. For version 2, body is zlib-compressed. For version 3, body is brotli-compressed.
- Recursive parsing handles multiple packets in a single WebSocket frame
- 30-second heartbeat timer

### Dependencies
- `web_socket_channel` (^3.0.3) -- For live danmaku WebSocket
- `protobuf` -- For gRPC danmaku
- `brotli` -- For live danmaku decompression
- `archive` -- For zlib (via `GZipDecoder`)

### Reusability Assessment
- **Directly copyable**: `tcp/live.dart` (binary protocol parser), `grpc/dm.dart`, `pages/danmaku/controller.dart` (segment management logic), `pages/danmaku/danmaku_model.dart`. The `live.dart` file is largely self-contained.
- **Needs adaptation**: The `PlDanmakuController` depends on `PlPlayerController` for callbacks, but the core segment fetching and caching logic is reusable.

### MediaKit Initialization

In `main.dart`:
```dart
void main() async {
  ScaledWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
  MediaKit.ensureInitialized();  // <-- Initializes media_kit
  ...
}

### Player Creation (`controller.dart`, `_initPlayer()` at line 729)

```dart
Future<Player> _initPlayer() async {
  final opt = {
    'video-sync': Pref.videoSync,           // default: 'display-resample'
    if (Platform.isAndroid) 'ao': Pref.audioOutput,
    'volume': (mobile ? Pref.playerVolume : volume.value * 100).toString(),
    'volume-max': kMaxVolume.toString(),
  };
  if (Pref.autosync != '0') opt['autosync'] = Pref.autosync;

  final player = await Player.create(
    configuration: PlayerConfiguration(
      logLevel: kDebugMode ? MPVLogLevel.warn : MPVLogLevel.error,
      options: opt,  // MPV options passed at creation
    ),
  );

  _videoController = await VideoController.create(
    player,
    configuration: VideoControllerConfiguration(
      enableHardwareAcceleration: hwdec != null,
      androidAttachSurfaceAfterVideoParameters: false,
      hwdec: hwdec,  // from HwDecType enum, e.g. 'mediacodec,auto-safe' on Android
    ),
  );

  player.setMediaHeader(userAgent: BrowserUa.pc, referer: HttpString.baseUrl);
  _startListeners(player);
  return player;
}
```

### MPV Options

Key configurable MPV properties:
- `video-sync`: `display-resample` (default)
- `ao` (audio output): Android-specific, from `AudioOutput` enum
- `volume` / `volume-max`: Player volume
- `autosync`: `0` on desktop, `30` on Android (default)
- `hwdec`: Hardware decoder (from `HwDecType` enum -- `mediacodec,auto-safe` on Android, `auto` on other platforms)
- Buffer options (passed as media extras, not MPV properties):
  - `cache: yes`
  - `cache-secs`: `Pref.bufferSec * playbackSpeed` (default 16.0)
  - `demuxer-hysteresis-secs`: `cache-secs / 1.5`
  - `demuxer-max-bytes` / `demuxer-max-back-bytes`: `Pref.bufferSize * 0x100000` (default 4.0 * 1MB)
- Live buffer: `demuxer-max-back-bytes: 0`

### Video/Audio Stream Handling

For DASH streams with separate audio/video, uses MPV's EDL (Edit Decision List) format:
```
edl://!no_clip;!no_chapters;%<video_length>%<video_url>;!new_stream;!no_clip;!no_chapters;%<audio_length>%<audio_url>
```

### Data Sources (`data_source.dart`)

- `sealed class DataSource` with `videoSource` and `audioSource`
- `NetworkSource` -- URLs from API
- `FileSource` -- Local file paths for downloaded content

### Dependencies
- `media_kit: 1.1.11` (with forked dependency overrides for custom version 1.2.5)
- `media_kit_libs_video: 1.0.5`
- `media_kit_video: 1.2.5`

### Reusability Assessment
- **Directly copyable**: `data_source.dart`, `hwdec_type.dart`, and other model files in `pl_player/models/`.
- **Needs adaptation**: `controller.dart` is heavily coupled to `PlPlayerController` (GetxController pattern), `Pref`, `GStorage`, danmaku controllers, and the full app architecture. The MPV configuration approach (`_initPlayer()`, buffer settings, EDL construction) is reusable as a pattern but needs to be extracted from the monolithic controller.

# BiliPai Backend Business Logic Files -- Flutter Porting Analysis

## 1. Network Signing

### `WbiUtils.kt`
**Path:** `D:\Documents\GitHub\BiliPai\app\src\main\java\com\android\purebilibili\core\network\WbiUtils.kt`

**Pure Kotlin?** Mostly. The only non-pure dependency is `com.android.purebilibili.core.util.Logger.d(...)` (a single logging call). All actual signing logic uses only `java.net.URLEncoder`, `java.security.MessageDigest`, and standard Kotlin -- no Android imports.

**Algorithm:**
1. Takes `imgKey + subKey`, applies a fixed 64-element permutation table (`mixinKeyEncTab`) to extract a 32-character "mixin key".
2. Adds `wts` (current Unix epoch seconds) to the params map.
3. Optionally injects 4 risk-fingerprint parameters (`dm_img_list`, `dm_img_str`, `dm_cover_img_str`, `dm_img_inter`).
4. Filters illegal characters `[!'()*]` from values.
5. Sorts all keys alphabetically.
6. Builds query string using `encodeURIComponent` (URL-encode with `+` -> `%20`, `*` -> `%2A`, `%7E` -> `~`).
7. Appends the mixin key to the query string, then takes MD5 hex digest -> that's `w_rid`.
8. Returns the original (unencoded) params plus `w_rid`.

**Constants:**
- `mixinKeyEncTab`: 64-element `intArray` of indices (lines 8-12).
- Risk fingerprint values: hardcoded base64 strings for `dm_img_str` / `dm_cover_img_str` (WebGL/Angle fingerprint strings).

**Dart translation needs:**
- A `md5` package (e.g. `crypto` or `pointycastle`).
- Manual implementation of the permutation table lookup.
- `Uri.encodeQueryComponent` substitute matching the exact encoding rules.
- Remove or replace the Logger call.

**Priority: HIGH** -- WBI signing is mandatory for all Bilibili Web API calls (search, video info, playurl, comments, etc.).

---

### `AppSignUtils.kt`
**Path:** `D:\Documents\GitHub\BiliPai\app\src\main\java\com\android\purebilibili\core\network\AppSignUtils.kt`

**Pure Kotlin?** Yes -- fully pure. Uses only `java.net.URLEncoder`, `java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets`, `java.security.MessageDigest`.

**Algorithm:**
- Sorts params by key, builds `key=value&key=value` query string, appends `appSec`, then MD5.
- Three variants:
  - `signForTvLogin`: plain query string + `TV_APP_SEC` (no URL-encoding of values).
  - `signForAndroidApi`: plain query string + `ANDROID_APP_SEC`.
  - `signForAndroidHdLogin`: percent-encodes both key and value (`+` -> `%20`) before MD5.
- `createLoginSessionId`: `md5(buvid + timestampMillis)`.

**Constants (hardcoded appkey/appsec pairs):**
| Credential | appkey | appsec |
|---|---|---|
| TV (cloud TV) | `4409e2ce8ffd12b8` | `59b43e04ad6965f34319062b478f83dd` |
| Android client | `1d8b6e7d45233436` | `560c52ccd288fed045859ed18bffd973` |
| Android HD | `dfca71928277209b` | `b5475a8825547a4fc26c7d518eaaa02e` |

**Dart translation needs:**
- Same MD5 package as WbiUtils.
- `percentEncode` function matching `+` -> `%20` semantics.
- Straightforward 1:1 port -- no Android dependencies at all.

**Priority: HIGH** -- required for TV login flow and APP API playurl requests (higher quality streams).

---

### `WbiKeyManager.kt` (companion)
**Path:** `D:\Documents\GitHub\BiliPai\app\src\main\java\com\android\purebilibili\core\network\WbiKeyManager.kt`

**Pure Kotlin?** No -- uses `android.content.Context`, `SharedPreferences`, and `android.util.Log`. The caching logic itself (mutex, timestamp, validity check) is pure.

**Logic:** Fetches `img_key` and `sub_key` from the `/x/web-interface/nav` API (the `WbiImg` fields in `NavResponse`), extracts the filename without extension from the URL, caches for 24 hours with a 1-hour pre-refresh window, persists to SharedPreferences.

## 2. gRPC Protocol

### `ProtoWire.kt`
**Path:** `D:\Documents\GitHub\BiliPai\app\src\main\java\com\android\purebilibili\core\network\grpc\ProtoWire.kt`

**Pure Kotlin?** Yes -- fully pure. Uses only `java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream`, `java.nio.ByteBuffer`, `java.util.zip.GZIPInputStream/GZIPOutputStream`.

**Implementation:**
- A complete hand-rolled protobuf wire format codec (no .proto files, no generated code).
- **Wire types:** `VARINT=0`, `FIXED64=1`, `LENGTH_DELIMITED=2`, `FIXED32=5`.
- **Encoding functions:** `int64()`, `int32()`, `bool()`, `string()`, `bytes()`, `double()` -- each emits `(field_number << 3 | wire_type)` tag + payload.
- **Varint encoding:** Standard LEB128 7-bit groups with MSB continuation bit.
- **gRPC framing:** 1 byte compressed flag + 4-byte big-endian length + payload. Gzip compression if message > 64 bytes.
- **Parsing:** `parseFields()` returns `List<Field>` with tag/varint/bytes/fixed64/fixed32. `Reader` class handles varint reading, fixed64/fixed32 in little-endian.
- **CESU-8 tolerance:** Custom UTF-8 decoder that handles CESU-8 surrogate pairs (B站 sometimes encodes non-BMP characters as 6-byte surrogate pairs instead of 4-byte UTF-8). This is a unique Bilibili-specific quirk.

**Dart translation needs:**
- Dart's `ByteBuffer` / `ByteData` for manual byte manipulation.
- `dart:io` `GZipCodec` for compression/decompression.
- The CESU-8 tolerant decoder is the trickiest part -- needs careful porting using `Utf8Decoder` or manual byte manipulation.
- All field encoding/parsing is straightforward arithmetic.

**Priority: HIGH** -- gRPC is the primary protocol for Bilibili's app-level API (dynamic feed, search, playurl, etc.).

---

### `BiliGrpcClient.kt`
**Path:** `D:\Documents\GitHub\BiliPai\app\src\main\java\com\android\purebilibili\core\network\grpc\BiliGrpcClient.kt`

**Pure Kotlin?** No -- depends on `okhttp3`, `com.android.purebilibili.core.network.NetworkModule`, `com.android.purebilibili.core.store.TokenManager`, and `java.util.Base64`.

**Logic:**
- Sends HTTP POST to `https://app.bilibili.com{path}` with `content-type: application/grpc`, `grpc-encoding: gzip`, a fake `x-bili-trace-id` of all-1s, `buvid` header, cookie header, and optional `authorization: identify_v1 {access_token}`.
- Validates response: checks `grpc-status` header equals `"0"`.
- Calls `ProtoWire.unframe()` on the response body.
- Cookie building: `buvid3`, `SESSDATA`, `bili_jct`, `DedeUserID` from TokenManager caches.
- Buvid resolution: uses cached buvid3 or generates `UUID-without-dashes + "infoc"`.

**Constants:**
- `APP_BASE_URL = "https://app.bilibili.com"`
- `USER_AGENT` = a specific `android_hd` client UA string.
- `TRACE_ID = "11111111111111111111111111111111:1111111111111111:0:0"`

**Dart translation needs:** Replace OkHttp with `dart:io` `HttpClient` or the `dio` package. The request building and header logic is directly portable. TokenManager references need to be replaced with a Dart token store.

## 3. Danmaku Protocol

### `DanmakuProto.kt`
**Path:** `D:\Documents\GitHub\BiliPai\app\src\main\java\com\android\purebilibili\feature\video\danmaku\DanmakuProto.kt`

**Pure Kotlin?** Mostly. The only Android dependency is `android.util.Log` (used for logging). The actual parsing logic uses only `java.io.ByteArrayInputStream`, `java.io.DataInputStream`, `java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets`. The `Log` calls can be trivially replaced.

**Implementation:**
- Hand-rolled protobuf parser for Bilibili's danmaku protobuf responses.
- Contains a private `ProtoInput` class (varint reader, length-delimited reader, string reader, float reader, field skipper).
- **Two main parse targets:**
  1. `parseWebViewReply(data)` -> `DmWebViewReply` -- the `x/v2/dm/web/view` response. Handles field-number ambiguity between old/new API versions (fields 3-10 have different meanings in old vs new API, resolved via heuristic checks like `isLikelyDmSegConfig` and `isLikelyDanmakuFlagConfig`).
  2. `parse(data)` -> `List<DanmakuElem>` -- the `DmSegMobileReply` response (segment danmaku list). Parses each `DanmakuElem` with field numbers 1-29.
- **Data classes:** `DanmakuElem` (13 fields), `DmWebViewReply` (8 fields), `DmSegConfig`, `DanmakuFlagConfig`, `CommandDm` (10 fields), `DmSetting` (20 fields).

**DanmakuElem field map:** id(1), progress(2), mode(3), fontsize(4), color(5), midHash(6), content(7), ctime(8), weight(9), action(10), pool(11), idStr(12), attr(13), like(15), animation(22), extra(23), colorful(24), type(25), oid(26), dmFrom(27), count(28), isSelf(29).

**Constants:** `DmColorfulTypeNone = 0`, `DmColorfulTypeVipGradualColor = 60001`.

**Dart translation needs:** Replace `ProtoInput` with a Dart equivalent (can share with the gRPC ProtoWire codec or use `protobuf` package with .proto definitions). The field-number ambiguity resolution heuristics must be preserved. Replace `android.util.Log` with `dart:developer` log or package logging.

**Priority: HIGH** -- danmaku is a core feature of any Bilibili client.

---

### `DanmakuProtocol.kt`
**Path:** `D:\Documents\GitHub\BiliPai\app\src\main\java\com\android\purebilibili\core\network\socket\DanmakuProtocol.kt`

**Pure Kotlin?** Mostly. Uses `kotlinx.coroutines`, `org.brotli.dec.BrotliInputStream`, and standard Java I/O. The Brotli dependency is the main external library. No Android SDK imports.

**Protocol format (big-endian binary):**
- 16-byte header: `[0-3]` packet length (total), `[4-5]` header length (16), `[6-7]` protocol version, `[8-11]` operation code, `[12-15]` sequence ID.
- Body follows after header.

**Protocol versions:**
- `0` = JSON data
- `1` = heartbeat/popularity (Int32)
- `2` = Zlib compressed (recursive decode)
- `3` = Brotli compressed (recursive decode)

**Operation codes:**
- `2` = client heartbeat
- `3` = server heartbeat reply (popularity)
- `5` = message notification (danmaku, gifts, etc.)
- `7` = auth packet
- `8` = auth reply

**Logic:**
- `encode()`: builds a `ByteBuffer` with big-endian byte order, writes header + body.
- `decode()`: reads packets from buffer, for Zlib/Brotli versions, decompresses and recursively decodes. Uses `withContext(Dispatchers.Default)`.
- `decompressZlib()`: uses `InflaterOutputStream`.
- `decompressBrotli()`: uses `BrotliInputStream` from the `org.brotli.dec` package.

**Dart translation needs:**
- `dart:typed_data` `ByteData` for binary manipulation.
- `dart:io` `ZLibDecoder` for Zlib.
- Brotli: use `brotli` package on pub.dev or compile a FFI binding.
- `kotlinx.coroutines` -> Dart `Future`/`Isolate` for async decompression.
- The recursive decode pattern is directly portable.

**Priority: HIGH** -- this is the live streaming danmaku WebSocket protocol; essential for live features.

## 5. Business Policies

### `VideoLoadPolicy.kt`
**Path:** `D:\Documents\GitHub\BiliPai\app\src\main\java\com\android\purebilibili\data\repository\VideoLoadPolicy.kt`

**Pure Kotlin?** Yes -- fully pure. Only imports `DashVideo` and `Page` data models. No Android/kotlinx.coroutines dependencies.

**Logic (20+ functions):**
- `resolveVideoInfoLookupInput()`: parses BV/av IDs.
- `resolveInitialStartQuality()`: quality negotiation based on VIP status, login state, auto-highest setting, mobile data preference. Quality ladder: 32 (guest) -> 64 (login) -> 80 (login+1080p) -> 116 (VIP) -> 125 (VIP+HDR) -> 127 (8K).
- `buildDashAttemptQualities()`: builds fallback chain for premium qualities (127, 126, 125, 120, 116, 112 -> 80).
- `shouldScheduleHdrAutoUpgrade()`: 8-condition check for non-blocking HDR upgrade.
- `buildPlayUrlWbiBaseParams()`: constructs the standard playurl WBI parameter set (`fnval=4048`, `fourk=1`, `voice_balance=1`, `gaia_source=pre-load`, etc.).
- `buildDirectedTrafficWbiOverrides()`: mobile data "directed traffic" mode params (`platform=android`, `mobi_app=android`, `build=8130300`).
- Multiple quality satisfaction, cache decision, and retry functions.

**Priority: HIGH** -- this is the central playback quality orchestration logic. Without it, the Flutter client cannot properly negotiate video stream quality.

### `VideoResponse.kt` (PlayUrl)
**Path:** `D:\Documents\GitHub\BiliPai\app\src\main\java\com\android\purebilibili\data\model\response\VideoResponse.kt`

**Pure Kotlin?** No -- `getBestVideo()` and `getBestAudio()` use `android.util.Log.w()` and `com.android.purebilibili.core.util.Logger.d()`. Also imports `VideoDecodeFormat` and `findClosestTarget` utility.

- `Dash.getBestAudio()`: matches by ID, handles Dolby (30250) and Hi-Res/FLAC (30251) special cases, uses closest-target fallback.

**Priority: HIGH** -- the playurl response model and stream selection logic is essential for playback.

## Summary: Porting Priority Matrix

| Priority | Category | Files | Pure Kotlin? | Key Translation Challenges |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **HIGH** | Network Signing | `WbiUtils.kt`, `AppSignUtils.kt` | Yes (except Logger) | MD5, permutation table, exact URL encoding |
| **HIGH** | gRPC Protocol | `ProtoWire.kt`, `BiliGrpcClient.kt` | ProtoWire: Yes; Client: No (OkHttp) | LEB128 varint, CESU-8 tolerance, GZIP framing |
| **HIGH** | Danmaku Protocol | `DanmakuProto.kt`, `DanmakuProtocol.kt` | Mostly (android.util.Log) | Protobuf parsing, Brotli decompression, binary frame codec |
| **HIGH** | Playback Policy | `VideoLoadPolicy.kt` | Yes | Quality ladder logic, 20+ decision functions |
| **HIGH** | Data Models | `VideoResponse.kt`, `LoginModels.kt`, `NavModels.kt`, `ResponseModels.kt`, `SearchModels.kt`, `VideoDetailResponse.kt` | Mostly (some use android.util.Log) | Flexible serializers, JSON type coercion, sealed class translation |
| **MEDIUM** | Download Policies | `DownloadQueuePolicy.kt`, `DownloadResumePolicy.kt`, `DownloadAssetPolicy.kt`, `DownloadPersistencePolicy.kt`, `DownloadTask.kt` | Yes | Straightforward data/logic ports |
| **MEDIUM** | Business Policies | `PlaybackHeartbeatPolicy.kt`, `SearchLoadPolicy.kt` | Yes | Heartbeat field construction, search merge/dedup |
| **MEDIUM** | Network Policies | `NetworkFallbackPolicy.kt` | Yes | DNS fallback table |
| **MEDIUM** | Plugin System | `RuleEngine.kt`, `JsonRulePlugin.kt` | No (Compose Color) | Color parsing replacement, custom serializer -> manual JSON parsing |
| **LOW** | Plugin SDK | `plugin-sdk/*.kt` | Yes | Interface contracts, sealed class translation |
| **LOW** | Download (Android-specific) | `DownloadStoragePolicy.kt`, `DownloadCleanupPolicy.kt`, `OfflineEpisodeQueuePolicy.kt` | No (java.io.File, SAF) | Platform-specific file access patterns |
| **LOW** | Business (optional) | `CommentFraudDetectionPolicy.kt`, `HomeFeedAnonymizerPolicy.kt`, `BatchDownload*.kt` | Yes | Diagnostic/optional features |

**Total files analyzed: 28 source files across 8 categories.**

The recommended porting order for a Flutter Bilibili client would be:
1. `WbiUtils.kt` + `AppSignUtils.kt` + `WbiKeyManager.kt` (signing foundation)
2. `ProtoWire.kt` + `BiliGrpcClient.kt` (gRPC transport)
3. Data models: `NavModels.kt`, `LoginModels.kt`, `VideoResponse.kt`, `VideoDetailResponse.kt`, `SearchModels.kt`, `ResponseModels.kt`
4. `DanmakuProto.kt` + `DanmakuProtocol.kt` (danmaku)
5. `VideoLoadPolicy.kt` (playback quality orchestration)
6. Remaining policies and download logic

49	     * 签名计算时使用编码后的值。
50	     *
51	     * WBI 的额外风控指纹参数不再默认注入，避免污染像 playurl 这类

61	        val currTime = System.currentTimeMillis() / 1000
62	
63	        // 1. 准备原始参数 (加入 wts)，并过滤非法字符
64	        val rawParams = mutableMapOf<String, String>()
65	        for ((key, value) in params) {
66	            rawParams[key] = filterIllegalChars(value)
67	        }
68	        rawParams["wts"] = currTime.toString()
69	        if (includeRiskFingerprint) {
70	            rawParams.appendRiskFingerprintParams()
71	        }
72	
73	        // 2. 排序 Key
74	        val sortedKeys = rawParams.keys.sorted()
75	
76	        // 3. 拼接字符串用于计算 Hash (Key=EncodedValue)
77	        val queryBuilder = StringBuilder()
78	        for (key in sortedKeys) {
79	            val value = rawParams[key]
80	            if (value != null) {
81	                // 重点：这里编码只是为了算 Hash
82	                val encodedValue = encodeURIComponent(value)
83	
84	                if (queryBuilder.isNotEmpty()) {
85	                    queryBuilder.append("&")
86	                }
87	                queryBuilder.append(key).append("=").append(encodedValue)
88	            }
89	        }
90	
91	        // 4. 计算签名
92	        val strToHash = queryBuilder.toString() + mixinKey
93	        val wRid = md5(strToHash)
94	        
95	        com.android.purebilibili.core.util.Logger.d("WbiUtils", " w_rid: $wRid, params count: ${rawParams.size}")
96	
97	        // 5. 将签名加入原始参数表
98	        rawParams["w_rid"] = wRid
99	
100	        // 返回未编码的 Map，交给 Retrofit 处理
101	        return rawParams
102	    }
103	}

28	    
29	    /**
30	     * Percent-encode like Dart/PiliPlus Uri.encodeComponent / encodeURIComponent.
31	     * Uses URLEncoder then maps '+' to '%20' so spaces match form-urlencoded clients
32	     * that do not use application/x-www-form-urlencoded's plus convention.
33	     */
34	    fun percentEncode(value: String): String {
35	        return URLEncoder.encode(value, StandardCharsets.UTF_8.name()).replace("+", "%20")
36	    }
37	
38	    /**
39	     * 计算 APP 签名
40	     * 签名规则：将参数按 key 排序后拼接成 query string，末尾加上 appsec，然后 MD5
41	     * 
42	     * @param params 请求参数 (不含 sign)
43	     * @param appSec 使用的 appsec
44	     * @return 签名后的完整参数 Map (含 sign)
45	     */
46	    fun sign(params: Map<String, String>, appSec: String = TV_APP_SEC): Map<String, String> {
47	        val sortedParams = params.toSortedMap()
48	        
49	        // 构建 query string
50	        val queryString = sortedParams.entries.joinToString("&") { "${it.key}=${it.value}" }
51	        
52	        // 计算 MD5
53	        val signStr = queryString + appSec
54	        val sign = md5(signStr)
55	        
56	        // 返回包含 sign 的完整参数
57	        return sortedParams + ("sign" to sign)
58	    }
59

83	        }

85	        val queryString = sortedParams.entries.joinToString("&") { (key, value) ->
86	            "${percentEncode(key)}=${percentEncode(value)}"
87	        }
88	        return sortedParams + ("sign" to md5(queryString + ANDROID_HD_APP_SEC))

102	     */
103	    private fun md5(input: String): String {

9	internal object ProtoWire {
10	    const val WIRE_VARINT = 0
11	    const val WIRE_FIXED64 = 1
12	    const val WIRE_LENGTH_DELIMITED = 2
13	    const val WIRE_FIXED32 = 5
14	
15	    data class Field(
16	        val number: Int,
17	        val wireType: Int,
18	        val varint: Long = 0L,
19	        val bytes: ByteArray = ByteArray(0),
20	        val fixed64: Long = 0L,
21	        val fixed32: Int = 0
22	    )
23	
24	    fun frame(message: ByteArray, gzipMinLength: Int = 64): ByteArray {
25	        val compressed = message.size > gzipMinLength
26	        val payload = if (compressed) gzip(message) else message
27	        return ByteArrayOutputStream(payload.size + 5).use { out ->
28	            out.write(if (compressed) 1 else 0)
29	            out.write(ByteBuffer.allocate(4).order(ByteOrder.BIG_ENDIAN).putInt(payload.size).array())
30	            out.write(payload)
31	            out.toByteArray()
32	        }
33	    }
34	
35	    fun unframe(frame: ByteArray): ByteArray {
36	        require(frame.size >= 5) { "Invalid gRPC frame length: ${frame.size}" }
37	        val compressed = frame[0].toInt() == 1
38	        val length = ByteBuffer.wrap(frame, 1, 4).order(ByteOrder.BIG_ENDIAN).int
39	        require(length >= 0 && frame.size >= length + 5) { "Invalid gRPC payload length: $length" }
40	        val payload = frame.copyOfRange(5, 5 + length)
41	        return if (compressed) gunzip(payload) else payload
42	    }
43	
44	    fun message(vararg fields: ByteArray): ByteArray {
45	        return ByteArrayOutputStream(fields.sumOf { it.size }).use { out ->
46	            fields.forEach(out::write)
47	            out.toByteArray()
48	        }
49	    }
50	
51	    fun int64(fieldNumber: Int, value: Long): ByteArray = field(fieldNumber, WIRE_VARINT, varint(value))
52	
53	    fun int32(fieldNumber: Int, value: Int): ByteArray = int64(fieldNumber, value.toLong())
54	
55	    fun bool(fieldNumber: Int, value: Boolean): ByteArray = int64(fieldNumber, if (value) 1L else 0L)
56	
57	    fun string(fieldNumber: Int, value: String): ByteArray {
58	        if (value.isEmpty()) return ByteArray(0)
59	        val bytes = value.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
60	        return field(fieldNumber, WIRE_LENGTH_DELIMITED, varint(bytes.size.toLong()), bytes)
61	    }
62	
63	    fun bytes(fieldNumber: Int, value: ByteArray): ByteArray {
64	        if (value.isEmpty()) return ByteArray(0)
65	        return field(fieldNumber, WIRE_LENGTH_DELIMITED, varint(value.size.toLong()), value)
66	    }
67	
68	    fun double(fieldNumber: Int, value: Double): ByteArray {
69	        val fixed = ByteBuffer.allocate(8)
70	            .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
71	            .putDouble(value)
72	            .array()
73	        return field(fieldNumber, WIRE_FIXED64, fixed)

76	    fun parseFields(data: ByteArray): List<Field> {
77	        val reader = Reader(data)
78	        val fields = mutableListOf<Field>()
79	        while (!reader.exhausted()) {
80	            val tag = reader.readVarint().toInt()
81	            if (tag == 0) break
82	            val number = tag ushr 3
83	            val wireType = tag and 0x07
84	            fields += when (wireType) {
85	                WIRE_VARINT -> Field(number, wireType, varint = reader.readVarint())
86	                WIRE_FIXED64 -> Field(number, wireType, fixed64 = reader.readFixed64())
87	                WIRE_LENGTH_DELIMITED -> {

90	                }
91	                WIRE_FIXED32 -> Field(number, wireType, fixed32 = reader.readFixed32())
92	                else -> error("Unsupported protobuf wire type: $wireType")
93	            }
94	        }
95	        return fields
96	    }

100	    fun doubleValue(field: Field): Double {
101	        return ByteBuffer.wrap(ByteBuffer.allocate(8).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).putLong(field.fixed64).array())
102	            .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
103	            .double
104	    }
105	
106	    private fun field(fieldNumber: Int, wireType: Int, vararg payload: ByteArray): ByteArray {
107	        return ByteArrayOutputStream().use { out ->
108	            out.write(varint(((fieldNumber shl 3) or wireType).toLong()))
109	            payload.forEach(out::write)
110	            out.toByteArray()
111	        }
112	    }
113	
114	    private fun varint(value: Long): ByteArray {
115	        var current = value
116	        val out = ByteArrayOutputStream()
117	        while (true) {
118	            if ((current and 0x7FL.inv()) == 0L) {
119	                out.write(current.toInt())
120	                return out.toByteArray()
121	            }
122	            out.write(((current and 0x7F) or 0x80).toInt())
123	            current = current ushr 7
124	        }
125	    }
126	
127	    private fun gzip(bytes: ByteArray): ByteArray {
128	        val out = ByteArrayOutputStream()
129	        GZIPOutputStream(out).use { it.write(bytes) }
130	        return out.toByteArray()
131	    }
132	
133	    private fun gunzip(bytes: ByteArray): ByteArray {
134	        return GZIPInputStream(bytes.inputStream()).use { it.readBytes() }
135	    }
136	
137	    private fun decodeStringValue(bytes: ByteArray): String {
138	        val utf8 = bytes.toString(Charsets.UTF_8)
139	        if (REPLACEMENT_CHAR !in utf8) return utf8
140	
141	        // B 站部分 gRPC 字符串会用 CESU-8 代理对承载非 BMP 字符，标准 UTF-8 会把它解成 U+FFFD。
142	        val tolerant = decodeUtf8AllowingCesu8Surrogates(bytes)
143	        return if (tolerant.countReplacementChars() < utf8.countReplacementChars()) {
144	            tolerant
145	        } else {
146	            utf8
147	        }
148	    }
149	
150	    private fun decodeUtf8AllowingCesu8Surrogates(bytes: ByteArray): String {
151	        val out = StringBuilder(bytes.size)
152	        var index = 0
153	        while (index < bytes.size) {
154	            index = appendUtf8OrCesu8CodePoint(bytes, index, out)
155	        }
156	        return out.toString()
157	    }
158	
159	    private fun appendUtf8OrCesu8CodePoint(bytes: ByteArray, index: Int, out: StringBuilder): Int {
160	        val first = bytes[index].unsigned()
161	        return when {
162	            first < 0x80 -> {
163	                out.append(first.toChar())
164	                index + 1
165	            }
166	
167	            first in 0xC2..0xDF && hasContinuation(bytes, index, 1) -> {
168	                val codePoint = ((first and 0x1F) shl 6) or (bytes[index + 1].unsigned() and 0x3F)
169	                out.append(codePoint.toChar())
170	                index + 2
171	            }
172	
173	            first in 0xE0..0xEF && hasContinuation(bytes, index, 2) && isValidThreeBytePrefix(bytes, index) ->
174	                appendThreeByteOrCesu8CodePoint(bytes, index, out)
175	
176	            first in 0xF0..0xF4 && hasContinuation(bytes, index, 3) && isValidFourBytePrefix(bytes, index) -> {
177	                out.appendCodePoint(decodeFourByteCodePoint(bytes, index))
178	                index + 4
179	            }
180	
181	            else -> {
182	                out.append(REPLACEMENT_CHAR)
183	                index + 1
184	            }
185	        }
186	    }
187	
188	    private fun appendThreeByteOrCesu8CodePoint(bytes: ByteArray, index: Int, out: StringBuilder): Int {
189	        val codePoint = decodeThreeByteCodePoint(bytes, index)
190	        if (codePoint in HIGH_SURROGATE_START..HIGH_SURROGATE_END) {
191	            val lowSurrogate = decodeCesu8LowSurrogate(bytes, index + 3)
192	            return if (lowSurrogate != null) {
193	                out.appendCodePoint(Character.toCodePoint(codePoint.toChar(), lowSurrogate.toChar()))
194	                index + 6
195	            } else {
196	                out.append(REPLACEMENT_CHAR)
197	                index + 3
198	            }
199	        }
200	        if (codePoint in LOW_SURROGATE_START..LOW_SURROGATE_END) {
201	            out.append(REPLACEMENT_CHAR)
202	        } else {
203	            out.append(codePoint.toChar())
204	        }
205	        return index + 3
206	    }
207	
208	    private fun decodeCesu8LowSurrogate(bytes: ByteArray, index: Int): Int? {
209	        if (index + 2 >= bytes.size || !hasContinuation(bytes, index, 2)) return null
210	        if (bytes[index].unsigned() != 0xED) return null
211	        val codePoint = decodeThreeByteCodePoint(bytes, index)
212	        return codePoint.takeIf { it in LOW_SURROGATE_START..LOW_SURROGATE_END }
213	    }
214	
215	    private fun hasContinuation(bytes: ByteArray, index: Int, count: Int): Boolean {
216	        if (index + count >= bytes.size) return false
217	        for (offset in 1..count) {
218	            if ((bytes[index + offset].unsigned() and 0xC0) != 0x80) return false
219	        }
220	        return true
221	    }
222	
223	    private fun isValidThreeBytePrefix(bytes: ByteArray, index: Int): Boolean {
224	        val first = bytes[index].unsigned()
225	        val second = bytes[index + 1].unsigned()
226	        return when (first) {
227	            0xE0 -> second >= 0xA0
228	            else -> true
229	        }
230	    }
231	
232	    private fun isValidFourBytePrefix(bytes: ByteArray, index: Int): Boolean {
233	        val first = bytes[index].unsigned()
234	        val second = bytes[index + 1].unsigned()
235	        return when (first) {
236	            0xF0 -> second >= 0x90
237	            0xF4 -> second <= 0x8F
238	            else -> true
239	        }
240	    }
241	
242	    private fun decodeThreeByteCodePoint(bytes: ByteArray, index: Int): Int {
243	        return ((bytes[index].unsigned() and 0x0F) shl 12) or
244	            ((bytes[index + 1].unsigned() and 0x3F) shl 6) or
245	            (bytes[index + 2].unsigned() and 0x3F)
246	    }
247	
248	    private fun decodeFourByteCodePoint(bytes: ByteArray, index: Int): Int {
249	        return ((bytes[index].unsigned() and 0x07) shl 18) or
250	            ((bytes[index + 1].unsigned() and 0x3F) shl 12) or
251	            ((bytes[index + 2].unsigned() and 0x3F) shl 6) or
252	            (bytes[index + 3].unsigned() and 0x3F)
253	    }
254	
255	    private fun Byte.unsigned(): Int = toInt() and 0xFF
256	
257	    private fun String.countReplacementChars(): Int = count { it == REPLACEMENT_CHAR }
258	
259	    private const val REPLACEMENT_CHAR = '\uFFFD'
260	    private const val HIGH_SURROGATE_START = 0xD800
261	    private const val HIGH_SURROGATE_END = 0xDBFF
262	    private const val LOW_SURROGATE_START = 0xDC00
263	    private const val LOW_SURROGATE_END = 0xDFFF
264	
265	    private class Reader(private val data: ByteArray) {
266	        private var position = 0
267	
268	        fun exhausted(): Boolean = position >= data.size
269	
270	        fun readVarint(): Long {
271	            var shift = 0
272	            var result = 0L
273	            while (shift < 64) {
274	                val byte = readByte().toLong() and 0xFF
275	                result = result or ((byte and 0x7F) shl shift)
276	                if ((byte and 0x80) == 0L) return result
277	                shift += 7
278	            }
279	            error("Malformed protobuf varint")
280	        }
281	
282	        fun readFixed64(): Long {
283	            require(position + 8 <= data.size) { "Unexpected EOF reading fixed64" }
284	            val value = ByteBuffer.wrap(data, position, 8).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).long
285	            position += 8
286	            return value
287	        }
288	
289	        fun readFixed32(): Int {
290	            require(position + 4 <= data.size) { "Unexpected EOF reading fixed32" }
291	            val value = ByteBuffer.wrap(data, position, 4).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).int
292	            position += 4
293	            return value
294	        }
295	
296	        fun readBytes(length: Int): ByteArray {
297	            require(length >= 0 && position + length <= data.size) { "Unexpected EOF reading bytes: $length" }
298	            return data.copyOfRange(position, position + length).also {
299	                position += length
300	            }
301	        }
302	
303	        private fun readByte(): Byte {
304	            require(position < data.size) { "Unexpected EOF reading byte" }
305	            return data[position++]
306	        }
307	    }
308	}

291	    // if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('post-data: $data');
292	    try {
293	      return await dio.post<T>(
294	        url,
295	        data: data,
296	        queryParameters: queryParameters,
297	        options: options,
298	        cancelToken: cancelToken,
299	      );
300	    } on DioException catch (e) {
301	      AccountManager.toast(e);
302	      return Response(
303	        data: {
304	          'message': await AccountManager.dioError(e),
305	        }, // 将自定义 Map 数据赋值给 Response 的 data 属性
306	        statusCode: e.response?.statusCode ?? -1,
307	        requestOptions: e.requestOptions,
308	      );
309	    }
310	  }
311

314	   */
315	  Future<Response> downloadFile(
316	    String urlPath,

318	    CancelToken? cancelToken,
319	  }) async {

321	      return await dio.download(

336	        },

338	        requestOptions: e.requestOptions,
339	      );
340	    }
341	  }
342	
343	  static List<int> responseBytesDecoder(
344	    List<int> responseBytes,
345	    Map<String, List<String>> headers,
346	  ) => switch (headers['content-encoding']?.firstOrNull) {
347	    'gzip' => _gzipDecoder.decodeBytes(responseBytes),
348	    'br' => _brotliDecoder.convert(responseBytes),
349	    _ => responseBytes,
350	  };
351	
352	  static String _responseDecoder(
353	    List<int> responseBytes,
354	    RequestOptions options,
355	    ResponseBody responseBody,
356	  ) => utf8.decode(
357	    responseBytesDecoder(responseBytes, responseBody.headers),
358	    allowMalformed: true,
359	  );
360	}

4	sealed class LoadingState<T> {
5	  const LoadingState();
6	
7	  factory LoadingState.loading() => const Loading._internal();
8	
9	  bool get isSuccess => this is Success<T>;
10	
11	  T get data => switch (this) {
12	    Success(:final response) => response,
13	    _ => throw this,
14	  };
15	
16	  T? get dataOrNull => switch (this) {
17	    Success(:final response) => response,
18	    _ => null,
19	  };
20	
21	  Future<void> toast() => SmartDialog.showToast(toString());
22	}

24	class Loading extends LoadingState<Never> {
25	  const Loading._internal();
26	
27	  @override
28	  String toString() {
29	    return 'ApiException: loading';
30	  }
31	}
32	
33	@immutable
34	class Success<T> extends LoadingState<T> {
35	  final T response;
36	  const Success(this.response);
37	
38	  @override
39	  bool operator ==(Object other) {
40	    if (identical(this, other)) {
41	      return true;
42	    }
43	    if (other is Success<T>) {
44	      return response == other.response;
45	    }
46	    return false;
47	  }
48	
49	  @override
50	  int get hashCode => response.hashCode;
51	}
52	
53	@immutable
54	class Error extends LoadingState<Never> {
55	  final int? code;
56	  final String? errMsg;
57	  const Error(this.errMsg, {this.code});
58	
59	  @override
60	  bool operator ==(Object other) {
61	    if (identical(this, other)) {
62	      return true;
63	    }
64	    if (other is Error) {
65	      return errMsg == other.errMsg && code == other.code;
66	    }

532	  // 发表评论 replyAdd
533	
534	  // type	num	评论区类型代码	必要	类型代码见表
535	  // oid	num	目标评论区id	必要
536	  // root	num	根评论rpid	非必要	二级评论以上使用
537	  // parent	num	父评论rpid	非必要	二级评论同根评论id 大于二级评论为要回复的评论id
538	  // message	str	发送评论内容	必要	最大1000字符
539	  // plat	num	发送平台标识	非必要	1：web端 2：安卓客户端  3：ios客户端  4：wp客户端
540	  static Future<LoadingState<ReplyInfo?>> replyAdd({
541	    required int type,
542	    required int oid,
543	    required String message,
544	    int? root,
545	    int? parent,
546	    List? pictures,
547	    bool syncToDynamic = false,
548	    Map<String, int>? atNameToMid,
549	  }) async {
550	    final data = {
551	      'type': type,
552	      'oid': oid,
553	      if (root != null && root != 0) 'root': root,
554	      if (parent != null && parent != 0) 'parent': parent,
555	      'message': message,
556	      if (atNameToMid?.isNotEmpty == true)
557	        'at_name_to_mid': jsonEncode(atNameToMid), // {"name":uid}
558	      if (pictures != null) 'pictures': jsonEncode(pictures),
559	      if (syncToDynamic) 'sync_to_dynamic': 1,
560	      'csrf': Accounts.main.csrf,
561	    };
562	    final res = await Request().post(
563	      Api.replyAdd,
564	      data: data,
565	      options: Options(contentType: Headers.formUrlEncodedContentType),
566	    );
567	    if (res.data['code'] == 0) {
568	      try {
569	        final replyInfo = RequestUtils.replyCast(res.data['data']['reply']);
570	        GStorage.reply?.put(
571	          replyInfo.id.toString(),
572	          (replyInfo.deepCopy()
573	                ..unknownFields.clear()
574	                ..clearTrackInfo())
575	              .writeToBuffer(),
576	        );
577	        return Success(replyInfo);
578	      } catch (e, s) {
579	        Utils.reportError(e, s);
580	        return const Success(null);
581	      }
582	    } else {
583	      return Error(res.data['message']);
584	    }
585	  }

847	        case .vtt:
848	          return compute<List, String>(SubtitleUtils.json2Vtt, list);

851	      }
852	    }

854	  }

856	  static bool _canAddRank(Map i) {
857	    if (!GlobalData().blackMids.contains(i['owner']['mid']) &&
858	        !RecommendFilter.filterTitle(i['title']) &&
859	        !RecommendFilter.filterLikeRatio(
860	          i['stat']['like'],
861	          i['stat']['view'],
862	        )) {
863	      if (enableFilter &&
864	          i['tname'] != null &&
865	          zoneRegExp.hasMatch(i['tname'])) {
866	        return false;
867	      }
868	      return true;
869	    }
870	    return false;
871	  }

1027	    required int objectId, // aid, epid
1028	    required int playurlType, // ugc 1, pgc 2
1029	    int? qn,
1030	  }) async {
1031	    final accessKey = Accounts.get(AccountType.video).accessKey;
1032	    final params = {
1033	      'access_key': ?accessKey,
1034	      'actionKey': 'appkey',
1035	      'cid': cid,
1036	      'fourk': 1,
1037	      'is_proj': 1,
1038	      'mobile_access_key': ?accessKey,
1039	      'object_id': objectId,
1040	      'mobi_app': 'android',
1041	      'platform': 'android',
1042	      'playurl_type': playurlType,
1043	      'protocol': 0,
1044	      'qn': qn ?? 80,
1045	    };
1046	    AppSign.appSign(params);

1	import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
2	import 'package:http2/http2.dart';
3	
4	class RetryInterceptor extends Interceptor {
5	  final Dio _client;
6	  final int _count;
7	  final int _delay;
8	
9	  RetryInterceptor(this._client, this._count, this._delay);
10	
11	  @override
12	  void onError(DioException err, ErrorInterceptorHandler handler) {
13	    if (err.requestOptions.responseType == ResponseType.stream) {
14	      return handler.next(err);
15	    }
16	    if (err.response != null) {
17	      final options = err.requestOptions;
18	      if (options.followRedirects && options.maxRedirects > 0) {
19	        final status = err.response!.statusCode;
20	        if (status != null && 300 <= status && status < 400) {
21	          var redirectUrl = err.response!.headers.value('location');
22	          if (redirectUrl != null) {
23	            var uri = Uri.parse(redirectUrl);
24	            if (!uri.hasScheme) {
25	              uri = options.uri.resolveUri(uri);
26	              redirectUrl = uri.toString();
27	            }
28	            (options..path = redirectUrl).maxRedirects--;
29	            if (status == 303) {
30	              options
31	                ..data = null
32	                ..method = 'GET';
33	            }
34	            _client
35	                .fetch(options)
36	                .then(
37	                  (i) => handler.resolve(
38	                    i
39	                      ..redirects.add(
40	                        RedirectRecord(status, options.method, uri),
41	                      )
42	                      ..isRedirect = true,
43	                  ),
44	                )
45	                .onError<DioException>((error, _) => handler.next(error));
46	            return;
47	          }
48	        }
49	      }
50	      return handler.next(err);
51	    } else {
52	      switch (err.type) {
53	        case DioExceptionType.connectionError:
54	        case DioExceptionType.connectionTimeout:
55	        case DioExceptionType.sendTimeout:
56	        case DioExceptionType.unknown:
57	          if ((err.requestOptions.extra['_rt'] ??= 0) < _count &&
58	              err.error
59	                  is! TransportConnectionException // 网络中断, 此时请求可能已经被服务器所接收
60	                  ) {
61	            Future.delayed(
62	              Duration(
63	                milliseconds: ++err.requestOptions.extra['_rt'] * _delay,
64	              ),
65	              () => _client
66	                  .fetch(err.requestOptions)
67	                  .then(handler.resolve)
68	                  .onError<DioException>((error, _) => handler.reject(error)),
69	            );
70	          } else {
71	            handler.next(err);
72	          }
73	          return;
74	        default:
75	          return handler.next(err);
76	      }
77	    }
78	  }
79	
80	  RetryInterceptor copyWith({Dio? client, int? count, int? delay}) =>
81	      .new(client ?? _client, count ?? _count, delay ?? _delay);
82	}
83

9	/**
10	 * B站弹幕 Protobuf 手动解析器
11	 * 
12	 * 协议格式 (Protobuf Wire Format):
13	 * - DmSegMobileReply { repeated DanmakuElem elems = 1; }
14	 * - DanmakuElem 字段:
15	 *   - id (field 1, int64)
16	 *   - progress (field 2, int32) - 弹幕出现时间(ms)
17	 *   - mode (field 3, int32) - 弹幕类型
18	 *   - fontsize (field 4, int32) - 字体大小
19	 *   - color (field 5, uint32) - 颜色 RGB
20	 *   - midHash (field 6, string) - 用户 hash
21	 *   - content (field 7, string) - 弹幕内容
22	 *   - ctime (field 8, int64) - 发送时间戳
23	 *   - weight (field 9, int32) - 权重
24	     *   - action (field 10, string)
25	     *   - pool (field 11, int32) - 弹幕池
26	     *   - idStr (field 12, string)
